title: 3D Human Pose Perception from Egocentric Stereo Videos
contribution: Transformer for egocentric stereo 3D body pose that uses scene information and temporal context to handle self-occlusion from head-mounted cameras, plus new egocentric stereo datasets. (Highlight)
datasets: UnrealEgo; new UnrealEgo-RW and synthetic egocentric stereo data

title: 3DGS-Avatar: Animatable Avatars via Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Builds animatable clothed human avatars from a monocular video with deformable 3D Gaussian splatting for fast training and real-time rendering.
datasets: ZJU-MoCap; PeopleSnapshot (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: 6D-Diff: A Keypoint Diffusion Framework for 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Keypoint diffusion framework that denoises 2D keypoint hypotheses to handle occlusion and clutter in RGB 6D object pose estimation.

title: A Simple Baseline for Efficient Hand Mesh Reconstruction
contribution: Decomposes hand mesh decoders into token generator and mesh regressor and ablates them to derive a simple, efficient single-image hand mesh baseline.

title: A Unified Diffusion Framework for Scene-aware Human Motion Estimation from Sparse Signals
contribution: Diffusion model that estimates full-body motion from sparse head and hand tracking signals of AR/VR devices, conditioned on the 3D scene to resolve ambiguity.
sensing: sparse HMD and controller tracking signals plus 3D scene

title: Attention-Propagation Network for Egocentric Heatmap to 3D Pose Lifting
contribution: Lifts egocentric joint heatmaps to 3D body pose with an attention-propagation network to cope with self-occlusion and out-of-view limbs. (Highlight)

title: Authentic Hand Avatar from a Phone Scan via Universal Hand Model
contribution: Universal hand model that jointly tracks and models high-fidelity hand meshes across identities and adapts to a person from a short phone scan to produce an authentic hand avatar for AR/VR.
sensing: multi-view capture for the universal model; short phone scan for personalisation

title: BOTH2Hands: Inferring 3D Hands from Both Text Prompts and Body Dynamics
contribution: Introduces BOTH57M, a multimodal dataset of tracked body and two-hand motion with finger-level annotations and text, plus a diffusion baseline that generates two-hand motion from body dynamics and text.
sensing: multi-view mocap with body and hand capture

title: BiTT: Bi-directional Texture Reconstruction of Interacting Two Hands from a Single Image
contribution: First end-to-end method for relightable, pose-free texture reconstruction of two interacting hands from one RGB image, using left-right texture symmetry and a parametric texture model.

title: BodyMAP - Jointly Predicting Body Mesh and 3D Applied Pressure Map for People in Bed
contribution: Jointly predicts 3D body mesh and a 3D applied-pressure map for people lying in bed, aimed at pressure-ulcer prevention.
sensing: single overhead depth image plus pressure mat
datasets: SLP / BodyPressureSD (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: CG-HOI: Contact-Guided 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates dynamic 3D human-object interactions from text by jointly modelling human motion, object motion and explicit human-object contact.
sensing: text input; trained on 3D HOI mocap
datasets: BEHAVE; CHAIRS (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: Capturing Closely Interacted Two-Person Motions with Reaction Priors
contribution: Captures closely interacting two-person 3D motion from monocular video using reaction priors to resolve inter-person occlusion.
datasets: new close-interaction dataset (per paper); not stated in abstract

title: Closely Interactive Human Reconstruction with Proxemics and Physics-Guided Adaption
contribution: Reconstructs closely interacting people from monocular video using proxemics priors and physics-guided adaptation to handle occlusion and depth ambiguity.

title: Complementing Event Streams and RGB Frames for Hand Mesh Reconstruction
contribution: EvRGBHand fuses event-camera streams and RGB frames for 3D hand mesh reconstruction under fast motion and difficult lighting.

title: Confronting Ambiguity in 6D Object Pose Estimation via Score-Based Diffusion on SE(3)
contribution: Score-based diffusion on SE(3) that models pose distributions to handle symmetry and occlusion ambiguity in RGB 6D pose estimation.

title: CyberDemo: Augmenting Simulated Human Demonstration for Real-World Dexterous Manipulation
contribution: Robot imitation learning that augments human teleoperated demonstrations collected in simulation and transfers dexterous manipulation policies to the real world.
sensing: simulated human teleoperation demonstrations; real robot RGB

title: DPHMs: Diffusion Parametric Head Models for Depth-based Tracking
contribution: Diffusion parametric head model used as a prior for robust volumetric head reconstruction and tracking from monocular depth sequences.
datasets: new monocular depth head dataset (DPHM-Kinect, per paper)

title: DPMesh: Exploiting Diffusion Prior for Occluded Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Uses a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model as a backbone prior for occluded human mesh recovery from a single image.
datasets: 3DPW-OC; OCHuman; 3DPW (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: DVMNet: Computing Relative Pose for Unseen Objects Beyond Hypotheses
contribution: Deep voxel matching network that computes the relative pose of an unseen object between two images without scoring discrete pose hypotheses.
datasets: CO3D; Objaverse; LINEMOD (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: DiVa-360: The Dynamic Visual Dataset for Immersive Neural Fields
contribution: Releases a 360-degree synchronized multi-view dynamic dataset including tabletop hand-object interaction sequences for benchmarking dynamic neural fields. (Highlight)

title: DiffusionPoser: Real-time Human Motion Reconstruction From Arbitrary Sparse Sensors Using Autoregressive Diffusion
contribution: Autoregressive diffusion model that reconstructs full-body motion in real time from an arbitrary user-chosen combination of IMUs and pressure insoles.
datasets: AMASS (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: Dynamic Inertial Poser (DynaIP): Part-Based Motion Dynamics Learning for Enhanced Human Pose Estimation with Sparse Inertial Sensors
contribution: Estimates human pose from sparse IMUs using real mocap data, pseudo-velocity regression and part-based dynamics modelling.
datasets: DIP-IMU; TotalCapture; real inertial mocap data

title: EgoExoLearn: A Dataset for Bridging Asynchronous Ego- and Exo-centric View of Procedural Activities in Real World
contribution: Dataset where people record egocentric video while following exocentric demonstration videos, with benchmarks for cross-view association and skill assessment.
sensing: egocentric video with gaze plus exocentric demonstration video

title: EgoGen: An Egocentric Synthetic Data Generator
contribution: Synthetic egocentric data generator that simulates natural human motion with an egocentric-perception-driven policy to produce training data for egocentric tasks including human mesh recovery.

title: Egocentric Whole-Body Motion Capture with FisheyeViT and Diffusion-Based Motion Refinement
contribution: Estimates body and hand motion from a single head-mounted fisheye camera with FisheyeViT and diffusion-based motion refinement under self-occlusion.
datasets: new synthetic egocentric whole-body dataset (EgoWholeBody, per paper)

title: EventEgo3D: 3D Human Motion Capture from Egocentric Event Streams
contribution: Captures 3D human motion from a head-mounted monocular event camera, with a new event-based egocentric dataset.
datasets: new real and synthetic egocentric event datasets (per paper)

title: Forecasting of 3D Whole-body Human Poses with Grasping Objects
contribution: Forecasts 3D whole-body poses including fine hand gestures while humans grasp and interact with objects.
datasets: GRAB (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: FoundationPose: Unified 6D Pose Estimation and Tracking of Novel Objects
contribution: Unified foundation model for 6D pose estimation and tracking of novel objects in both CAD-model-based and few-reference model-free setups, using a neural implicit object representation and large-scale synthetic training.
datasets: LINEMOD; Occluded-LINEMOD; YCB-Video; T-LESS; YCBInEOAT (per paper)

title: FreeMan: Towards Benchmarking 3D Human Pose Estimation under Real-World Conditions
contribution: Large multi-view in-the-wild 3D pose benchmark with 2D/3D keypoints and calibrated cameras for evaluating generalization beyond lab datasets.

title: G-HOP: Generative Hand-Object Prior for Interaction Reconstruction and Grasp Synthesis
contribution: Learns a denoising-diffusion joint prior over hand (skeletal distance field) and object (SDF) conditioned on category and uses it as guidance for video-based hand-object reconstruction and grasp synthesis.

title: GEARS: Local Geometry-aware Hand-object Interaction Synthesis
contribution: Synthesizes hand motion interacting with objects using local geometry-aware joint-centred sensors that generalize across object shapes.

title: GenFlow: Generalizable Recurrent Flow for 6D Pose Refinement of Novel Objects
contribution: Recurrent shape-constrained optical-flow refiner that iteratively improves 6D poses of novel objects given their 3D shape.

title: GenH2R: Learning Generalizable Human-to-Robot Handover via Scalable Simulation Demonstration and Imitation
contribution: Learns vision-based human-to-robot handover of unseen objects from a large procedural simulation (GenH2R-Sim) with about a million generated demonstrations, distilled by imitation learning.
sensing: simulated point clouds; real robot with depth camera

title: GeoReF: Geometric Alignment Across Shape Variation for Category-level Object Pose Refinement
contribution: Category-level object pose refinement with geometric alignment that handles intra-class shape variation.

title: GigaPose: Fast and Robust Novel Object Pose Estimation via One Correspondence
contribution: CAD-based novel object pose estimation from RGB that retrieves out-of-plane rotation with 2-DoF templates and recovers the remaining parameters from a single patch correspondence.

title: HHMR: Holistic Hand Mesh Recovery by Enhancing the Multimodal Controllability of Graph Diffusion Models
contribution: Graph-diffusion model that unifies hand mesh generation, inpainting, reconstruction and fitting in one controllable framework. (Highlight)
sensing: single RGB image and multimodal conditions

title: HOI-M^3: Capture Multiple Humans and Objects Interaction within Contextual Environment
contribution: Introduces HOI-M3, a large-scale multi-view dataset of multiple humans interacting with multiple objects in contextual indoor scenes with 3D body and object tracking annotations, and baselines for monocular capture.
sensing: dense multi-view RGB plus object-mounted IMUs

title: HOIAnimator: Generating Text-prompt Human-object Animations using Novel Perceptive Diffusion Models
contribution: Perceptive diffusion model that generates human-object interaction animations from text prompts.

title: HOIDiffusion: Generating Realistic 3D Hand-Object Interaction Data
contribution: Conditional diffusion model that synthesizes realistic hand-object images from 3D hand-object geometry and text to create HOI training data.
sensing: generated RGB images conditioned on 3D geometry

title: HOISDF: Constraining 3D Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Global Signed Distance Fields
contribution: Jointly exploits hand and object signed distance fields as a global implicit representation to guide monocular 3D hand-object pose estimation under occlusion.

title: HOLD: Category-agnostic 3D Reconstruction of Interacting Hands and Objects from Video
contribution: Template-free joint reconstruction of a hand and an unknown object from a monocular video; it is the baseline for the HANDS 2024 and 2025 ARCTIC bimanual category-agnostic reconstruction challenge, scored with hand-relative Chamfer distance CD_h.

title: HandBooster: Boosting 3D Hand-Mesh Reconstruction by Conditional Synthesis and Sampling of Hand-Object Interactions
contribution: Trains a conditional diffusion model over hand-object interactions and samples novel interaction poses to synthesize labeled images that improve hand-mesh reconstruction under object occlusion.

title: HandDiff: 3D Hand Pose Estimation with Diffusion on Image-Point Cloud
contribution: Diffusion-based 3D hand pose estimation conditioned on image and point cloud from depth input. (Highlight)
datasets: ICVL; MSRA; NYU; DexYCB (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation
contribution: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation via hierarchical binary surface encoding and coarse-to-fine 3D-3D correspondence pruning without render-and-compare.

title: Holoported Characters: Real-time Free-viewpoint Rendering of Humans from Sparse RGB Cameras
contribution: Renders realistic free-viewpoint video of a clothed human in real time at 4K from only four test-time camera views plus skeletal pose, via skeleton-driven mesh capture, view-dependent texturing and image-based refinement.

title: I'M HOI: Inertia-aware Monocular Capture of 3D Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Captures human and object motion from one RGB camera plus a single object-mounted IMU, and releases IMHD2, a highly dynamic HOI dataset recorded with 32 RGB views and object IMUs with SMPL-H and object annotations.
sensing: monocular RGB plus one object-mounted IMU

title: Instance-Adaptive and Geometric-Aware Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Category-level 6D pose estimation with instance-adaptive keypoints and geometry-aware features for unseen instances.

title: Instance-aware Contrastive Learning for Occluded Human Mesh Reconstruction
contribution: Instance-aware contrastive learning for human mesh reconstruction when people are occluded by objects or other people.
datasets: 3DPW; OCHuman; CrowdPose (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: InterHandGen: Two-Hand Interaction Generation via Cascaded Reverse Diffusion
contribution: Learns a generative diffusion prior for close two-hand interaction (with or without an object) by factoring it into unconditional and conditional single-hand distributions; the prior regularizes ill-posed two-hand reconstruction.
datasets: InterHand2.6M; ARCTIC (per paper; not stated in abstract)

title: Joint Reconstruction of 3D Human and Object via Contact-Based Refinement Transformer
contribution: CONTHO jointly reconstructs 3D human and object from a single image using 3D-guided contact estimation followed by contact-based refinement of both meshes.

title: L4D-Track: Language-to-4D Modeling Towards 6-DoF Tracking and Shape Reconstruction in 3D Point Cloud Stream
contribution: Language-to-4D pre-training for real-time category-level 6-DoF pose tracking of unknown objects with simultaneous shape reconstruction from point cloud streams.

title: LEMON: Learning 3D Human-Object Interaction Relation from 2D Images
contribution: Jointly predicts human contact, object affordance and spatial relation from an image plus object geometry, and introduces the 3DIR dataset of paired images, object point clouds and 3D interaction annotations.
sensing: single RGB image plus object point cloud

title: LiveHPS: LiDAR-based Scene-level Human Pose and Shape Estimation in Free Environment
contribution: LiDAR-based scene-level human pose and shape estimation that also introduces FreeMotion, a large multi-modal multi-view dataset with calibrated LiDARs, cameras and IMUs.

title: Loose Inertial Poser: Motion Capture with IMU-attached Loose-Wear Jacket
contribution: Motion capture from four IMUs sewn into a loose-wear jacket, with simulated loose-wear training data to handle sensor-body displacement.

title: MANUS: Markerless Grasp Capture using Articulated 3D Gaussians
contribution: Markerless hand-object grasp capture that models the hand with articulated 3D Gaussians for accurate contact estimation, with the MANUS-Grasps dataset.

title: MMVP: A Multimodal MoCap Dataset with Vision and Pressure Sensors
contribution: Motion capture dataset combining RGB-D video with foot-pressure insoles to provide accurate contact and dense pressure annotations for physically plausible pose estimation.

title: MOHO: Learning Single-view Hand-held Object Reconstruction with Multi-view Occlusion-Aware Supervision
contribution: Synthetic-to-real framework that reconstructs hand-held objects from one image using multi-view occlusion-aware supervision mined from hand-object videos to handle hand-induced and self-occlusion.

title: MRC-Net: 6-DoF Pose Estimation with MultiScale Residual Correlation
contribution: Two-stage single-shot 6-DoF object pose estimation from RGB with pose classification and multi-scale residual correlation regression.

title: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints
contribution: Adds a musculoskeletal model to MANO so hand pose tracking respects biomechanical muscle and tendon constraints.

title: Mocap Everyone Everywhere: Lightweight Motion Capture With Smartwatches and a Head-Mounted Camera
contribution: Affordable full-body motion capture from two smartwatches and a head-mounted camera, using 6D head pose to resolve the ambiguity of extremely sparse multimodal inputs.

title: MorpheuS: Neural Dynamic 360deg Surface Reconstruction from Monocular RGB-D Video
contribution: Reconstructs complete 360-degree dynamic surfaces of a target from casually captured monocular RGB-D video using diffusion priors for unobserved regions.

title: MultiPhys: Multi-Person Physics-aware 3D Motion Estimation
contribution: Recovers physically plausible multi-person motion from monocular video with a physics simulator, robust to occlusion and interpenetration.

title: MultiPly: Reconstruction of Multiple People from Monocular Video in the Wild
contribution: Reconstructs multiple people in 3D from monocular in-the-wild video with layered neural representation and occlusion-aware instance segmentation.

title: NIFTY: Neural Object Interaction Fields for Guided Human Motion Synthesis
contribution: Uses neural object interaction fields to guide an object-conditioned human motion diffusion model for human-object interaction synthesis.

title: Neural Implicit Representation for Building Digital Twins of Unknown Articulated Objects
contribution: Builds digital twins of unknown articulated objects by recovering part geometry and articulation from RGB-D scans in two states.

title: Normalizing Flows on the Product Space of SO(3) Manifolds for Probabilistic Human Pose Modeling
contribution: HuProSO3 normalizing flow over products of SO(3) for probabilistic human pose modelling and uncertainty-aware pose estimation.
sensing: pose data; single RGB for conditional estimation

title: OAKINK2: A Dataset of Bimanual Hands-Object Manipulation in Complex Task Completion
contribution: Bimanual object-manipulation dataset for complex daily tasks with a three-level task abstraction (affordance, primitive, complex task) and pose annotations for body, hands and objects, plus an LLM-based complex-task-completion framework.

title: OHTA: One-shot Hand Avatar via Data-driven Implicit Priors
contribution: Creates a high-fidelity, drivable hand avatar from a single image using data-driven implicit hand priors.

title: Object Pose Estimation via the Aggregation of Diffusion Features
contribution: Aggregates Stable Diffusion features for template-based object pose estimation that generalizes to unseen objects. (Highlight)

title: Open-Vocabulary Object 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates the relative 6D pose of an object specified only by a text prompt between two RGB-D views of different scenes, without an object model. (Highlight)

title: PhysPT: Physics-aware Pretrained Transformer for Estimating Human Dynamics from Monocular Videos
contribution: Physics-aware pretrained transformer that refines kinematic monocular motion estimates and infers forces to produce physically plausible human dynamics.

title: Physics-Aware Hand-Object Interaction Denoising
contribution: Trains a hand-motion denoiser with learned grasp-credibility and manipulation-feasibility losses to make vision-tracked hand-object sequences physically plausible.

title: ProxyCap: Real-time Monocular Full-body Capture in World Space via Human-Centric Proxy-to-Motion Learning
contribution: Real-time monocular full-body capture in world space learned from a proxy dataset of 2D skeleton sequences and 3D rotational motions.

title: RAM-Avatar: Real-time Photo-Realistic Avatar from Monocular Videos with Full-body Control
contribution: Learns a real-time photorealistic full-body avatar with face and hand control from monocular video using face, hand and body templates, sparse dual attention and a lightweight StyleUnet renderer.

title: RELI11D: A Comprehensive Multimodal Human Motion Dataset and Method
contribution: Multimodal human motion dataset with RGB, LiDAR, IMU and event streams plus a fusion method for pose estimation in complex fast motion.

title: Real-Time Simulated Avatar from Head-Mounted Sensors
contribution: SimXR controls a physics-simulated humanoid avatar in real time from AR/VR headset pose and head-mounted camera images, combining headset tracking with image cues for clipped body parts.
datasets: new synthetic and real headset datasets (per paper)

title: Reconstructing Hands in 3D with Transformers
contribution: HaMeR, a large ViT-based hand mesh recovery model trained on scaled 2D/3D hand data, plus the HInt in-the-wild hand annotation set; widely used as the hand tracker in human-to-robot pipelines.

title: RoHM: Robust Human Motion Reconstruction via Diffusion
contribution: Diffusion-based motion reconstruction that decouples global trajectory and local pose denoising to recover complete, plausible motion from noisy and occluded monocular RGB(-D) observations.

title: Scaling Up Dynamic Human-Scene Interaction Modeling
contribution: Introduces TRUMANS, a large motion-capture dataset of human-scene interaction including manipulation of movable and articulated objects in replicated indoor scenes, with a diffusion-based scene- and action-aware motion generator.
sensing: optical mocap plus multi-view RGB in reconstructed indoor scenes

title: Score-Guided Diffusion for 3D Human Recovery
contribution: ScoreHMR fits a body model to image observations through score guidance in a diffusion latent space, for single-frame, multi-view and video fitting.

title: ScoreHypo: Probabilistic Human Mesh Estimation with Hypothesis Scoring
contribution: Probabilistic human mesh estimation that samples multiple mesh hypotheses and ranks them with a learned scoring model to handle ambiguity.

title: SecondPose: SE(3)-Consistent Dual-Stream Feature Fusion for Category-Level Pose Estimation
contribution: Category-level 6D pose and size estimation fusing SE(3)-consistent geometric features with DINOv2 semantic priors.

title: Single-View Scene Point Cloud Human Grasp Generation
contribution: Generates human hand grasps from single-view scene point clouds while avoiding penetration into unseen object parts, with a new dataset.

title: Single-to-Dual-View Adaptation for Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Unsupervised adaptation of a pre-trained single-view 3D hand pose estimator to arbitrarily placed dual views without camera parameters or keypoint labels; it is the baseline (S2DHand) for the HANDS 2024 AssemblyHands-S2D challenge.

title: SplattingAvatar: Realistic Real-Time Human Avatars with Mesh-Embedded Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Embeds Gaussians on a triangle mesh via barycentric coordinates and displacement so photorealistic human avatars render at over 300 FPS on a GPU and 30 FPS on a mobile device.

title: Stratified Avatar Generation from Sparse Observations
contribution: Estimates full-body AR/VR avatars from head and hand observations with a stratified scheme that first predicts the upper body and then the lower body conditioned on it, following the SMPL kinematic tree.
sensing: HMD head and hand tracking signals

title: Synergistic Global-space Camera and Human Reconstruction from Videos
contribution: SynCHMR jointly reconstructs metric-scale camera trajectory, scene and human meshes in world coordinates from monocular video.

title: TACO: Benchmarking Generalizable Bimanual Tool-ACtion-Object Understanding
contribution: Bimanual hand-object dataset with 2.5K tool-action-object sequences, 3D hand-object meshes and action labels, collected by an automatic pipeline that combines multi-view sensing with optical motion capture, plus generalization benchmarks.
sensing: 12 third-person cameras plus 1 egocentric camera, optical mocap

title: Template Free Reconstruction of Human-object Interaction with Procedural Interaction Generation
contribution: Introduces ProciGen, a procedurally generated synthetic HOI dataset with large object-shape variety, and HDM, a hierarchical diffusion model that reconstructs human and object from a single RGB image without object templates, tested on real BEHAVE data.

title: Text2HOI: Text-guided 3D Motion Generation for Hand-Object Interaction
contribution: Generates one- and two-hand object interaction sequences from text via contact-map prediction and a contact-conditioned motion generator.

title: URHand: Universal Relightable Hands
contribution: First universal relightable hand model that generalizes across views, poses, illuminations and identities and can be personalized from a few phone images.
sensing: multi-view light-stage capture; phone images for personalisation

title: WHAM: Reconstructing World-grounded Humans with Accurate 3D Motion
contribution: Recovers world-grounded 3D human mesh and global trajectory from monocular video by fusing 2D keypoint sequences with image features and a learned foot-contact-aware trajectory refiner.
sensing: monocular RGB video (optional camera gyro / SLAM)

title: Analyzing the Synthetic-to-Real Domain Gap in 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Systematically analyzes the synthetic-to-real gap for 3D hand pose estimation (forearm, image statistics, pose, object occlusion) and provides a synthesis pipeline whose synthetic data matches real-data accuracy.
datasets: introduces synthetic hand data; real benchmarks not named in abstract

title: BIGS: Bimanual Category-agnostic Interaction Reconstruction from Monocular Videos via 3D Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Reconstructs two hands and an unknown object from monocular video with 3D Gaussian splatting; it grew out of the team UVHANDS entry in the HANDS 2024 ARCTIC bimanual category-agnostic challenge.
datasets: MANO hand model; datasets not named in abstract

title: BimArt: A Unified Approach for the Synthesis of 3D Bimanual Interaction with Articulated Objects
contribution: Generates 3D bimanual hand motion for articulated-object manipulation by first generating articulation-aware contact maps from the object trajectory and using them to guide a hand motion generator.
sensing: none at inference (generative, conditioned on object trajectory)

title: Dyn-HaMR: Recovering 4D Interacting Hand Motion from a Dynamic Camera
contribution: First approach to recover 4D global motion of interacting hands from monocular in-the-wild videos taken by moving cameras, avoiding the weak-perspective camera limits of prior hand reconstruction.
sensing: monocular RGB video, dynamic (moving or egocentric) camera

title: EasyHOI: Unleashing the Power of Large Models for Reconstructing Hand-Object Interactions in the Wild
contribution: Reconstructs hand-object interactions from a single in-the-wild image by initializing hand pose and object shape with off-the-shelf foundation models (segmentation, inpainting, image-to-3D) and refining them with interaction-aware optimization.
datasets: in-the-wild images; benchmarks not named in abstract

title: EgoPressure: A Dataset for Hand Pressure and Pose Estimation in Egocentric Vision
contribution: Introduces an egocentric dataset with hand pose meshes and per-contact pressure intensities, annotated by multi-view sequence optimization over a moving egocentric camera plus static RGB-D cameras, with baselines for pressure and joint hand pose-pressure estimation.
sensing: egocentric RGB plus 7 static RGB-D (Kinect) cameras and a pressure pad for annotation

title: End-to-End HOI Reconstruction Transformer with Graph-based Encoding
contribution: Proposes HOI-TG, an end-to-end transformer with graph residual blocks that implicitly learns human-object interaction to jointly reconstruct human and object meshes and contacts from a single image.

title: FoundHand: Large-Scale Domain-Specific Learning for Controllable Hand Image Generation
contribution: Trains a 2D-keypoint-conditioned diffusion model on a new 10M-image hand dataset to generate, repose and re-view single and two-hand images.

title: GigaHands: A Massive Annotated Dataset of Bimanual Hand Activities
contribution: Introduces GigaHands, a 34-hour markerless multi-view capture of bimanual hand activities (56 subjects, 417 objects, 14k clips) with automatic 3D hand and object annotations and 84k text descriptions.
sensing: dense multi-view RGB capture (51 camera views), markerless

title: HOIGPT: Learning Long-Sequence Hand-Object Interaction with Language Models
contribution: Unifies captioning, completion and text-conditioned generation of long 3D hand-object interaction sequences with a language model over a hand-object decomposed VQ-VAE tokenizer.
sensing: none at inference (3D HOI sequences and text)

title: HOT3D: Hand and Object Tracking in 3D from Egocentric Multi-View Videos
contribution: Public egocentric dataset of 833+ minutes of multi-view video of 19 subjects handling 33 rigid objects, with mocap-based ground-truth 3D poses of hands (UmeTrack and MANO), objects and cameras; it is used in the BOP 2024 H3 track and the HANDS MegoTrack challenge.
sensing: egocentric multi-view RGB/monochrome (Project Aria, Quest 3); optical marker mocap for ground truth

title: HaWoR: World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
contribution: Reconstructs world-space hand motion from egocentric video by decoupling camera-space hand motion from a camera trajectory estimated with an adaptive egocentric SLAM, and infills hands that leave the view.

title: Hand-held Object Reconstruction from RGB Video with Dynamic Interaction
contribution: Reconstructs a rigid object manipulated by one or both hands from monocular RGB video by jointly optimizing object poses and an implicit shape, using 3D generative priors and inter-view pose-outlier voting to correct pose errors.
datasets: three HOI datasets, not named in abstract

title: HandOS: 3D Hand Reconstruction in One Stage
contribution: Builds a one-stage 3D hand reconstruction framework on a frozen detector with an interactive 2D-3D decoder, removing separate left-right classification and handling multiple hands.

title: How Do I Do That? Synthesizing 3D Hand Motion and Contacts for Everyday Interactions
contribution: Predicts 3D hand motion and contact-map trajectories from a single RGB view, action text and a 3D contact point using a VQ-VAE interaction codebook and a transformer predictor, trained on data mined from HoloAssist.

title: LatentHOI: On the Generalizable Hand Object Motion Generation with Latent Hand Diffusion
contribution: Generates hand-object interaction motion that generalizes to unseen objects by decoupling temporal motion (latent diffusion) from spatial grasping (GraspVAE), for single-hand and bimanual settings.

title: ManiVideo: Generating Hand-Object Manipulation Video with Dexterous and Generalizable Grasping
contribution: Generates temporally coherent bimanual hand-object manipulation videos from hand and object motion sequences using a multi-layer occlusion representation and Objaverse objects for generalization.
sensing: RGB video generation conditioned on 3D hand and object motion

title: ManipTrans: Efficient Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation Transfer via Residual Learning
contribution: Transfers human bimanual hand-object motions to dexterous robot hands in simulation with a pre-trained trajectory imitator plus an interaction-constrained residual module, and uses it to convert HOI datasets into robot manipulation data.
sensing: none (operates on 3D hand-object mocap sequences in simulation)
datasets: multiple hand-object datasets; produces a transferred robot-hand dataset

title: Pose-Guided Temporal Enhancement for Robust Low-Resolution Hand Reconstruction
contribution: Improves 3D hand reconstruction from low-resolution video by fusing temporal joint features with triplane visual features under pose guidance.

title: Re-HOLD: Video Hand Object Interaction Reenactment via adaptive Layout-instructed Diffusion Model
contribution: Reenacts hand-object interaction videos with a diffusion model that uses separate adaptive layout representations for hands and objects to handle varying object size and shape.

title: TASTE-Rob: Advancing Video Generation of Task-Oriented Hand-Object Interaction for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Introduces about 100k egocentric hand-object interaction videos aligned with language instructions and fine-tunes a video diffusion model with a three-stage hand pose refinement to generate demonstration videos for robot imitation.
datasets: introduces TASTE-Rob (100,856 videos); compares with Ego4D

title: UniHOPE: A Unified Approach for Hand-Only and Hand-Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates 3D hand and optional hand-held object pose in one model using a grasp-aware fusion module with an object switcher and de-occluded image pairs for robustness to object-induced hand occlusion.

title: WiLoR: End-to-end 3D Hand Localization and Reconstruction in-the-wild
contribution: Combines a real-time fully convolutional multi-hand detector with a transformer-based 3D hand reconstruction model, trained with a new 2M-image in-the-wild hand dataset.
sensing: single RGB image or video frames
datasets: introduces a 2M+ in-the-wild hand image dataset

title: Generating 6DoF Object Manipulation Trajectories from Action Description in Egocentric Vision
contribution: Extracts 6DoF object manipulation trajectories at scale from ego- and exo-centric videos and trains vision- and point-cloud-language models to generate trajectories from action descriptions, evaluated on HOT3D.
sensing: egocentric RGB video and point clouds (training data mined from ego/exo video)

title: Poly-Autoregressive Prediction for Modeling Interactions
contribution: Forecasts an ego agent's future state by autoregressively modeling token sequences of all interacting agents, applied among other tasks to object pose forecasting during hand-object interaction.
sensing: none (operates on tracked agent and pose sequences)

title: FIction: 4D Future Interaction Prediction from Video
contribution: Predicts which objects at which 3D locations a person will interact with next and the body poses for that interaction from video of the activity and the environment.

title: Reconstructing In-the-Wild Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Introduces Open3DHOI, an open-vocabulary in-the-wild 3D HOI dataset (2.5k+ images, 133 object classes, 120 actions) with an annotation pipeline, plus a Gaussian-splatting-based HOI optimizer for single-image reconstruction.
datasets: introduces Open3DHOI (2.5k+ 3D HOI assets from existing 2D HOI datasets)

title: PICO: Reconstructing 3D People In Contact with Objects
contribution: Introduces PICO-db, an in-the-wild image dataset with dense body-object contact correspondences on retrieved object meshes, and PICO-fit, a contact-guided optimization that reconstructs human and object from a single image.
datasets: introduces PICO-db (built on DAMON images); SMPL-X

title: CORE4D: A 4D Human-Object-Human Interaction Dataset for Collaborative Object REarrangement
contribution: Introduces CORE4D, a real plus synthetic 4D dataset of two people jointly rearranging category-level objects with allocentric RGB-D and egocentric views, and benchmarks for collaborative motion forecasting and interaction synthesis.
sensing: real-world multi-modal motion capture (details in paper)

title: ParaHome: Parameterizing Everyday Home Activities Towards 3D Generative Modeling of Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Builds a home capture system and the ParaHome dataset (486 minutes, 207 captures, 38 participants) of body and dexterous hand motion with multiple rigid and articulated objects, sequential and concurrent manipulation and text descriptions.
sensing: multi-view RGB (70 cameras) plus IMU suit and hand mocap gloves

title: InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Trains a single physics-based whole-body controller on hours of imperfect HOI mocap via subject-specific teacher policies that retarget and refine the data, distilled into a student policy.
datasets: multiple HOI mocap datasets, not named in abstract

title: InteractAnything: Zero-shot Human Object Interaction Synthesis via LLM Feedback and Object Affordance Parsing
contribution: Synthesizes zero-shot 3D human-object interactions from text for open-set objects using LLM relation reasoning, 2D-diffusion-based affordance parsing and pose optimization.

title: ChainHOI: Joint-based Kinematic Chain Modeling for Human-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates text-driven human-object interactions by explicitly modeling joint-level and kinematic-chain-level interactions with a graph-based generative network.

title: Guiding Human-Object Interactions with Rich Geometry and Relations
contribution: Synthesizes human-object interactions with a diffusion model guided by an interactive distance field built from boundary and detail keypoints of the object mesh.

title: Learning Physics-Based Full-Body Human Reaching and Grasping from Brief Walking References
contribution: Learns physics-based full-body reaching and grasping from brief walking mocap via active data generation and local feature alignment that transfers natural walking patterns.
datasets: brief walking mocap; not named in search result

title: SkillMimic: Learning Basketball Interaction Skills from Demonstrations
contribution: Learns multiple basketball human-object interaction skills in a single physics-based policy using a unified HOI imitation reward instead of skill-specific rewards, with two new basketball HOI datasets.
datasets: introduces two basketball HOI datasets (about 35 min)

title: Lifting Motion to the 3D World via 2D Diffusion
contribution: Estimates global 3D motion, including world trajectory, using only 2D pose sequences and multi-view-consistent 2D motion diffusion, without 3D supervision.

title: Pose Priors from Language Models
contribution: Uses a large multimodal model to derive contact constraints that regularize 3D pose optimization for two-person interactions and self-contact.

title: ClimbingCap: Multi-Modal Dataset and Method for Rock Climbing in World Coordinate
contribution: Introduces AscendMotion, a climbing motion dataset with RGB, LiDAR and IMU, and ClimbingCap, a method recovering world-coordinate climbing motion.

title: Ego4o: Egocentric Human Motion Capture and Understanding from Multi-Modal Input
contribution: Captures and describes human motion from consumer wearables (egocentric images and 1-3 sparse IMUs, optionally text) in a single multimodal framework robust to missing inputs.

title: EgoLM: Multi-Modal Language Model of Egocentric Motions
contribution: Models egocentric motion and language jointly with an LLM conditioned on egocentric video and sparse motion sensors, supporting motion tracking from sensors, narration and generation.
sensing: egocentric RGB video plus sparse wearable motion sensors

title: EnvPoser: Environment-aware Realistic Human Motion Estimation from Sparse Observations with Uncertainty Modeling
contribution: Estimates full-body motion from VR head and hand tracking signals with an uncertainty-aware multi-hypothesis stage refined by semantic and geometric constraints from a pre-scanned environment.
sensing: sparse VR tracking (head and hands) plus scanned environment

title: Estimating Body and Hand Motion in an Ego-sensed World
contribution: EgoAllo estimates world-grounded body and hand motion from a head-mounted device using a diffusion model conditioned on head pose in a canonical frame, with hand observations as guidance.
sensing: head-mounted device: egocentric SLAM poses plus egocentric images

title: FRAME: Floor-aligned Representation for Avatar Motion from Egocentric Video
contribution: Combines device pose and body-facing egocentric stereo camera feeds in a floor-aligned representation for 300 FPS avatar body pose prediction, with a large real-world ego-mounted camera dataset collected via a VR setup.
sensing: head-mounted body-facing stereo camera plus device 6D pose
datasets: introduces a real-world ego-mounted stereo dataset

title: From Sparse Signal to Smooth Motion: Real-Time Motion Generation with Rolling Prediction Models
contribution: Generates smooth real-time full-body motion for XR avatars from temporally and spatially sparse, unreliable hand-tracking inputs, switching between tracking and synthesis when inputs drop out.
sensing: sparse XR tracking signals (head and vision-based hand tracking)

title: HeatFormer: A Neural Optimizer for Multiview Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Refines SMPL parameters from multiple static views with a transformer neural optimizer based on heatmap alignment, agnostic to camera number and calibration, for room monitoring under occlusion.

title: HiPART: Hierarchical Pose AutoRegressive Transformer for Occluded 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Generates hierarchical dense 2D poses from sparse 2D keypoints with an autoregressive transformer before 2D-to-3D lifting to improve occluded 3D human pose estimation.

title: Homogeneous Dynamics Space for Heterogeneous Humans
contribution: Builds a shared dynamics space aggregating heterogeneous kinematics and dynamics data from biomechanics and reinforcement learning to support data-driven human dynamics understanding.

title: HumanMM: Global Human Motion Recovery from Multi-shot Videos
contribution: Recovers world-coordinate human motion across shot transitions in edited multi-shot videos by detecting shot changes and aligning camera and body across shots.
sensing: monocular RGB video with shot transitions

title: MEGA: Masked Generative Autoencoder for Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Formulates human mesh recovery as masked generative modeling over pose and shape tokens, giving both a single prediction and samples that express ambiguity.

title: MODA: Motion-Drift Augmentation for Inertial Human Motion Analysis
contribution: Introduces a data augmentation that simulates displacement of body-worn IMUs during motion to improve inertial human motion analysis models.
datasets: five datasets, not named in abstract

title: MV-SSM: Multi-View State Space Modeling for 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates multi-view 3D human keypoints with projective state space blocks that generalize across camera configurations and occlusion.

title: MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View mmWave Sensing for Long-Distance Self-Occluded Human Walking Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates long-distance, self-occluded human walking pose from multi-view mmWave radar and compares it with camera systems.

title: MotionPRO: Exploring the Role of Pressure in Human MoCap and Beyond
contribution: Large motion capture dataset with pressure, RGB and optical mocap, and methods showing pressure improves pose and trajectory estimation and physical plausibility.
sensing: pressure plus RGB plus optical mocap

title: Motions as Queries: One-Stage Multi-Person Holistic Human Motion Capture
contribution: Captures multi-person holistic (body, hands, face) motion from monocular video with one network in which each temporal query tracks one person's motion.

title: ODHSR: Online Dense 3D Reconstruction of Humans and Scenes from Monocular Videos
contribution: Online framework that jointly performs camera tracking, human pose estimation and 3DGS human-plus-scene reconstruction from a single in-the-wild monocular video, without pre-calibrated cameras or poses.

title: PI-HMR: Towards Robust In-bed Temporal Human Shape Reconstruction with Contact Pressure Sensing
contribution: Reconstructs temporal in-bed human shape from pressure-sensing bedsheets, with a gravity-constrained SMPLify-IB annotation method.

title: PromptHMR: Promptable Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Transformer HMR that accepts spatial and semantic prompts (boxes, masks, text, interaction cues) to resolve crowded and occluded scenes, with a video extension for world-grounded motion.

title: REWIND: Real-Time Egocentric Whole-Body Motion Diffusion with Exemplar-Based Identity Conditioning
contribution: Estimates whole-body (body and hand) motion causally and in real time from egocentric images with a one-step distilled cascaded body-hand diffusion model and identity conditioning.

title: Reconstructing Close Human Interaction with Appearance and Proxemics Reasoning
contribution: Reconstructs close two-person interactions under inter-person occlusion from in-the-wild video with a dual-branch optimization constrained by appearance, a proxemics diffusion prior and physics.

title: Reconstructing Humans with a Biomechanically Accurate Skeleton
contribution: Regresses parameters of a biomechanically accurate skeleton model from a single image, trained with iteratively refined pseudo labels, avoiding joint-limit violations.

title: SAT-HMR: Real-Time Multi-Person 3D Mesh Estimation via Scale-Adaptive Tokens
contribution: Estimates multi-person 3D meshes in real time from a single image using scale-adaptive tokens in a DETR-style one-stage network.

title: UMotion: Uncertainty-driven Human Motion Estimation from Inertial and Ultra-wideband Units
contribution: Estimates 3D human shape and pose online from six body-worn IMU plus ultra-wideband sensors with an uncertainty-driven unscented Kalman filter fusion.
sensing: sparse body-worn IMU plus UWB sensors

title: Any6D: Model-free 6D Pose Estimation of Novel Objects
contribution: Estimates 6D pose and size of unknown objects from a single RGB-D anchor image using joint object alignment and render-and-compare refinement, evaluated including hand-held objects (HO3D).
sensing: single RGB-D anchor and query images

title: CRISP: Object Pose and Shape Estimation with Test-Time Adaptation
contribution: Estimates category-agnostic object pose and shape from one RGB-D image with an active-shape-model corrector and self-training test-time adaptation.

title: ONDA-Pose: Occlusion-Aware Neural Domain Adaptation for Self-Supervised 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Adapts self-supervised 6D object pose estimation to occluded real images using a CAD-like radiance field to render synthetic images and a global pose refiner to produce pseudo labels.
datasets: three public datasets, not named in search result

title: One2Any: One-Reference 6D Pose Estimation for Any Object
contribution: Estimates relative 6DoF object pose from a single reference and a single query RGB-D image by encoding a reference object pose embedding and decoding reference object coordinates.

title: Pos3R: 6D Pose Estimation for Unseen Objects Made Easy
contribution: Estimates the 6D pose of unseen objects from a single RGB image without training by using a 3D reconstruction foundation model for template selection.

title: RefPose: Leveraging Reference Geometric Correspondences for Accurate 6D Pose Estimation of Unseen Objects
contribution: Estimates 6D pose of unseen objects from RGB using rendered reference images and geometric correspondences with correlation-volume attention in a render-and-compare loop.

title: SCFlow2: Plug-and-Play Object Pose Refiner with Shape-Constraint Scene Flow
contribution: Refines 6D object pose for novel objects without retraining by combining 3D scene flow from RGB-D frames with shape constraints in a recurrent matching network.

title: iG-6DoF: Model-free 6DoF Pose Estimation for Unseen Object via Iterative 3D Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Estimates 6DoF pose of unseen objects without a CAD model using rotation-equivariant initialization and iterative 3D Gaussian splatting render-and-compare refinement.

title: Prior-free 3D Object Tracking
contribution: Tracks 3D object pose without any given model or training prior by iteratively alternating mesh generation and pose optimization (Bidirectional Iterative Tracking).

title: Mitigating the Human-Robot Domain Discrepancy in Visual Pre-training for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Adapts visual representations pre-trained on human activity video to the robot domain with a human-robot contrastive alignment loss on paired human-robot videos.

title: MobileH2R: Learning Generalizable Human to Mobile Robot Handover Exclusively from Scalable and Diverse Synthetic Data
contribution: Learns human-to-mobile-robot handover policies purely from synthetic data by generating diverse full-body human handover motions and imitation-friendly demonstrations for 4D imitation learning.

title: VidBot: Learning Generalizable 3D Actions from In-the-Wild 2D Human Videos for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Extracts metric 3D hand trajectories from monocular RGB human videos with depth foundation models and SfM, then learns a coarse-to-fine 3D affordance model for zero-shot robot manipulation.

title: TaoAvatar: Real-Time Lifelike Full-Body Talking Avatars for Augmented Reality via 3D Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Builds a lightweight 3D Gaussian full-body talking avatar on a personalized clothed parametric template, distilled from a heavy deformation network so it runs in real time on mobile AR devices.
sensing: multi-view RGB capture for avatar creation; real-time mobile rendering

title: Real-time High-fidelity Gaussian Human Avatars with Position-based Interpolation of Spatially Distributed MLPs
contribution: Represents Gaussian human avatars with spatially distributed MLPs interpolated by position to render pose-dependent detail in real time.

title: Real-time Free-view Human Rendering from Sparse-view RGB Videos using Double Unprojected Textures
contribution: Renders free-view humans in real time at 4K from sparse-view RGB videos by disentangling template deformation from appearance using double unprojected textures.

title: RGBAvatar: Reduced Gaussian Blendshapes for Online Modeling of Head Avatars
contribution: Maps tracked 3DMM parameters to a compact learned set of Gaussian blendshapes so photorealistic head avatars can be reconstructed on the fly from video.

title: MobilePortrait: Real-Time One-Shot Neural Head Avatars on Mobile Devices
contribution: Builds a lightweight one-shot neural head avatar with mixed explicit and implicit keypoints and precomputed visual features that runs in real time on mobile devices.
sensing: single portrait image plus driving video

title: LUCAS: Layered Universal Codec Avatars
contribution: Proposes a layered universal prior model for codec head avatars that separates the hairless head and hair, with a mesh-based design for real-time on-device rendering.
sensing: multi-view capture for the universal prior

title: Vid2Avatar-Pro: Authentic Avatar from Videos in the Wild via Universal Prior
contribution: Creates animatable photorealistic avatars from monocular in-the-wild videos by fitting a universal Gaussian prior learned from large-scale multi-view performance capture.
datasets: large multi-view clothed human capture corpus (prior); SMPL

title: GBC-Splat: Generalizable Gaussian-Based Clothed Human Digitalization under Sparse RGB Cameras
contribution: Feed-forward reconstruction of complete clothed human meshes with anchored Gaussians from sparse RGB views, combining occupancy regression and disparity estimation for 6-DoF photorealistic view synthesis.

title: GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Multi-Person Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Multi-View Videos
contribution: Reconstructs geometrically consistent multi-person 2D Gaussian avatars from sparse multi-view videos while preventing inter-person penetration.

title: RePerformer: Immersive Human-centric Volumetric Videos from Playback to Photoreal Reperformance
contribution: Represents human-centric volumetric video with motion and appearance Gaussians encoded into 2D maps, supporting both playback and re-performance under new motions.

title: GAF: Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction from Monocular Videos via Multi-view Diffusion
contribution: Reconstructs animatable Gaussian head avatars from smartphone monocular video by distilling a multi-view head diffusion prior.

title: ArtHOI: Taming Foundation Models for Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Hand-Articulated-Object Interactions
contribution: Reconstructs 4D hand and articulated-object interaction from a single monocular RGB video without object templates or pre-scans by integrating and refining priors from several foundation models (adaptive sampling refinement for object scale and pose, MLLM-guided hand-object alignment).

title: Clay-to-Stone: Phase-wise 3D Gaussian Splatting for Monocular Articulated Hand-Object Manipulation Modeling
contribution: Models articulated hand-object manipulation from monocular video with a two-phase 3D Gaussian Splatting scheme: a CLAY phase for fine-grained geometric deformation and a STONE phase that enforces rigid part constraints and estimates articulation motion parameters.

title: GHOST: Fast Category-Agnostic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction from RGB Videos Using Gaussian Splatting
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that reconstructs animatable single- and bimanual hand-object interactions from a monocular RGB video using dense view-consistent Gaussian discs for hands and objects, running an order of magnitude faster than prior category-agnostic methods.

title: From 2D Alignment to 3D Plausibility: Unifying Heterogeneous 2D Priors and Penetration-Free Diffusion for Occlusion-Robust Two-Hand Reconstruction
contribution: Splits monocular two-hand reconstruction into 2D structural alignment that fuses keypoint, segmentation and depth priors from foundation models and 3D interaction alignment with a penetration-removing diffusion model using collision-gradient guidance.

title: HandX: Scaling Bimanual Motion and Interaction Generation
contribution: Assembles a bimanual motion corpus (54.2 hours, 485K fine-grained text annotations produced by kinematic feature extraction plus LLM description) and trains text-conditioned two-hand motion and interaction generation with contact prediction.
sensing: aggregated 3D hand motion capture data (no new sensor setup stated)

title: WHOLE: World-Grounded Hand-Object Lifted from Egocentric Videos
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that learns a generative prior over joint hand-object motion and guides it at test time to reconstruct world-space hand motion and 6D object pose from SLAM-localized egocentric video, including when the object is occluded or out of view.
sensing: egocentric monocular RGB video with SLAM camera poses

title: CARI4D: Category Agnostic 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction
contribution: Reconstructs metric-scale 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video for unseen object categories by selecting among foundation-model pose hypotheses, refining them with learned render-and-compare, and optimizing contacts under physical constraints.
datasets: in-distribution and unseen HOI datasets plus in-the-wild internet videos (names not stated in sources seen)

title: Recovering Physically Plausible Human-Object Interactions from Monocular Videos
contribution: Starts from a kinematic human-object estimate and refines it with a reinforcement-learning policy that reproduces the interaction in a physics simulator, removing interpenetration and object floating.

title: ReGenHOI: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation for 3D Human-Object Interaction Understanding
contribution: Bridges image-based 3D human-object reconstruction and language-driven interaction generation through a shared semantic-geometric latent space with a 3D contact reasoning mechanism.
sensing: single RGB image (reconstruction branch) and text (generation branch)

title: AnyLift: Scaling Motion Reconstruction from Internet Videos via 2D Diffusion
contribution: Synthesizes multi-view 2D motion data from internet-video keypoints and trains a camera-conditioned multi-view 2D motion diffusion model to recover world-grounded 3D human motion and human-object interaction from dynamic-camera videos.
sensing: monocular RGB internet video with dynamic camera

title: IMU-HOI: A Symbiotic Framework for Coherent Human-Object Interaction and Motion Capture via Contact-Conscious Inertial Fusion
contribution: Jointly recovers full-body pose and the 6-DoF object trajectory from sparse IMUs on the body and the object, treating hand-object contact as a probabilistic signal inferred from the IMU streams inside a three-stage fusion pipeline.
sensing: sparse body-worn IMUs plus one object IMU
datasets: three HOI benchmarks (names not stated in sources seen)

title: Glove2Hand: Synthesizing Natural Hand-Object Interaction from Multi-Modal Sensing Gloves
contribution: Translates egocentric videos of sensing-glove wearers into photorealistic bare-hand videos with a 3D Gaussian hand model and diffusion restorer, keeping synchronized tactile and IMU signals as contact and occluded-pose ground truth for bare-hand tracking and contact estimation.
sensing: egocentric RGB video with tactile and IMU sensing gloves

title: PAM: A Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for Sim-to-Real HOI Video Generation
contribution: Generates realistic hand-object interaction videos from initial and target hand poses plus object geometry and uses the synthetic videos to augment training of hand pose estimators.
sensing: simulated hand-object poses rendered to RGB video

title: Detecting Precise Hand Touch Moments in Egocentric Video
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that detects the exact frame of first hand-object contact in egocentric video and releases the TouchMoment dataset (4,021 videos, 8,456 frame-level contact annotations with 3D hand pose).

title: CoherentHand: Temporally Consistent 3D Hand Trajectory Synthesis with Semantic Motion Priors
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that forecasts and interpolates 3D hand pose trajectories without object models, using a VLM-guided residual vector-quantized motion codebook and a flow-based continuous decoder.

title: EggHand: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Egocentric Hand Pose Forecasting
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that uses full-body motion cues to forecast future 3D hand trajectories and poses in egocentric video, including when the hands are partly or fully out of view.
sensing: egocentric video plus body motion signals

title: TokenHand: Discrete Token Representation for Efficient Hand Mesh Reconstruction
contribution: Represents a 3D hand mesh with M discrete sub-structure tokens and recasts single-view hand mesh reconstruction as token classification followed by a pretrained decoder.
datasets: standard hand benchmarks (names not stated in sources seen)

title: MGDHand: Multi-Granularity Prior-to-Inertial Distillation Framework for Sequential 3D Hand Pose Estimation from Sparse IMUs
contribution: Estimates sequential 3D hand pose from sparse hand-worn IMUs by distilling static shape, dynamic pose and temporal motion priors into the inertial model.

title: PAD-Hand: Physics-Aware Diffusion for Hand Motion Recovery
contribution: Refines noisy per-frame hand pose sequences into physically plausible motion with a conditional diffusion model whose objective includes Euler-Lagrange dynamics residuals as virtual observables, also estimating physics variance.
sensing: monocular RGB video (pose sequences from image-based hand estimators)

title: ForeHOI: Feed-forward 3D Object Reconstruction from Daily Hand-Object Interaction Videos
contribution: Reconstructs the geometry of hand-occluded objects from a monocular hand-object video in under a minute with a feed-forward dual-branch diffusion model that jointly inpaints 2D object masks, completes 3D voxels and estimates object pose.

title: Enhancing Hands in 3D Whole-Body Pose Estimation with Conditional Hands Modulator
contribution: Proposes Hand4Whole++, which injects features from a frozen pretrained hand estimator into a frozen whole-body estimator through a small trainable Conditional Hands Modulator to improve hand accuracy within body context.

title: Event6D: Event-based Novel Object 6D Pose Tracking
contribution: Tracks 6D pose of unseen objects at over 120 FPS by reconstructing intensity and depth at arbitrary timestamps from events anchored on the latest depth frame and running render-and-compare updates, trained only on synthetic data.
datasets: introduces a synthetic training set and two evaluation sets

title: EgoXtreme: A Dataset for Robust Object Pose Estimation in Egocentric Views under Extreme Conditions
contribution: Provides about 1.3M egocentric frames for 6D pose estimation of manipulated objects (tools, rackets, emergency equipment) under motion blur, smoke, dynamic lighting and camera shake.

title: AlignPose: Generalizable 6D Pose Estimation via Multi-view Feature-metric Alignment
contribution: Estimates 6D pose of novel objects by aligning features across several extrinsically calibrated RGB views, without object-specific training or symmetry annotation, to reduce depth ambiguity and occlusion errors.

title: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
contribution: Estimates 6DoF pose of unseen objects without training or CAD models by building 3D concept maps from vision-language model features and matching them.

title: Ground Reaction Inertial Poser: Physics-based Human Motion Capture from Sparse IMUs and Insole Pressure Sensors
contribution: Reconstructs physically consistent full-body motion and global trajectory from four IMUs and foot-pressure insoles by driving a simulated humanoid digital twin with joint torques.

title: Ultra Diffusion Poser: Diffusion-Based Human Motion Tracking from Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ranging-based Between-sensor Distances
contribution: Conditions a diffusion pose model on IMU signals, UWB inter-sensor distances and 3D sensor positions reconstructed analytically from UWB, reducing joint position error versus prior sparse-sensor trackers.

title: VIMCAN: Visual-Inertial 3D Human Pose Estimation with Hybrid Mamba-Cross-Attention Network
contribution: Fuses RGB keypoints and wearable IMU data with a Mamba temporal model and cross-attention spatial fusion for real-time (over 60 FPS) 3D human pose estimation.

title: XR-Poser: Accurate Egocentric Human Motion Estimation for AR/VR
contribution: Estimates temporally consistent, spatially grounded egocentric body motion for AR/VR with a transformer model plus an auto-labeling system that exploits large unlabeled data.

title: FUSION: Full-body Unified Motion Prior for Body and Hands Via Diffusion
contribution: Learns a single diffusion motion prior over body and hand articulation for use in full-body motion estimation and generation.

title: Occluded Human Body Capture with Frequency Domain Denoising Prior
contribution: Treats monocular occluded motion capture as wavelet-coefficient selection, modelling occluded 2D keypoints probabilistically and refining them with a frequency-domain diffusion prior over periodicity and momentum.

title: Natural Human Motion Recovery by Aligning High-Order Temporal Dynamics from Monocular Videos
contribution: Refines monocular human motion estimates by aligning high-order temporal dynamics to address jitter, global inconsistency and scale ambiguity (reported as an oral and best-paper candidate).

title: OnlineHMR: Video-based Online World-Grounded Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Makes world-grounded human mesh recovery fully causal and streaming with a key-value cache, sliding-window training on a TRAM backbone and human-centric incremental SLAM for world alignment.

title: HumanBA: Human-Aware Bundle Adjustment via Global Human-Camera Decoupling
contribution: Recovers global human and camera motion from monocular video by subtracting the human-induced component from joint trajectories and feeding the camera-induced remainder into bundle adjustment.

title: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Provides a promptable single-image model that recovers body, hand and foot pose using the Momentum Human Rig representation, which decouples skeleton and surface shape.

title: MetricHMSR: Metric Human Mesh and Scene Recovery from Monocular Images
contribution: Recovers metric-scale human meshes and the 3D scene from one image using a bounding camera ray map for metric cues and a human mixture-of-experts to separate local pose from global translation.

title: RAM: Recover Any 3D Human Motion in-the-Wild
contribution: Combines a motion-aware tracker with adaptive Kalman filtering (SegFollow) and memory-enhanced temporal mesh recovery for real-time multi-person 3D motion reconstruction under occlusion and fast motion.

title: FisherPoser: Human Motion Estimation from Sparse Observations with Hierarchical Region-Wise Fisher-Matrix Uncertainty Modeling
contribution: Estimates full-body pose from a headset and two controllers by predicting a Matrix-Fisher distribution per joint and propagating pose and uncertainty along the kinematic chain by body region.
sensing: 3 x 6-DoF trackers (HMD plus two hand controllers)

title: Bezier Degradation Modeling for LiDAR-based Human Motion Capture
contribution: Models LiDAR point-cloud degradation with Bezier curves to make LiDAR-based human motion capture robust to sparse or corrupted observations.

title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos
contribution: Converts egocentric human videos via human-in-the-loop fingertip retargeting into 50K+ trajectories for eight dexterous hands, defines a function-actuator-aligned action space, trains a 3D VLA policy, and adds a portable RGB-D plus hand-pose capture rig.
sensing: egocentric human video; RGB-D plus hand pose capture rig (UniDex-Cap)

title: RoboWheel: A Data Engine from Real-World Human Demonstrations for Cross-Embodiment Robotic Learning
contribution: Reconstructs hand-object interaction from monocular RGB or RGB-D video, refines relative poses with an RL optimizer under contact and penetration constraints, and retargets and augments the result into training data for arms, dexterous hands and humanoids.
datasets: introduces HORA (150K trajectories, per a paper-note summary)

title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
contribution: Tracks retargeted human hand-object reference trajectories on a robot hand with a distilled generalist tracker plus a modulator that corrects the reference, object latent and positional targets to reduce embodiment bias, with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
sensing: human hand-object motion trajectories (retargeted); simulation and real robot

title: Video2Robo: 3DGS-based Synthetic Data from One Video Enables Scalable Robot Learning
contribution: Reconstructs task objects from one smartphone human demonstration video with 3D Gaussian Splatting, tracks their 6D trajectories, and has a virtual robot arm replay them under scene augmentation to synthesize robot training data.

title: Spatial-Aware VLA Pretraining through Visual-Physical Alignment from Human Videos
contribution: Extracts 3D visual and 3D action annotations from large-scale human manipulation videos to pretrain a dual-encoder VLA (VIPA-VLA) that aligns 2D vision with 3D physical space before robot policy learning.

title: Beyond Mimicry: Learning Whole-Body Human-Humanoid Interaction from Human-Human Demonstrations
contribution: Retargets human-human interaction data to human-humanoid interaction with a contact-preserving physics-aware pipeline (PAIR) and learns a hierarchical policy (D-STAR) that separates when to act from where to act.
sensing: human-human motion capture data; humanoid simulation and robot

title: Teleoperation, Simulation, or Human Video? Data Utilization Law for Robot Manipulation
contribution: CVPR 2026 Findings paper that measures exchange rates between teleoperated, simulated and human-video data for manipulation policies, reporting about 8 simulation samples per teleoperated sample and that about 10 human-video samples can cancel one teleoperated sample in-domain.
sensing: teleoperation, simulation and human video data

title: Hoi! - A Multimodal Dataset for Force-Grounded, Cross-View Articulated Manipulation
contribution: Records 3,048 sequences of people operating 381 articulated objects in 38 scenes under four embodiments (bare hand, hand with wrist camera, UMI gripper, custom force-sensing gripper) with multi-view RGB-D, pose, force and tactile streams.
sensing: multi-view RGB-D plus wrist camera, handheld gripper with force and tactile sensing

title: Ego-1K: A Large-Scale Multiview Video Dataset for Egocentric Vision
contribution: Releases nearly 1,000 short egocentric videos from a 12-camera synchronized rig around a VR headset, focused on hand motion and hand-object interaction, for dynamic 3D video synthesis and scene understanding.
sensing: 12 synchronized cameras around a VR headset (egocentric multi-view)

title: FunREC: Reconstructing Functional 3D Scenes from Egocentric Interaction Videos
contribution: Builds interactable digital twins of indoor scenes with manipulable articulated parts directly from egocentric RGB-D videos of people interacting with them.

title: HORT: Monocular Hand-held Objects Reconstruction with Transformers
contribution: Reconstructs dense 3D point clouds of hand-held objects from a single RGB image with a coarse-to-fine transformer that fuses image features with 3D hand geometry and predicts the object pose relative to the hand.
datasets: synthetic and real hand-object datasets (not named in abstract); in-the-wild images

title: MagicHOI: Leveraging 3D Priors for Accurate Hand-object Reconstruction from Short Monocular Video Clips
contribution: Reconstructs hands and template-free objects from short monocular interaction clips by using a novel-view-synthesis diffusion model as a prior for unseen object regions and aligning hand to object with visible-contact constraints.

title: Dynamic Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction with Distributed Force-aware Contact Representation
contribution: ViTaM-D reconstructs dynamic hand-object interaction, including deformable objects, by combining a visual network with distributed tactile sensing and a force-aware contact representation (DF-Field) used for refinement; introduces the simulated HOT dataset.
sensing: RGB vision plus distributed tactile sensing (glove)

title: Diffusion-based 3D Hand Motion Recovery with Intuitive Physics
contribution: Diffusion-based motion refiner trained only on mocap with intuitive-physics constraints from hand-object interaction states to improve video hand motion estimates during interactions.
datasets: existing hand-object benchmarks (not named in abstract); motion capture data for training

title: MaskHand: Generative Masked Modeling for Robust Hand Mesh Reconstruction in the Wild
contribution: MaskHand recovers 3D hand meshes from a single image by tokenizing MANO poses (VQ-MANO) and sampling them with a context-guided masked transformer, giving confidence-guided, occlusion-robust reconstructions.
datasets: standard hand benchmarks and in-the-wild data (not named in abstract)

title: Prior-aware Dynamic Temporal Modeling Framework for Sequential 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates sequential 3D hand pose with a memory of hand priors and dynamic temporal convolutions that adapt their receptive field to motion, improving accuracy and smoothness under self-occlusion.
sensing: monocular video (RGB or depth not specified in abstract)
datasets: four public hand pose datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Task-Oriented Human Grasp Synthesis via Context- and Task-Aware Diffusers
contribution: Synthesizes task-oriented human grasps with a two-stage diffusion pipeline that first predicts a scene- and task-aware contact map and then generates the MANO grasp from it; adds a new dataset and metric.
sensing: 3D object and scene geometry (synthesis, no camera input)

title: G-DexGrasp: Generalizable Dexterous Grasping Synthesis Via Part-Aware Prior Retrieval and Prior-Assisted Generation
contribution: G-DexGrasp generates dexterous hand grasps for unseen object categories and language task instructions by retrieving part-level contact and affordance priors that guide a generative model and a refinement optimization.
sensing: 3D object point cloud plus language instruction

title: AffordDexGrasp: Open-set Language-guided Dexterous Grasp with Generalizable-Instructive Affordance
contribution: AffordDexGrasp generates language-guided dexterous robot grasps for open-set object categories through an intermediate generalizable affordance representation, using flow matching for affordance and then grasp generation.
sensing: single-view object point cloud plus language; simulation and real robot
datasets: open-set table-top language-guided dexterous grasp dataset (introduced)

title: EvolvingGrasp: Evolutionary Grasp Generation via Efficient Preference Alignment
contribution: EvolvingGrasp improves a dexterous grasp generator online through hand-pose-wise preference optimization from positive and negative feedback, with a physics-aware consistency model for fast, plausible sampling.
sensing: object geometry; simulation and real robot hand

title: DexVLG: Dexterous Vision-Language-Grasp Model at Scale
contribution: DexVLG predicts language-aligned dexterous grasp poses from single-view RGB-D with a vision-language model and a flow-matching pose head, trained on the 170M-grasp DexGraspNet 3.0 dataset generated in simulation.

title: 2HandedAfforder: Learning Precise Actionable Bimanual Affordances from Human Videos
contribution: Extracts bimanual affordance masks automatically from human activity videos (the 2HANDS dataset) and trains a VLM-based predictor of left- and right-hand grasp regions, evaluated on the new ActAffordance benchmark.
datasets: 2HANDS (introduced, derived from human activity video datasets)

title: InteractAvatar: Modeling Hand-Face Interaction in Photorealistic Avatars with Deformable Gaussians
contribution: InteractAvatar builds a photorealistic animatable avatar of the hand and of non-rigid hand-face interaction using a dynamic Gaussian hand model and a hand-face interaction module learned from multi-view video.

title: Towards Explicit Exoskeleton for the Reconstruction of Complicated 3D Human Avatars
contribution: ToMiE extends the SMPL skeleton with adaptively grown external joints so that hand-held objects and loose clothing can be reconstructed and animated within a human avatar.
sensing: monocular or multi-view RGB video (avatar fitting)

title: HUMOTO: A 4D Dataset of Mocap Human Object Interactions
contribution: Releases HUMOTO, a high-fidelity mocap HOI dataset (735 sequences, 7,875 s at 30 fps, 63 objects with 72 articulated parts) with detailed hand poses, LLM-scripted multi-step tasks and a dataset-quality metric suite.
sensing: optical motion capture plus RGB cameras

title: ScoreHOI: Physically Plausible Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction via Score-Guided Diffusion
contribution: ScoreHOI reconstructs human and object pose jointly from an image by score-guided diffusion sampling with physical constraints and contact-driven iterative refinement.
datasets: standard HOI benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: Contact-Aware Amodal Completion for Human-Object Interaction via Multi-Regional Inpainting
contribution: Performs amodal completion of occluded objects in human-object interaction images with a diffusion inpainting scheme that treats contact-informed primary and secondary regions differently.

title: Human-Object Interaction from Human-Level Instructions
contribution: Synthesizes long-horizon full-body and finger-level human-object interaction from language instructions by LLM planning plus an RL tracking policy in physics simulation.

title: PrimHOI: Compositional Human-Object Interaction via Reusable Primitives
contribution: PrimHOI synthesizes complex multi-object HOI motion zero-shot by composing reusable contact primitives (grasping, clamping, supporting) defined by relative geometry with hierarchical primitive planning (also listed on the ICCV virtual site as 'Generalizable 4D Human Object Interaction Synthesis by Composing Interaction Primitives').

title: SyncDiff: Synchronized Motion Diffusion for Multi-Body Human-Object Interaction Synthesis
contribution: SyncDiff synthesizes synchronized motions for arbitrary numbers of humans, hands and objects with a diffusion model that uses alignment scores, graphical-model sampling and frequency decomposition.
datasets: five multi-body HOI datasets (not named in abstract)

title: TriDi: Trilateral Diffusion of 3D Humans, Objects, and Interactions
contribution: TriDi models the joint distribution of 3D human, object and interaction (text or contact map) with a three-way diffusion transformer, covering human-from-object, object-from-human and joint generation in one network.
sensing: none (3D generation); conditions on 3D human, object or text

title: DAViD: Modeling Dynamic Affordance of 3D Objects Using Pre-trained Video Diffusion Models
contribution: DAViD learns 4D dynamic affordance of 3D objects by generating HOI videos with a pre-trained video diffusion model, lifting them to 4D, and training LoRA-adapted human and object motion diffusion models.

title: VolumetricSMPL: A Neural Volumetric Body Model for Efficient Interactions, Contacts, and Collisions
contribution: VolumetricSMPL is a neural volumetric body model with neural blend weights that provides fast SDF queries for human-object and human-scene contact and collision handling in reconstruction and fitting.
sensing: body model (applied to in-the-wild images and egocentric data)

title: Perceiving and Acting in First-Person: A Dataset and Benchmark for Egocentric Human-Object-Human Interactions
contribution: InterVLA is an 11.4-hour human-object-human interaction dataset with 2 egocentric and 5 exocentric RGB views, mocap human and object motion and verbal commands, with benchmarks for egocentric motion estimation, interaction synthesis and prediction.
sensing: hybrid RGB plus optical mocap; 2 egocentric and 5 exocentric cameras

title: SceneMI: Motion In-betweening for Modeling Human-Scene Interaction
contribution: SceneMI performs scene-aware motion in-betweening for human-scene interaction with a diffusion model robust to noisy keyframes, and applies it to HSI reconstruction from monocular video and IMU-captured data.
sensing: keyframes from mocap, IMUs or monocular video plus scene geometry

title: HAMSt3R: Human-Aware Multi-view Stereo 3D Reconstruction
