contribution: HAMSt3R extends MASt3R for joint feed-forward reconstruction of humans and scene from sparse uncalibrated views, adding heads for person segmentation, DensePose correspondences and human-centric depth.

title: AnyBimanual: Transferring Unimanual Policy for General Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: AnyBimanual transfers a pretrained unimanual robot policy to bimanual manipulation with few bimanual demonstrations using a skill manager and visual alignment between unimanual and bimanual observations.

title: Diffusion-Based Imaginative Coordination for Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: Jointly predicts future video latents and actions with a diffusion model for robot bimanual manipulation, using unidirectional attention so action prediction can run without video generation.

title: Rethinking Bimanual Robotic Manipulation: Learning with Decoupled Interaction Framework
contribution: Learns bimanual robot manipulation with a decoupled framework that gives each arm its own model and a selective interaction module, handling both coordinated and uncoordinated tasks.

title: DexH2R: A Benchmark for Dynamic Dexterous Grasping in Human-to-Robot Handover
contribution: DexH2R is a real-world human-to-robot handover dataset on a dexterous robot hand collected via teleoperation, with a baseline method (DynamicGrasp) and benchmarks of autoregressive and diffusion policies.
sensing: rich visual sensor data (modalities not detailed in abstract) plus teleoperated dexterous robot hand

title: Humans as Checkerboards: Calibrating Camera Motion Scale for World-Coordinate Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Human as Checkerboard calibrates the scale of monocular SLAM using the absolute depth of human-scene contact joints from a human mesh recovery model, giving world-coordinate human motion without optimization.
datasets: standard world-grounded HMR benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: VOccl3D: A Video Benchmark Dataset for 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation under real Occlusions
contribution: VOccl3D is a rendered video benchmark with realistic occlusions and 3D body pose and shape annotations, used to fine-tune HPS methods (CLIFF, BEDLAM-CLIFF) and an occlusion-robust person detector.

title: Probabilistic Inertial Poser (ProbIP): Uncertainty-aware Human Motion Modeling from Sparse Inertial Sensors
contribution: ProbIP predicts full-body motion with per-joint rotational uncertainty from six or fewer IMUs using RU-Mamba blocks that output matrix Fisher distributions and progressive distribution narrowing.
datasets: multiple public IMU datasets (not named in abstract)

title: MagShield: Towards Better Robustness in Sparse Inertial Motion Capture Under Magnetic Disturbances
contribution: MagShield detects magnetic disturbances across multiple IMUs and corrects orientation errors with human motion priors, as a plug-in for sparse inertial mocap systems.
datasets: dataset released by authors (not named in abstract)

title: Contact-Aware Refinement of Human Pose Pseudo-Ground Truth via Bioimpedance Sensing
contribution: BioTUCH refines video-based 3D human pose with self-contact measured by wearable bioimpedance sensing, adding contact-aware optimization; introduces a synchronized RGB, bioimpedance and mocap dataset.
sensing: monocular RGB video plus wearable bioimpedance sensors
datasets: new RGB, bioimpedance and 3D mocap dataset (introduced)

title: GENMO: A GENeralist Model for Human MOtion
contribution: GENMO unifies human motion estimation and generation in one diffusion-regression model by treating estimation as constrained generation, enabling world-grounded motion recovery from video and multimodal generation.
sensing: monocular RGB video, plus text, audio or keyframes
datasets: in-the-wild videos with 2D annotations and text (others not named in abstract)

title: DPoser-X: Diffusion Model as Robust 3D Whole-body Human Pose Prior
contribution: DPoser-X is a diffusion-based whole-body (body, hands, face) pose prior that solves pose tasks as inverse problems with truncated timestep scheduling and masked training across part datasets.
sensing: none (pose prior applied to image-based fitting)
datasets: multiple body, hand and face benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: Head2Body: Body Pose Generation from Multi-sensory Head-mounted Inputs
contribution: Head2Body generates full-body pose from head-mounted inputs by combining a pre-trained head-IMU encoder, LVLM-segmented egocentric video features and a VQ-VAE pose token decoder.
sensing: head-mounted IMU plus egocentric RGB video

title: Bring Your Rear Cameras for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Studies rear-mounted cameras on head-mounted devices for egocentric full-body pose and proposes a transformer that refines multi-view 2D heatmaps with uncertainty; introduces Ego4View-Syn and Ego4View-RW.
sensing: egocentric multi-view (front and rear head-mounted cameras)

title: UniEgoMotion: A Unified Model for Egocentric Motion Reconstruction, Forecasting, and Generation
contribution: UniEgoMotion is a conditional motion diffusion model with a head-centric representation that reconstructs, forecasts and generates 3D body motion from egocentric images; introduces EE4D-Motion.

title: Continuous-Time Human Motion Field from Event Cameras
contribution: Predicts a continuous-time human motion field from event-camera streams with a recurrent feed-forward network queried at arbitrary times; introduces a beam-splitter event human motion dataset.
datasets: Beam-splitter Event Agile Human Motion Dataset (introduced)

title: PoseAnchor: Robust Root Position Estimation for 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: PoseAnchor adds absolute root position estimation to 3D human pose estimators with a robust least-squares regression (ITRR) that rejects noisy 2D detections, without retraining.

title: PersPose: 3D Human Pose Estimation with Perspective Encoding and Perspective Rotation
contribution: PersPose improves monocular 3D human pose estimation by encoding crop camera intrinsics (Perspective Encoding) and rotating the image to center the subject (Perspective Rotation).

title: A Structure-aware and Motion-adaptive Framework for 3D Human Pose Estimation with Mamba
contribution: SAMA lifts 2D pose sequences to 3D with a Mamba framework that integrates states along the pose topology and modulates per-joint motion dynamics.

title: AJAHR: Amputated Joint Aware 3D Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: AJAHR recovers 3D human meshes for people with limb amputations using an amputation classifier trained jointly with the mesh regressor and the synthetic Amputee 3D dataset.

title: LDPose: Towards Inclusive Human Pose Estimation for Limb-Deficient Individuals in the Wild
contribution: LDPose introduces a pose estimation dataset and task for limb-deficient individuals that also predicts residual limb endpoints, with a contrastive limb-deficient loss.

title: ProGait: A Multi-Purpose Video Dataset and Benchmark for Transfemoral Prosthesis Users
contribution: Video dataset and benchmark for vision-based gait analysis of transfemoral prosthesis users, covering prosthesis detection and gait analysis tasks for clinical rehabilitation.

title: CHROME: Clothed Human Reconstruction with Occlusion-Resilience and Multiview-Consistency from a Single Image
contribution: CHROME reconstructs occlusion-resilient, multiview-consistent clothed 3D humans from a single occluded image using a multiview diffusion model and no ground-truth geometry supervision.

title: A Plug-and-Play Physical Motion Restoration Approach for In-the-Wild High-Difficulty Motions
contribution: Refines video-based motion capture of high-difficulty motions with a mask-based motion correction module and a physics-based motion transfer module in simulation.

title: Detection, Pose Estimation and Segmentation for Multiple Bodies: Closing the Virtuous Circle
contribution: BBox-Mask-Pose iterates detection, instance segmentation and mask-conditioned pose estimation in a closed loop to improve 2D pose for overlapping people.

title: PHD: Personalized 3D Human Body Fitting with Point Diffusion
contribution: PHD calibrates a user's body shape first and then fits pose from video with a shape-conditioned point-diffusion pose prior, improving personalized 3D human mesh recovery.

title: ETCH: Generalizing Body Fitting to Clothed Humans via Equivariant Tightness
contribution: ETCH fits a body to a clothed human point cloud by estimating SE(3)-equivariant cloth-to-body tightness vectors and regressing sparse inner-body markers.

title: PoseSyn: Synthesizing Diverse 3D Pose Data from In-the-Wild 2D Data
contribution: PoseSyn synthesizes 3D pose-image training pairs around hard poses mined from in-the-wild 2D datasets using a human animation model, improving 3D pose estimators under occlusion and challenging poses.
datasets: in-the-wild 2D pose datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Generative Modeling of Shape-Dependent Self-Contact Human Poses
contribution: Introduces Goliath-SC, a 383K self-contact pose dataset with registered body shapes, and a shape-conditioned latent diffusion self-contact prior used to refine single-view pose estimation.
sensing: multi-view capture for dataset; monocular RGB for estimation

title: BoxDreamer: Dreaming Box Corners for Generalizable Object Pose Estimation
contribution: BoxDreamer estimates the pose of unseen objects from sparse reference views by predicting 2D bounding-box corners in the query view and solving PnP, remaining robust under occlusion.
sensing: monocular RGB with sparse reference views

title: CleanPose: Category-Level Object Pose Estimation via Causal Learning and Knowledge Distillation
contribution: CleanPose improves category-level object pose estimation with a front-door causal inference module and residual knowledge distillation to reduce data bias.

title: Deterministic Object Pose Confidence Region Estimation
contribution: Estimates compact 6D pose confidence regions deterministically by calibrating keypoint distributions with inductive conformal prediction and propagating them via the implicit function theorem.

title: Environment-Agnostic Pose: Generating Environment-independent Object Representations for 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: EA6D estimates 6D object pose with a diffusion model that generates environment-independent object representations robust to illumination, occlusion and clutter; adds the DiverseScenes set.

title: Joint Learning of Pose Regression and Denoising Diffusion with Score Scaling Sampling for Category-level 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Speeds up and improves category-level 6D pose estimation from depth by pre-training the encoder with a regression head, joint regression-diffusion training and time-dependent score scaling.

title: SDFit: 3D Object Pose and Shape by Fitting a Morphable SDF to a Single Image
contribution: SDFit recovers object 3D pose and shape from a single image by render-and-compare fitting of a category-level morphable SDF model.

title: Unified Category-Level Object Detection and Pose Estimation from RGB Images using 3D Prototypes
contribution: Unifies category-level object detection and 6D pose estimation from RGB in one model using neural mesh prototypes and multi-model RANSAC.

title: Multi-View 3D Point Tracking
contribution: MVTracker tracks arbitrary 3D points in dynamic scenes from a few calibrated cameras with depth by fusing multi-view features into a point cloud and applying kNN correlation with a transformer, robust to occlusion.
sensing: multi-view RGB plus sensor or estimated depth (e.g. 4 cameras)

title: Learning Precise Affordances from Egocentric Videos for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Builds an affordance system that labels precise affordances from egocentric videos without human annotation, trains a generalizable model, and uses it for tool grasping and robot-to-human handover.
sensing: egocentric RGB video; robot RGB-D for deployment

title: AR-VRM: Imitating Human Motions for Visual Robot Manipulation with Analogical Reasoning
contribution: AR-VRM pretrains a keypoint VLM to predict human hand keypoints from human action videos and maps them to robot components by analogical reasoning for visual robot manipulation.
sensing: human action RGB videos; robot cameras

title: PROGRESSOR: A Perceptually Guided Reward Estimator with Self-Supervised Online Refinement
contribution: PROGRESSOR learns a task-progress reward from egocentric human video and refines it adversarially during online RL for robot learning.

title: Precise Action-to-Video Generation Through Visual Action Prompts
contribution: Uses rendered visual skeletons of hands and robots as action prompts to fine-tune video generation models for precise action-to-video generation across HOI and dexterous robot domains.

title: GUAVA: Generalizable Upper Body 3D Gaussian Avatar
contribution: GUAVA reconstructs an animatable upper-body 3D Gaussian avatar with facial and hand expressions from a single image in about 0.1 s, using an expressive human model and tracking method, and supports real-time animation.

title: MoGA: 3D Generative Avatar Prior for Monocular Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction
contribution: MoGA reconstructs a 3D Gaussian avatar from a single image by fitting a generative avatar prior, constraining inversion to 3D-consistent avatars.

title: PERSONA: Personalized Whole-Body 3D Avatar with Pose-Driven Deformations from a Single Image
contribution: PERSONA builds a personalized animatable whole-body 3D avatar with pose-driven deformation from a single image by combining a diffusion-generated pose-rich video with 3D avatar optimization.

title: Sequential Gaussian Avatars with Hierarchical Motion Context
contribution: SeqAvatar models SMPL-driven 3D Gaussian human avatars with hierarchical coarse-to-fine motion context for non-rigid deformation, rendering in real time.

title: LHM: Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D in Seconds
contribution: LHM infers an animatable 3D Gaussian human avatar from a single image in a feed-forward multimodal transformer pass, within seconds.

title: Towards Immersive Human-X Interaction: A Real-Time Framework for Physically Plausible Motion Synthesis
contribution: Human-X synthesizes physically plausible reactive motion in real time for human-avatar, human-humanoid and human-robot interaction with an autoregressive reaction diffusion planner and an RL tracking policy, validated in a VR interface.

title: 3D Hand Pose Estimation in Everyday Egocentric Images
contribution: WildHands estimates 3D hand pose in egocentric images where objects occlude the hand. It studies crop inputs, intrinsics-aware positional encoding, auxiliary segmentation and grasp supervision, and multi-dataset training.
datasets: ARCTIC egocentric split, H2O, AssemblyHands, EPIC-KITCHENS, Ego-Exo4D

title: 3D Reconstruction of Objects in Hands without Real World 3D Supervision
contribution: Trains single-image occupancy networks for hand-held objects. Supervision comes from multiview 2D masks taken from in-the-wild hand-object videos and from synthetic shape priors, not from real 3D labels.
sensing: monocular RGB image (trained with in-the-wild video)
datasets: MOW, in-the-wild hand-object videos, synthetic shape collections

title: Benchmarks and Challenges in Pose Estimation for Egocentric Hand Interactions with Objects
contribution: Sets up the HANDS23 challenge on AssemblyHands and ARCTIC and analyses the submitted methods for egocentric hand and hand-object pose. It identifies failure cases such as fast motion, narrow-view object reconstruction and close two-hand-object contact.

title: Coarse-to-Fine Implicit Representation Learning for 3D Hand-Object Reconstruction from a Single RGB-D Image
contribution: Reconstructs a hand and the object it holds as SDFs from one RGB-D frame, in two stages: a coarse stage, then a point-aligned implicit function that uses local point-cloud geometry for fine detail.

title: D-SCo: Dual-Stream Conditional Diffusion for Monocular Hand-Held Object Reconstruction
contribution: Reconstructs hand-held objects from one RGB image with a point-cloud diffusion model. A hand-constrained step keeps the object centroid fixed, and a dual-stream denoiser models hand-object semantics and geometry.

title: Dense Hand-Object(HO) GraspNet with Full Grasping Taxonomy and Dynamics
contribution: Releases HOGraspNet, a real hand-object dataset that covers the full grasp taxonomy (99 participants). MANO and HALO hand fits from multi-view RGB-D give 3D hand and object meshes, keypoints, contact maps and grasp labels.

title: Are Synthetic Data Useful for Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Detection?
contribution: Builds a pipeline that generates synthetic egocentric hand-object images and releases the HOI-Synth benchmark. Tests synthetic data under unsupervised, semi-supervised and fully supervised domain adaptation for 2D HOI detection.

title: AttentionHand: Text-driven Controllable Hand Image Generation for 3D Hand Reconstruction in the Wild
contribution: Generates in-the-wild hand images from text, aligned with 3D hand labels and covering interacting hands, and uses them as extra training data for 3D hand mesh reconstruction.

title: 3D Hand Sequence Recovery from Real Blurry Images and Event Stream
contribution: Releases the EBH dataset of real motion-blurred hand images with event data. EBHNet recovers 3D hand sequences from blurry images, events or both, using a temporal splitter.

title: HandDAGT: A Denoising Adaptive Graph Transformer for 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates 3D hand keypoints from depth-image patches and point clouds with a graph transformer. Its attention weights kinematic against local geometric cues according to self- and object occlusion, and it uses a denoising training strategy.
datasets: four hand pose benchmarks (names not in abstract)

title: HandDGP: Camera-Space Hand Mesh Prediction with Differentiable Global Positioning
contribution: Predicts camera-space hand meshes end to end from one RGB image. A differentiable global positioning module solves the 2D-3D correspondence step, replacing the separate lifting stage.

title: MLPHand: Real Time Multi-View 3D Hand Reconstruction via MLP Modeling
contribution: Reconstructs single-hand meshes in real time from multiple views. A lightweight MLP Skeleton2Mesh model is combined with fused multi-view geometry features, cutting computation by about 90 percent.

title: Weakly-Supervised 3D Hand Reconstruction with Knowledge Prior and Uncertainty Guidance
contribution: Trains monocular 3D hand reconstruction from 2D labels only. Hand biomechanics, functional anatomy and physics enter as differentiable prior losses, and an NLL loss models image uncertainty.

title: NL2Contact: Natural Language Guided 3D Hand-Object Contact Modeling with Diffusion Model
contribution: Generates 3D hand-object contact maps from language with staged diffusion models and releases the ContactDescribe dataset. The contacts are used for grasp generation and to refine hand poses.
sensing: 3D hand and object geometry plus text (no camera input)

title: SemGrasp: Semantic Grasp Generation via Language Aligned Discretization
contribution: Generates static human grasps from language instructions. Grasps are discretized into tokens aligned with language, and a multimodal LLM is fine-tuned on the CapGrasp dataset.
sensing: object point cloud plus text (no camera input)

title: Decomposed Vector-Quantized Variational Autoencoder for Human Grasp Generation
contribution: Generates human grasps with a part-decomposed VQ-VAE that encodes hand parts separately. Decoding runs in two stages: first the grasp type, then the grasp location.
datasets: four grasp benchmarks (names not in abstract)

title: GraspXL: Generating Grasping Motions for Diverse Objects at Scale
contribution: A policy-learning framework that generates objective-driven grasping motions for more than 500k unseen objects across different hand morphologies (MANO, Allegro, Shadow), without hand-object training data.
datasets: large-scale generated grasp motions (introduced), Objaverse-scale object sets

title: On the Utility of 3D Hand Poses for Action Recognition
contribution: HandFormer recognizes hand-object actions by pairing high-frame-rate 3D hand poses, including two-hand poses, with sparsely sampled RGB frames.
sensing: 3D hand pose sequences plus RGB video (egocentric and exocentric)

title: Prompting Future Driven Diffusion Model for Hand Motion Prediction
contribution: Forecasts 3D hand skeleton motion from first- and third-person views with a prompt-based diffusion model (PromptFDDM), guided by networks that extract future and reference information.

title: Bidirectional Progressive Transformer for Interaction Intention Anticipation
contribution: Predicts future hand trajectories and object interaction hotspots jointly in egocentric video. Each prediction corrects the other through a bidirectional progressive mechanism.

title: Mitigating Perspective Distortion-induced Shape Ambiguity in Image Crops
contribution: Adds an intrinsics-aware positional encoding so that crop-based single-image 3D predictors know where the crop sits in the camera frame. One of its tests is articulated object shape prediction on the ARCTIC hand-object dataset.

title: Controllable Human-Object Interaction Synthesis
contribution: CHOIS generates synchronized full-body human and object motion with a conditional diffusion model. The inputs are a language description, initial states and sparse object waypoints in 3D scenes.
sensing: mocap-derived HOI motion data (generation, no camera input)

title: F-HOI: Toward Fine-grained Semantic-Aligned 3D Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Introduces Semantic-HOI, a dataset of fine-grained state-level text descriptions aligned with 3D HOI states and transitions, and a unified multimodal model for HOI understanding, reasoning and generation.
sensing: 3D HOI sequences plus images and text

title: HIMO: A New Benchmark for Full-Body Human Interacting with Multiple Objects
contribution: Releases HIMO, a full-body plus hand dataset of humans interacting with multiple objects at once, with text descriptions and temporal segmentation, and defines text-conditioned multi-object HOI synthesis benchmarks.

title: InterFusion: Text-Driven Generation of 3D Human-Object Interaction
contribution: Generates static 3D human-object interaction scenes from text, zero-shot. Human poses estimated from text serve as geometric priors, and generation runs in two stages, human first and then object.

title: Beyond the Contact: Discovering Comprehensive Affordance for 3D Objects from Pre-trained 2D Diffusion Models
contribution: Proposes Comprehensive Affordance (ComA), which models the distribution of human-object contact, relative orientation and proximity for a 3D object mesh. It is learned from samples produced with 2D diffusion models.

title: HSR: Holistic 3D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
contribution: Reconstructs a static scene and the dynamic humans in it, together and in one global frame, from monocular RGB video. The joint model accounts for interpenetration and occlusion between human and scene.

title: Generating Human Interaction Motions in Scenes with Text Control
contribution: TeSMo generates text-controlled human motion that reaches and interacts with objects in 3D scenes. A scene-agnostic motion diffusion model is pre-trained and then fine-tuned with scene-aware components.
datasets: large-scale mocap datasets with augmented scenes

title: Revisit Human-Scene Interaction via Space Occupancy
contribution: Treats human-scene interaction as interaction with scene occupancy, which turns motion-only mocap data into a large paired human-occupancy dataset for training interaction generation.

title: EgoBody3M: Egocentric Body Tracking on a VR Headset using a Diverse Dataset
contribution: First controller-less egocentric body tracker running in real time on a VR headset using its SLAM cameras, released with a 30-hour, 3-million-frame real egocentric body tracking dataset.

title: EgoPoseFormer: A Simple Baseline for Stereo Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates egocentric 3D body pose from stereo head-mounted cameras with a two-stage transformer. A coarse global estimate is refined DETR-style to handle joints that are self-occluded or outside the field of view.

title: EgoPoser: Robust Real-Time Egocentric Pose Estimation from Sparse and Intermittent Observations Everywhere
contribution: Estimates full-body pose from headset and intermittently tracked hand poses, independent of global position, with a SlowFast design that runs at over 600 fps.
sensing: sparse headset and hand tracking signals (VR)

title: MANIKIN: Biomechanically Accurate Neural Inverse Kinematics for Human Motion Estimation
contribution: Neural inverse kinematics for full-body pose from head and hand poses. It uses an SMPL model with biomechanical joint constraints and swivel-angle prediction to match the end effectors exactly.
sensing: sparse head and hand poses (mixed reality)

title: Nymeria: A Massive Collection of Egocentric Multi-modal Human Motion in the Wild
contribution: Releases 300 hours of in-the-wild daily motion: full-body ground truth, synchronized and localized Project Aria egocentric data (video, eye tracking, IMU), observer views and motion-language annotations.
sensing: egocentric multi-device (Aria glasses, wristbands) plus inertial mocap suit

title: AddBiomechanics Dataset: Capturing the Physics of Human Motion at Scale
contribution: Releases physically accurate human dynamics for 273 subjects (more than 70 hours, with force plates): joint torques and external forces, with baselines for estimating dynamics from motion.
sensing: optical marker mocap plus force plates

title: TRAM: Global Trajectory and Motion of 3D Humans from in-the-wild Videos
contribution: Recovers a person's metric-scale world trajectory and body motion from in-the-wild video. SLAM made robust to the moving human gives the camera and the scale, and a video transformer (VIMO) gives the body motion.

title: WHAC: World-grounded Humans and Cameras
contribution: Jointly recovers world-grounded expressive SMPL-X humans and metric camera trajectory from monocular video, and introduces the synthetic WHAC-A-Mole dataset with annotated humans and cameras.

title: COIN: Control-Inpainting Diffusion Prior for Human and Camera Motion Estimation
contribution: Separates human motion from camera motion in moving-camera video. A control-inpainting motion diffusion prior is applied through score distillation inside joint optimization.

title: PoseAugment: Generative Human Pose Data Augmentation with Physical Plausibility for IMU-based Motion Capture
contribution: Augments training data for sparse-IMU motion capture: a VAE generates poses, physical optimization makes them plausible, and IMU signals are then synthesized from them.

title: Divide and Fuse: Body Part Mesh Recovery from Partially Visible Human Images
contribution: Recovers body meshes bottom-up when the person is only partly visible or occluded. Each body part is reconstructed separately and the parts are then fused.

title: Occlusion Handling in 3D Human Pose Estimation with Perturbed Positional Encoding
contribution: PerturbPE makes graph-Laplacian positional encodings stable for GCN-based 3D pose lifting when occlusion removes skeleton edges.

title: RePOSE: 3D Human Pose Estimation via Spatio-Temporal Depth Relational Consistency
contribution: Improves video 3D pose under occlusion by supervising the relative depth ordering of keypoints across space and time rather than absolute depth.

title: UPose3D: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Human Pose Estimation with Cross-View and Temporal Cues
contribution: Multi-view 3D pose without 3D annotations: a pose compiler refines 2D keypoints using cross-view and temporal cues, together with the 2D detector's uncertainty and synthetic training data.
sensing: multi-view RGB video (any number of cameras)

title: Human Pose Recognition via Occlusion-Preserving Abstract Images
contribution: Replaces stick-figure 2D inputs with abstract images whose opaque limbs keep occlusion information, making 2D-to-3D pose lifting more robust across datasets.

title: Generating Physically Realistic and Directable Human Motions from Multi-Modal Inputs
contribution: Trains a masked humanoid controller in physics simulation that follows sparse, partial guidance, such as VR controller signals, partial keyframes or video-derived poses, and recovers from failures.
sensing: sparse VR controller signals, keypoints or video-derived poses (simulation)

title: SignAvatars: A Large-scale 3D Sign Language Holistic Motion Dataset and Benchmark
contribution: Releases a large 3D holistic (body, two hands, face) sign-language motion dataset annotated automatically from video, with a benchmark for 3D sign language production.

title: FoundPose: Unseen Object Pose Estimation with Foundation Features
contribution: Estimates the 6D pose of unseen objects from one RGB image with no training. It retrieves rendered templates and matches DINOv2 patch features to them for 2D-3D correspondences.
sensing: monocular RGB image plus object CAD model

title: Omni6DPose: A Benchmark and Model for Universal 6D Object Pose Estimation and Tracking
contribution: Releases a large real (ROPE) and simulated (SOPE) benchmark for category-level 6D object pose estimation and tracking across 149 categories, and introduces the GenPose++ baseline.

title: PACE: Pose Annotations in Cluttered Environments
contribution: Releases a real benchmark for instance- and category-level object pose in cluttered, occluded scenes (55K frames, 238 rigid and articulated objects), annotated with a calibrated 3-camera system, plus a simulated companion set (PACE-Sim).

title: SRPose: Two-view Relative Pose Estimation with Sparse Keypoints
contribution: Estimates relative camera pose or 6D object pose between two RGB images from sparse keypoints with prior-guided attention, which also serves object pose tracking.

title: Omni6D: Large-Vocabulary 3D Object Dataset for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Releases an RGB-D category-level pose dataset of 166 categories with occlusion and varied backgrounds, a symmetry-aware metric and a fine-tuning approach.

title: Controlling the World by Sleight of Hand
contribution: CosHand is an action-conditioned image diffusion model trained on unlabeled videos of hands manipulating objects. It predicts the scene after a specified hand interaction.

title: Track2Act: Predicting Point Tracks from Internet Videos enables Generalizable Robot Manipulation
contribution: Learns goal-conditioned point-track prediction from web videos of humans and robots, turns the tracks into robot actions and refines them with a residual policy learned from a few demonstrations.
datasets: web videos of humans and robots manipulating objects

title: Robo-ABC: Affordance Generalization Beyond Categories via Semantic Correspondence for Robot Manipulation
contribution: Builds a memory of contact-point affordances from human videos and transfers it to new object categories through diffusion-feature semantic correspondence for zero-shot robot manipulation.
sensing: monocular RGB human videos; robot RGB-D

title: Parameterized Quasi-Physical Simulators for Dexterous Manipulations Transfer
contribution: Transfers human dexterous hand-object manipulation to a simulated robot hand through a curriculum of parameterized quasi-physical simulators (HANDS 2024 extended abstract).

title: Expressive Whole-Body 3D Gaussian Avatar
contribution: ExAvatar learns an animatable whole-body avatar (body, hands, face) from a short monocular video by combining SMPL-X with 3D Gaussian Splatting.

title: iHuman: Instant Animatable Digital Humans From Monocular Videos
contribution: Builds animatable 3D digital humans quickly from monocular video by tying Gaussian splats to an accurate body mesh.

title: POCA: Post-training Quantization with Temporal Alignment for Codec Avatars
contribution: First post-training quantization method for Codec Avatar decoders, adding temporal alignment to avoid the temporal noise standard low-precision schemes introduce in AR/VR telepresence rendering.
sensing: headset capture for codec avatars (decoder compression)

title: Towards in-the-wild Egocentric 3D Hand-Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Introduces HOPformer, an end-to-end transformer that predicts both MANO hand meshes, object pose and object class from a single egocentric RGB image by conditioning object features on WiLoR hand priors, and releases the EPIC-Contact in-the-wild dataset with dense 3D hand-object contact correspondences.

title: GenHOI: Generalized Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Occlusion Awareness
contribution: Estimates 3D hand and object pose from a single RGB image for unseen objects under heavy occlusion by combining hierarchical textual semantic prompts, hand priors and multi-modal masked modeling over RGB, predicted point clouds and text.

title: EgoPHI: Estimating 3D Hand-Object Contact and Force from Egocentric Vision
contribution: Jointly estimates dense contact maps and 3D force distributions on hand and articulated object meshes from one monocular RGB image plus object geometry, trained with force labels from a physics-simulation augmentation of existing hand-object datasets and tested sim-to-real on instrumented physical objects.
sensing: single monocular egocentric RGB image plus known object geometry
datasets: existing hand-object datasets augmented with simulated per-vertex forces (ARCTIC referenced in code); new real dataset recorded with two force-sensing objects

title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch
contribution: Generatively reconstructs the 3D shape of a grasped object that is occluded by the hand by grounding the reconstruction in hand proprioception and multi-contact touch signals.
sensing: vision plus robot-hand proprioception and multi-contact tactile sensing

title: HandSCS: Structural Coordinate Space for Animatable Hand Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Builds animatable Gaussian-splat hand avatars in a structural coordinate space (per title; abstract not retrieved).

title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
contribution: Tracks hand motion under constraints with an adaptive control of the trade-off between motion fidelity and constraint satisfaction (per title; abstract not retrieved).

title: HO-Flow: Generalizable Hand-Object Interaction Generation with Latent Flow Matching
contribution: Generates hand-object interactions that generalize across objects using flow matching in a learned latent space (per title and session listing).

title: JointHOI: Jointly Generating Contact Maps Enhances Hand Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates hand-object interactions together with hand-object contact maps in one model so that the contact prediction guides the interaction synthesis (per title).

title: TaxoGrasp: Taxonomy-Guided Human Grasp Synthesis with Sparse Contact Constraint
contribution: Synthesizes human hand grasps conditioned on a grasp taxonomy class and sparse contact constraints (per title).

title: EgoMAN: Interaction-Structured Reasoning for Egocentric 3D Hand Trajectory Prediction
contribution: Predicts future 3D hand trajectories in egocentric interaction by reasoning over stage-aware interaction structure (approach, manipulate) together with visual observations, past motion, spatial context and intent.

title: FEEL (Force-Enhanced Egocentric Learning): A Dataset for Physical Action Understanding
contribution: Releases an egocentric dataset that pairs first-person video with force measurements for physical action understanding (oral presentation).

title: Controllable Egocentric Video Generation via Occlusion-Aware Sparse 3D Hand Joints
contribution: Generates egocentric video controlled by sparse 3D hand joint trajectories while modeling which joints are occluded.
sensing: egocentric RGB video (generation conditioned on 3D hand joints)

title: Egocentric World Model for Photorealistic Hand Object Interaction Synthesis
contribution: Builds an egocentric hand-object interaction world model that predicts photorealistic first-person rollouts from user actions alone, without privileged future object states, as a data source for embodied AI.

title: SparseCtrl-HOI: Sparse Temporal Control for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
contribution: Generates human-object interaction videos of hands manipulating objects from sparse temporal control signals instead of dense frame-wise hand-object pose sequences, with a SparseHOI-5K dataset built for training.

title: LOOM: Weaving Geometry-Consistent Human-Object Interaction Videos via Progressive Curriculum Learning
contribution: Generates human-object interaction videos with a diffusion transformer that injects multi-view 3D object information for cross-view consistency and avoids fine-grained hand mesh annotations through curriculum training.
sensing: monocular RGB video (generation) with 3D object input

title: ECHO: Ego-centric Modeling of Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Jointly recovers human pose, object motion and contact from head and wrist tracking alone using a tri-variate diffusion process with independent noise schedules, which tolerates flexible and intermittent inputs.
sensing: sparse wearable tracking (head and wrist poses from smart glasses and watches)

title: Reconstructing Humans and Objects in Interaction using Large Reconstruction Models
contribution: MILO reconstructs 3D human-object interactions from a single RGB image by using a large reconstruction model (Hunyuan3D-2.0 or SAM 3D Objects) to build a joint human-object mesh, then segmenting and fitting it without reprojection objectives or ground-truth contact.

title: Reconstructing 3D Human-Object Interaction via a Unified Triplane Space
contribution: Reconstructs a human and an arbitrarily shaped object in interaction from a single image by representing both in one shared triplane space.

title: HAT-4D: Lifting Monocular Video for 4D Multi-Object Interactions via Human-Agent Collaboration
contribution: Lifts monocular video of people interacting with multiple objects to 4D through a pipeline in which a human annotator and an AI agent collaborate (per title).

title: HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates full-body human-object interaction motion with masked token modeling, encoding human motion, object motion and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D token maps with an HOI VQ-VAE instead of iterative diffusion denoising.
sensing: none (motion generation on 3D HOI mocap data)

title: PartCHOI: Part-Aware Guidance for Clothed Human-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates human-object interactions for clothed humans with part-aware guidance (per title).

title: HSImul3R: Physics-in-the-Loop Reconstruction of Simulation-Ready Human-Scene Interactions
contribution: Reconstructs human-scene interactions with a physics simulator in the loop so the result is simulation-ready (per title).

title: WristMimic: Full-Body Humanoid Control with Wrist-Guided Manipulation
contribution: Retargets human-object interaction demonstrations to a physics-simulated humanoid by tracking body and wrist kinematically and learning finger motion only from object-trajectory and contact rewards, without finger pose targets.
sensing: motion-capture HOI demonstrations (ParaHome, OMOMO) replayed in physics simulation

title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
contribution: Jointly reconstructs the camera wearer's body and hand motion and the scene depth, camera trajectory and gaze from one monocular egocentric RGB video in a single feed-forward masked generative transformer.

title: EgoExoMoCap: Distributed Human Motion Capture via Ego- and Exocentric Body Tracking from Head-Mounted Devices
contribution: Estimates global full-body motion by fusing ego- and exocentric signals from multiple head-mounted devices (head, optionally wrist tracking, and context-aware image features) to stay robust to noise and occlusion.
sensing: head-mounted devices: head and wrist tracking plus ego and exo camera images

title: Towards Real-World Wearable Motion Reconstruction
contribution: Reconstructs human motion from wearable sensors under real-world conditions (per title; abstract not retrieved).

title: Sen-Cap: Sensor-Flexible and Noise-Resilient Human Motion Capture via LiDAR-Camera Integration
contribution: Captures human motion by fusing LiDAR and camera inputs in a way that tolerates varying sensor configurations and sensor noise (per title).

title: SynHMR: Synergistic Joint-Mesh Modeling for LiDAR-based Human Mesh Reconstruction
contribution: Reconstructs human meshes from LiDAR point clouds by modeling joints and mesh vertices jointly (per title).

title: AHOY! Animatable Humans under Occlusion from YouTube Videos with Gaussian Splatting and Video Diffusion Priors
contribution: Reconstructs complete animatable 3D Gaussian avatars from heavily occluded in-the-wild monocular video by hallucinating multi-view supervision with a fine-tuned video diffusion model and decoupling pose terms to absorb its inconsistencies.

title: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
contribution: Recovers human motion in the wild with masked flow matching that accepts flexible inputs (per title).

title: SKEL-CF: Coarse-to-Fine Biomechanical Skeleton and Surface Mesh Recovery
contribution: Estimates parameters of the anatomically grounded SKEL body model with a coarse-to-fine transformer, trained on 4DHuman data converted to SKEL alignment and with explicit camera modeling for depth and scale ambiguity.

title: Prosthesis-Aware 3D Human Pose Estimation: A Dataset and Benchmark for RSP Users
contribution: Collects RSP3D, a 3D dataset of running-specific prosthesis users captured with multi-camera marker-based motion capture, and benchmarks pose estimation that recovers both body joints and prosthesis geometry from video.
sensing: video for estimation; multi-camera marker-based mocap for ground truth

title: Fast Sam 3D Body: Accelerating SAM 3D Body for Real-Time Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Accelerates SAM 3D Body without retraining (reported up to 10.9x end-to-end speedup and much faster MHR-to-SMPL conversion) so that monocular full-body mesh recovery runs fast enough to drive humanoid teleoperation from one RGB stream.

title: EgoGVAE: Ego-body Mesh Reconstruction via Guided Variational Autoencoder
contribution: Reconstructs the camera wearer's body mesh from egocentric input with a guided variational autoencoder (per title).

title: Human Mesh Modeling for Anny Body
contribution: Presents Anny, a differentiable PyTorch body mesh model built on MakeHuman that covers body shapes from infants to elders in one topology and parameter space.

title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Builds a vision-language model that localizes task-relevant 3D human keypoints at close range and interprets users' motion commands for human-robot interaction.

title: DETRAM: End-to-end DEtection, Tracking and Recovery of HumAn Meshes
contribution: Detects, tracks and recovers 3D human meshes in one end-to-end model (per title).

title: MuCHeR: Multi-Person Camera-Centric Human Detection, Mesh Recovery and Tracking
contribution: Detects, recovers meshes for and tracks multiple people in camera-centric coordinates within one framework (per title; project page is NAVER Labs Multi-HMR 2).

title: Multi-THuMBS: Multi-person Tracking of 3D Human Meshes Beyond Video Shots
contribution: Tracks 3D meshes of multiple people across shot boundaries in edited videos (per title).

title: Point2Pose: Occlusion-Recovering 6D Pose Tracking and 3D Reconstruction for Multiple Unknown Objects Via 2D Point Trackers
contribution: Tracks 6D poses of multiple unseen rigid objects causally from RGB-D video, initialized only from sparse image points, using a 2D point tracker for long-range correspondences that recover tracking after full occlusion while building an online TSDF of each object, and adds a sim plus real multi-object dataset with mocap ground truth.
datasets: new multi-object tracking dataset (simulation with YCB objects and real sequences with motion-capture ground truth)

title: UF0-6D: Unified Flow-based Zero-Shot 6D Object Pose Estimation without Refinement
contribution: Estimates 6D pose of unseen objects zero-shot with a single flow-based model and no refinement stage (per title).

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Refines pose estimates of unseen objects from wide-angle (large) initial errors with a foundation-model refiner (per title).

title: Pose Anything Anywhere: Model-free Object Poses from Arbitrary References
contribution: PANY estimates 6D pose of unseen objects without CAD models from one or a few pose-free reference views by training multi-view geometric reasoning and cross-view correspondence end to end, for RGB or RGB-D queries.
sensing: RGB or RGB-D query image plus sparse reference images

title: Boosting 6D Object Pose Estimation via Monocular Depth Cues
contribution: Improves 6D object pose estimation by adding depth cues predicted from a monocular image (per title).
sensing: monocular RGB image with estimated depth

title: XYZ-IBD: Benchmarking Robust 6D Object Pose Estimation under Real-World Industrial Complexity
contribution: Releases an industrial bin-picking dataset of reflective parts in clutter and occlusion with millimetre-accurate 6D pose annotations and benchmarks pose and monocular depth estimation on it.

title: Geometry-Preserving Image Generation for 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Generates training images for 6D pose estimation with a generator that preserves object geometry so the pose labels stay valid (per title).

title: ObjectForesight: Predicting 3D Object Trajectories from Human Videos
contribution: Predicts future 6-DoF poses and trajectories of rigid objects from short egocentric videos of human interaction with a 3D object-centric dynamics model.

title: MessyKitchens: Contact-rich object-level 3D scene reconstruction
contribution: Provides 3D scans of 130 objects and 100 registered real cluttered scenes with accurate object contacts, and a method for physically plausible object-level scene reconstruction from a single image.
sensing: monocular RGB image (reconstruction); 3D scanning for ground truth

title: Where and What: Long-Term Object Tracking in Egocentric Videos
contribution: Tracks objects over long egocentric videos, keeping both their location and identity through manipulation and out-of-view periods (per title).

title: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos
contribution: DexWM predicts future latent environment states conditioned on dexterous actions expressed as finger keypoints from egocentric video, trained on over 900 hours of human and robot data, and transfers zero-shot to a Franka arm with an Allegro hand.
sensing: egocentric RGB video with extracted finger keypoints; robot data
datasets: over 900 hours of human egocentric and non-dexterous robot video (sources not itemized in what was seen)

title: RoboMirror: Understand Before You Imitate for Video to Humanoid Locomotion
contribution: Converts human videos into humanoid locomotion by first understanding the video and then imitating it (per title).

title: GenLCA: 3D Diffusion for Full-Body Avatars from In-the-Wild Videos
contribution: Trains a 3D diffusion model for full-body avatars using in-the-wild videos (per title).

title: FlexiAvatar: Unified 3D Gaussian Human Avatars Under Arbitrary Body Visibility
contribution: Builds 3D Gaussian human avatars that work whether the input shows the full body or only part of it (per title).

title: JacobianAvatar: Temporally Consistent Semi-rigid Avatar Reconstruction from a Monocular Video
contribution: Reconstructs temporally consistent semi-rigid avatars from a monocular video (per title).

title: Monocular Avatar Reconstruction via Cascaded Diffusion Priors and UV-Space Differentiable Shading
contribution: Reconstructs a human avatar from monocular input using cascaded diffusion priors and differentiable shading in UV space (per title).

title: Articulat3D: Reconstructing Articulated Digital Twins From Monocular Videos with Geometric and Motion Constraints
contribution: Reconstructs articulated-object digital twins from monocular videos using geometric and motion constraints (per title).

title: Hamba: Single-view 3D Hand Reconstruction with Graph-guided Bi-Scanning Mamba
contribution: Reconstructs 3D hand pose and shape from a single RGB image with a graph-guided bidirectional Mamba scan over a few joint tokens, targeting self-occlusion and hand-object occlusion.
datasets: FreiHAND and other 3D hand benchmarks (abstract names FreiHAND)

title: HOI-Swap: Swapping Objects in Videos with Hand-Object Interaction Awareness
contribution: Two-stage self-supervised diffusion video editor that swaps a hand-held object for a reference object and adjusts the hand grasp and motion so the edited hand-object interaction stays plausible.
sensing: monocular RGB video (egocentric and exocentric HOI clips)

title: Grasp as You Say: Language-guided Dexterous Grasp Generation
contribution: Builds the DexGYSNet language-guided dexterous grasp dataset via hand-object interaction retargeting to a robot hand plus LLM-assisted annotation, and a two-stage generator that produces intent-aligned dexterous grasps from language.
sensing: object point cloud plus language instruction; real-robot validation

title: Posture-Informed Muscular Force Learning for Robust Hand Pressure Estimation
contribution: PiMForce estimates whole-hand pressure during hand-object interaction by fusing 3D hand posture with forearm sEMG, and contributes a 21-participant dataset recorded with a pressure glove, sEMG armband and markerless finger tracking.
sensing: forearm sEMG armband plus markerless 3D hand tracking; pressure glove for ground truth
datasets: new multimodal hand pressure dataset (21 participants)

title: emg2pose: A Large and Diverse Benchmark for Surface Electromyographic Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: releases 370 hours of 16-channel wrist sEMG from 193 users with hand pose labels from a 26-camera mocap rig, with baselines for generalization across users, sensor placements and stages.
sensing: wrist sEMG; 26-camera motion capture for labels

title: InterDreamer: Zero-Shot Text to 3D Dynamic Human-Object Interaction
contribution: Generates text-aligned 3D dynamic human-object interaction sequences without paired text-interaction data by combining an LLM, a text-to-motion model and a learned world model of how human actions move objects.
sensing: none at inference (text-conditioned generation); trained on mocap HOI data

title: CooHOI: Learning Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Manipulated Object Dynamics
contribution: Spotlight: trains simulated humanoids to carry objects cooperatively by first learning single-agent interaction from human motion priors and then multi-agent coordination through the shared object dynamics with CTDE reinforcement learning.
datasets: human motion priors from mocap; no multi-human mocap required

title: Omnigrasp: Grasping Diverse Objects with Simulated Humanoids
contribution: Learns a controller for a simulated humanoid with dexterous hands that grasps more than 1200 objects and carries them along target trajectories, using a pretrained humanoid motion representation instead of paired body-object motion data.
sensing: physics simulation (object mesh and trajectory as input)
datasets: not stated in abstract (simulated objects; human motion representation)

title: HumanVLA: Towards Vision-Language Directed Object Rearrangement by Physical Humanoid
contribution: Distills a state-based teacher (goal-conditioned RL with adversarial motion priors) into a vision-language-action policy so a physically simulated humanoid rearranges objects from egocentric vision and language, with a new Human-in-the-Room dataset.

title: Accurate and Steady Inertial Pose Estimation through Sequence Structure Learning and Modulation
contribution: Adds a Sequence Structure Module to a spatial-temporal transformer that injects learned IMU/joint spatial structure and smoothness priors to improve accuracy and reduce jitter in sparse-IMU body pose estimation.
datasets: multiple inertial pose benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: Neural Localizer Fields for Continuous 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation
contribution: Learns a continuous field of 3D heatmap point localizers that can be queried at any body point, enabling training on heterogeneous mesh, skeleton and dense-pose datasets and fitting SMPL-family models afterwards.
datasets: 3DPW, EMDB, EHF, SSP-3D, AGORA plus many heterogeneous training sets

title: Multi-hypotheses Conditioned Point Cloud Diffusion for 3D Human Reconstruction from Occluded Images
contribution: Reconstructs detailed clothed 3D humans under human-object and human-human occlusion by conditioning a point-cloud diffusion model on multiple probabilistic SMPL hypotheses and pixel-aligned image features.

title: Di2Pose: Discrete Diffusion Model for Occluded 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Quantizes 3D poses into discrete tokens and runs a discrete diffusion process in that latent space to estimate biomechanically plausible 3D human pose under occlusion.

title: OccFusion: Rendering Occluded Humans with Generative Diffusion Priors
contribution: Renders partially occluded humans from monocular video by completing masks, optimizing 3D Gaussian humans with score-distillation supervision from 2D diffusion models, and inpainting poorly observed regions.

title: ManiPose: Manifold-Constrained Multi-Hypothesis 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Lifts 2D keypoints to multiple manifold-constrained 3D pose hypotheses with plausibility scores, without a generative model, to handle monocular depth ambiguity while keeping pose topology consistent.
datasets: real-world 3D HPE datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Toward Approaches to Scalability in 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Generates diverse plausible training poses from biomechanical range-of-motion limits (Biomechanical Pose Generator) and simplifies depth estimation to binary front/back joint decisions (Binary Depth Coordinates).

title: Dual-Diffusion for Binocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Jointly denoises 2D and 3D pose uncertainty with a diffusion model for two-view (binocular) 3D human pose estimation, with Z-embedding and baseline-width normalization.

title: Incorporating Test-Time Optimization into Training with Dual Networks for Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Meta-learns an HMR regressor whose parameters are a good starting point for per-sample test-time optimization, with a dual-network design unifying training-time and test-time objectives.

title: A Benchmark Dataset for Event-Guided Human Pose Estimation and Tracking in Extreme Conditions
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: releases EHPT-XC, a hybrid RGB plus event-camera dataset for multi-person pose estimation and tracking under low light and motion blur.

title: Pedestrian-Centric 3D Pre-collision Pose and Shape Estimation from Dashcam Perspective
contribution: Builds the PVCP dataset of pedestrian pre-collision poses from dashcam accident video and a two-stage image-to-pose, pose-to-mesh network (PPSENet) for 3D pose and shape sequences.

title: Muscles in Time: Learning to Understand Human Motion In-Depth by Simulating Muscle Activations
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: enriches existing mocap sequences with OpenSim musculoskeletal simulations to create a 9-hour, 227-subject synthetic muscle activation dataset, and benchmarks pose-to-muscle-activation estimation.
datasets: Muscles in Time / MinT (introduced, built from existing mocap datasets)

title: ContactField: Implicit Field Representation for Multi-Person Interaction Geometry
contribution: Implicit field that jointly reconstructs occupancy, instance IDs and contact for closely interacting people from multi-view images, with a synthetic multi-person interaction dataset and unsupervised contact estimation.

title: Text to Blind Motion
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: BlindWays, 3D motion of 11 blind pedestrians captured with wearable sensors on urban routes, paired with text descriptions, used to benchmark 3D human motion prediction models.
sensing: wearable motion sensors in the wild

title: Seeing Beyond the Crop: Using Language Priors for Out-of-Bounding Box Keypoint Prediction
contribution: TokenCLIPose uses keypoint-specific language embeddings to predict human and held-object (hockey stick) keypoints that fall outside the person bounding box or are occluded.

title: Codec Avatar Studio: Paired Human Captures for Complete, Driveable, and Generalizable Avatars
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: releases paired captures (256 subjects with multi-view head scans and headset camera video; 4 subjects in eight modalities including multi-view heads, hands and full body plus phone captures) with code and pretrained avatar models.
sensing: multi-view capture domes, VR headset internal cameras, phone captures

title: Expressive Gaussian Human Avatars from Monocular RGB Video
contribution: EVA builds drivable SMPL-X-based 3D Gaussian avatars with detailed hands and face from monocular video, using improved SMPL-X alignment, context-aware density control and per-pixel confidence feedback.

title: HumanSplat: Generalizable Single-Image Human Gaussian Splatting with Structure Priors
contribution: Predicts 3D Gaussian Splatting of a human from one image in a feed-forward manner by combining a multi-view diffusion model with a latent reconstruction transformer that uses human structure priors.
datasets: standard human reconstruction benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: Human-3Diffusion: Realistic Avatar Creation via Explicit 3D Consistent Diffusion Models
contribution: Couples 2D multi-view diffusion with a generative 3D Gaussian reconstruction model so each guides the other, creating 3D-consistent avatars from a single image including loose clothing and object occlusion.

title: Vision Foundation Model Enables Generalizable Object Pose Estimation
contribution: VFM-6D estimates 6D pose of unseen objects and novel categories in two stages (viewpoint estimation, then object coordinate maps) using foundation-model features lifted to 3D and trained only on synthetic data.
datasets: synthetic training data; standard 6D pose benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: EfficientCAPER: An End-to-End Framework for Fast and Robust Category-Level Articulated Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates category-level articulated object pose from a partial point cloud end to end, first posing the free part and then predicting joint parameters and states for constrained parts without post-hoc optimization.

title: TAPVid-3D: A Benchmark for Tracking Any Point in 3D
contribution: Datasets and Benchmarks track: 4000+ real videos with 3D point trajectories and metrics that jointly score 3D position and occlusion for long-range 3D point tracking from monocular video.
sensing: monocular RGB video (ground truth from existing multi-sensor footage)
datasets: TAPVid-3D (introduced from three existing data sources)

title: Reconstruction of Manipulated Garment with Guided Deformation Prior
contribution: Recovers complete 3D shapes of garments being manipulated (folded, not worn) from incomplete point clouds by fitting a diffusion-based deformation prior in the UV space of an implicit sewing-pattern model.

title: VLMimic: Vision Language Models are Visual Imitation Learner for Fine-grained Actions
contribution: Uses VLMs to ground object-centric movements in a few human videos and learn fine-grained manipulation skills as hierarchical constraints, refined iteratively for robot execution.
sensing: human demonstration RGB(-D) videos; robot cameras

title: Learning an Actionable Discrete Diffusion Policy via Large-Scale Actionless Video Pre-Training
contribution: Pre-trains a discrete diffusion model to predict future video tokens on actionless human videos and fine-tunes it with few action-labeled robot videos so imagined futures guide low-level action learning.
datasets: large-scale human videos and robot datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction
contribution: Spotlight: trains a causal transformer on sensorimotor sequences, including motion capture and YouTube human videos without actions, to control a real humanoid robot walking zero-shot.
sensing: robot proprioception; human mocap and monocular internet video as training data
datasets: policy rollouts, model-based controller data, motion capture, YouTube human videos

title: Generalizable Hand-Object Modeling from Monocular RGB Images via 3D Gaussians
contribution: Presents HOGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that reconstructs and renders hands and held objects from unconstrained monocular RGB images while disentangling geometry from lighting and motion-induced appearance changes.
datasets: two hand-object datasets (names not given in abstract)

title: SRHand: Super-Resolving Hand Images and 3D Shapes via View/Pose-aware Neural Image Representations and Explicit Meshes
contribution: Reconstructs detailed 3D hand geometry and textured hand images from low-resolution multi-view inputs by jointly optimizing a geometry-aware implicit image function with an explicit hand mesh.

title: HOI-Dyn: Learning Interaction Dynamics for Human-Object Motion Diffusion
contribution: Generates 3D whole-body human-object interaction motion by modelling HOI as a driver-responder system, training with a transformer interaction-dynamics model and a residual dynamics loss that predict how objects respond to human motion.

title: CoDA: Coordinated Diffusion Noise Optimization for Whole-Body Manipulation of Articulated Objects
contribution: Synthesizes coordinated body, left-hand, right-hand and articulated-object motion by optimizing noise across three separately trained diffusion models with a shared basis-point-set representation for precise hand-part contact.
datasets: separate body and hand motion datasets (names not given in abstract)

title: Learning to Generate Human-Human-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions
contribution: Introduces the human-human-object interaction (HHOI) generation task with a newly captured HHOI dataset and image-generation-based data synthesis, and composes text-to-HOI and text-to-HHI score-based diffusion models to generate multi-person interactions with a shared object.
sensing: newly captured multi-person HOI data (capture setup not described in abstract); generation from text

title: ToF-IP: Time-of-Flight Enhanced Sparse Inertial Poser for Real-time Human Motion Capture
contribution: Adds small Time-of-Flight distance sensors to sparse body-worn IMUs and fuses them with a node-centric transformer and dynamic spatial positional encoding for real-time full-body pose estimation with reduced drift, releasing a 208-minute IMU-ToF dataset with optical ground truth.
sensing: sparse IMUs plus wearable ToF distance sensors
datasets: 208-minute IMU-ToF dataset with optical tracking ground truth (introduced)

title: PandaPose: 3D Human Pose Lifting from a Single Image via Propagating 2D Pose Prior to 3D Anchor Space
contribution: Lifts 2D pose to 3D from a single image through a 3D anchor space with depth-aware joint feature lifting and an anchor-feature interaction decoder to reduce 2D-error propagation and self-occlusion ambiguity.

title: 3D Human Pose Estimation with Muscles
contribution: Presents MusclePose, a regression-based physics-infused 3D pose estimator from monocular video that infers joint torques via Lagrangian dynamics and muscle torque generators and predicts biomechanically grounded anthropometrics.

title: Towards Generalizable 3D Human Pose Estimation via Ensembles on Flat Loss Landscapes
contribution: Smooths the 3D human pose estimation loss landscape with an adaptive scaling mechanism and ensembles diverse solutions on it to improve cross-dataset generalization independent of architecture.

title: Unified 2D-3D Discrete Priors for Noise-Robust and Calibration-Free Multiview 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Adds a discrete VQ-style UniCodebook prior and discrete-continuous spatial attention to calibration-free multi-view 3D human pose estimation to stop noisy views from propagating errors (multi-view, adjacent to S4).
datasets: three multi-view human pose datasets (names not given in abstract)

title: RAPTR: Radar-based 3D Pose Estimation using Transformer
contribution: Estimates indoor 3D human pose from multi-view radar under weak supervision (3D boxes and 2D keypoints only) with a two-stage pose and joint decoder using pseudo-3D deformable attention, template and gravity losses.

title: OctoNet: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset for Human Activity Understanding Grounded in Motion-Captured 3D Pose Labels
contribution: Releases a 12-modality multi-view human activity dataset (RGB, depth, thermal, radar, Wi-Fi, IMU and more; 41 participants, 67.72M frames) with all modalities labelled by professional motion-capture 3D poses (Datasets and Benchmarks track).
sensing: multi-view RGB, depth, thermal, IR arrays, mmWave radar, Wi-Fi, IMU, audio; optical mocap ground truth

title: EPFL-Smart-Kitchen: An Ego-Exo Multi-Modal Dataset for Challenging Action and Motion Understanding in Video-Language Models
contribution: Records 29.7 hours of 16 people cooking with nine static RGB-D cameras, IMUs and a HoloLens 2 to provide synchronized 3D hand, body and eye kinematics with dense action labels and four benchmarks including text-to-motion and pose-based action segmentation (Datasets and Benchmarks track).
sensing: nine static RGB-D cameras, IMUs, HoloLens 2 egocentric headset

title: Intend to Move: A Multimodal Dataset for Intention-Aware Human Motion Understanding
contribution: Provides 10.1 hours of two-person 3D motion in realistic home environments with multi-view RGB-D video, 3D scene geometry and language annotations of evolving intentions, as a benchmark for intention-grounded motion modelling (Datasets and Benchmarks track).

title: RFMPose: Generative Category-level Object Pose Estimation via Riemannian Flow Matching
contribution: Formulates category-level 6D object pose estimation as Riemannian flow matching with geodesic interpolation and Riemannian optimal transport for symmetry ambiguity, with a pose-tracking extension.

title: OnlineSplatter: Pose-Free Online 3D Reconstruction for Free-Moving Objects
contribution: Reconstructs free-moving objects online from monocular RGB video as object-centric 3D Gaussians without camera pose or depth, using a dual-key memory module at constant memory and runtime.
datasets: real-world object video datasets (names not given in abstract)

title: Object-centric 3D Motion Field for Robot Learning from Human Videos
contribution: Extracts object-centric 3D motion fields from human videos with noisy depth using a denoising motion-field estimator and uses them as the action representation for zero-shot robot policy learning.
datasets: real-world robot experiments (no named dataset in abstract)

title: Touch in the Wild: Learning Fine-Grained Manipulation with a Portable Visuo-Tactile Gripper
contribution: Builds a portable handheld gripper with integrated tactile sensors for synchronized visual-tactile human demonstration collection in the wild and learns a cross-modal visuo-tactile representation for policy learning.
sensing: handheld gripper with camera and tactile sensors

title: RAPID Hand: Robust, Affordable, Perception-Integrated, Dexterous Manipulation Platfrom for Embodied Intelligence
contribution: Co-designs a low-cost 20-DoF robot hand, integrated wrist-vision, fingertip-tactile and proprioceptive perception, and a high-DoF teleoperation interface with two retargeting constraints for collecting dexterous demonstrations.
sensing: human hand teleoperation; wrist camera, fingertip tactile, proprioception

title: Compliant Residual DAgger: Improving Real-World Contact-Rich Manipulation with Human Corrections
contribution: Provides a compliance-control intervention interface for collecting gentle human delta-action corrections during policy execution and a compliant residual policy that learns from them with force feedback.
sensing: human physical corrections on a compliant robot, force sensing

title: HumanoidGen: Data Generation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation via LLM Reasoning
contribution: Automatically creates bimanual dexterous humanoid tasks and demonstrations in simulation with LLM-planned spatial constraints and MCTS-enhanced reasoning, and provides a benchmark of the generated data (robot bimanual, no human capture).

title: DexGarmentLab: Dexterous Garment Manipulation Environment with Generalizable Policy
contribution: Provides a simulation environment for bimanual dexterous garment manipulation with 15 task scenarios, generates diverse trajectories from a single expert demonstration via garment structural correspondence, and proposes the HALO hierarchical policy.

title: Grasp2Grasp: Vision-Based Dexterous Grasp Translation via Schrodinger Bridges
contribution: Transfers a grasp observed visually on a source hand to a functionally equivalent grasp on a target hand of different morphology via a Schrodinger bridge with physics-informed costs, without paired demonstrations.
sensing: visual observation of source hand grasp (simulation)

title: ESCA: Enabling Seamless Codec Avatar Execution through Algorithm and Hardware Co-Optimization for Virtual Reality
contribution: Full-stack co-design of a Codec Avatar post-training quantization method and a custom SoC accelerator so photorealistic avatar decoding runs in real time on VR head-mounted displays.

title: NoPo-Avatar: Generalizable and Animatable Avatars from Sparse Inputs without Human Poses
contribution: Reconstructs an animatable 3D human avatar from a single or sparse set of images without any camera or human pose input at test time.

title: LiteReality: Graphic-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from RGB-D Scans
contribution: Converts indoor RGB-D scans into compact, interactive, graphics-ready digital replicas by scene-graph parsing, retrieval of artist-made assets, PBR material painting and physics-engine integration.
datasets: ScanNet-style indoor scans (exact names truncated in abstract)

title: From Pose to Muscle: Multimodal Learning for Piano Hand Muscle Electromyography
contribution: Studies pose-to-EMG correspondence and introduces the PianoKPM dataset and PianoKPM Net to infer hand muscle activation from hand pose and other modalities during piano playing.
datasets: PianoKPM (introduced), a general EMG gesture dataset

title: IndEgo: A Dataset of Industrial Scenarios and Collaborative Work for Egocentric Assistants
contribution: Releases 197 hours of egocentric and 97 hours of exocentric recordings of industrial tasks, many performed collaboratively by two workers, with gaze, hand pose and point-cloud outputs and benchmarks for mistake detection and QA (Datasets and Benchmarks track).
sensing: egocentric smart glasses plus exocentric cameras

title: Don't call it privacy-preserving or human-centric pose estimation if you don't measure privacy
contribution: Argues that human pose estimation systems must define and measure privacy alongside accuracy, criticizing reliance on RGB inputs and the lack of benchmarks reflecting legal constraints (Position track).
sensing: n/a (position paper on RGB and non-RGB pose sensing)

title: SiMHand: Mining Similar Hands for Large-Scale 3D Hand Pose Pre-training
contribution: Pre-trains 3D hand pose estimators with contrastive learning on over 2M in-the-wild hand images, pairing non-identical samples with similar hand poses and weighting the loss by inter-sample distance.
sensing: monocular RGB images (hand crops from exocentric and egocentric video)

title: DICE: End-to-end Deformation Capture of Hand-Face Interactions from a Single Image
contribution: Regresses hand and face poses, contacts and non-rigid deformations jointly with a Transformer that separates local deformation fields from global mesh vertices, trained with weak supervision on in-the-wild images and running at about 20 fps.
datasets: Decaf hand-face benchmark; in-the-wild images without 3D labels

title: DexTrack: Towards Generalizable Neural Tracking Control for Dexterous Manipulation from Human References
contribution: Trains a neural controller that makes a dexterous robot hand track kinematic human-object interaction references, using a data flywheel that grows paired human-reference/robot-action demonstrations and mixes reinforcement and imitation learning.
sensing: kinematic hand-object reference trajectories (from human HOI capture) executed in physics simulation and on a real robot hand
datasets: Human-object interaction reference datasets (not named in the abstract)

title: AvatarGO: Zero-shot 4D Human-Object Interaction Generation and Animation
contribution: Generates animatable 4D human-object interaction scenes from text with a pre-trained diffusion model, using LLM-guided contact retargeting for placement and SMPL-X skinning-based motion fields for joint human-object animation with fewer penetrations.
sensing: text prompts only (no sensor input); SMPL-X body model
datasets: None introduced; zero-shot from pre-trained diffusion models

title: EgoExo-Gen: Ego-centric Video Prediction by Watching Exo-centric Videos
contribution: Predicts future egocentric frames from an exocentric video, the first ego frame and text by first forecasting cross-view hand-object interaction masks and then using them as structural guidance for a video diffusion model.
sensing: paired exocentric and egocentric RGB video
datasets: Ego-Exo4D, H2O; automatically generated pseudo HOI masks

title: Do Egocentric Video-Language Models Truly Understand Hand-Object Interactions?
contribution: Introduces EgoHOIBench to probe whether egocentric video-language models distinguish hand-object interaction verbs and nouns, and proposes the asymmetric contrastive objective EgoNCE++ with LLM-generated hard negative captions.
sensing: egocentric RGB video with text narrations

title: Modeling Fine-Grained Hand-Object Dynamics for Egocentric Video Representation Learning
contribution: Builds the HOD pipeline that uses a hand-object detector and an LLM to write narrations of hand-object dynamics, and trains EgoVideo with a lightweight motion adapter on these narrations for egocentric representation learning.

title: Weakly-Supervised Affordance Grounding Guided by Part-Level Semantic Priors
contribution: Grounds object affordance regions from human-object interaction images and egocentric object images by training on pseudo labels from an off-the-shelf part segmenter, with label refinement, fine-grained feature alignment and a lightweight reasoning module.
sensing: exocentric human-object interaction RGB images and egocentric object RGB images
datasets: Weakly supervised affordance grounding benchmarks (not named in the abstract)

title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: Pre-trains a 1.2B-parameter diffusion Transformer policy on multi-robot data through a physically interpretable unified action space and fine-tunes it on a self-collected bimanual dataset of over 6K episodes.
sensing: robot-mounted multi-view RGB cameras plus proprioception; teleoperated demonstrations
datasets: Multi-robot pre-training collection; self-created multi-task bimanual dataset (6K+ episodes, introduced)

title: VTDexManip: A Dataset and Benchmark for Visual-tactile Pretraining and Dexterous Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
contribution: Records humans manipulating 182 objects across 10 daily tasks with vision and binary tactile signals and benchmarks 18 visual-tactile pretraining variants on six dexterous reinforcement-learning tasks.
sensing: RGB video of human hands plus wearable binary tactile sensing
datasets: VTDexManip human visual-tactile dataset and benchmark (introduced)

title: Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping with Reinforcement Learning
contribution: Learns one vision-based grasping policy for several dexterous hands by acting in a universal action space of human-hand eigengrasps that is retargeted to each robot hand's joints.
sensing: simulated vision observations plus fingertip and palm positions; human-hand eigengrasp space

title: HAMSTER: Hierarchical Action Models for Open-World Robot Manipulation
contribution: Fine-tunes a high-level VLM on off-domain data such as action-free videos, sketches and simulation to output 2D end-effector paths that guide a low-level 3D-aware control policy.
sensing: single RGB image to the VLM; 3D-aware sensing for the low-level policy
datasets: Off-domain action-free video, sketch and simulation data

title: Vision Language Models are In-Context Value Learners
contribution: Estimates task progress values zero-shot by asking a VLM to order shuffled video frames, and supports in-context examples from other embodiments including human videos for dataset filtering and success detection (Spotlight).
sensing: monocular RGB video of robot and human demonstrations
datasets: 300+ real-world robot tasks across platforms, including bimanual tasks

title: Robots Pre-train Robots: Manipulation-Centric Robotic Representation from Large-Scale Robot Datasets
contribution: Measures how manipulation-centric pre-trained visual representations are and pre-trains an encoder on DROID robot data with proprioception and actions as an alternative to human-video pretraining.
sensing: robot RGB camera data with proprioceptive states and actions

title: Learning Shape-Independent Transformation via Spherical Representations for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates category-level object pose by predicting correspondences on spherical anchor representations with an attention module robust to noisy, incomplete point clouds and a hyperbolic correspondence loss.

title: CHAMP: Conformalized 3D Human Multi-Hypothesis Pose Estimators
contribution: Lifts 2D keypoint sequences to multiple 3D human pose hypotheses with a diffusion model and trains a differentiable conformal predictor end to end to score and filter hypotheses before aggregation.
datasets: Standard 3D human pose benchmarks (not named in the abstract)

title: CoMotion: Concurrent Multi-person 3D Motion
contribution: Detects and tracks detailed 3D poses of multiple people online from one camera by updating poses directly from each new frame instead of matching detections, which keeps tracks through occlusion.
datasets: Multiple image and video datasets with pseudo-labels (not named in the abstract)

title: ImDy: Human Inverse Dynamics from Imitated Observations
