contribution: Generates over 150 hours of motion with joint torques and ground reaction forces by running motion imitators in a physics simulator, and trains a data-driven inverse dynamics solver on it.
sensing: human kinematic motion sequences (mocap-derived) replayed in physics simulation

title: X-Fi: A Modality-Invariant Foundation Model for Multimodal Human Sensing
contribution: Fuses any subset of human-sensing modalities without retraining through a variable-input Transformer with an X-fusion mechanism, applied to human pose estimation and activity recognition.
sensing: six modalities including RGB, depth, LiDAR, mmWave radar and WiFi

title: RFMamba: Frequency-Aware State Space Model for RF-Based Human-Centric Perception
contribution: Processes radar echoes with a dual-branch state space model that selects informative frequency cues and spatial information for three human perception tasks.

title: Pedestrian Motion Reconstruction: A Large-scale Benchmark via Mixed Reality Rendering with Multiple Perspectives and Modalities
contribution: Builds a mixed-reality dataset of 12,138 sequences of 54 subjects interacting with 7 objects and vehicles in 12 urban settings and benchmarks pedestrian motion reconstruction across views and modalities.
sensing: multi-view, multi-modal capture on a mixed reality platform (dynamic vehicle-mounted sensors)

title: Robust-PIFu: Robust Pixel-aligned Implicit Function for 3D Human Digitalization from a Single Image
contribution: Reconstructs clothed 3D humans from occluded single images by using latent diffusion models to remove external occluders and to output layered views behind self-occlusion before pixel-aligned implicit reconstruction.

title: Locality Sensitive Avatars From Video
contribution: Learns a NeRF human avatar from monocular video by splitting the observation-to-canonical mapping into skeletal rigid motion and a graph-network non-rigid part that keeps pose information local to neighbouring body parts.
datasets: ZJU-MoCap, SynWild, ActorsHQ, MVHumanNet, outdoor videos

title: Generalizable Human Gaussians from Single-View Image
contribution: Reconstructs 3D human Gaussians from one image with a generate-then-refine pipeline that refines back views with a ControlNet and injects and iteratively corrects SMPL-X priors.
datasets: Several public human datasets (not named in the abstract)

title: LIFe-GoM: Generalizable Human Rendering with Learned Iterative Feedback Over Multi-Resolution Gaussians-on-Mesh
contribution: Reconstructs an animatable human avatar from sparse views in a single pass using iterative feedback updates of a coupled multi-resolution Gaussians-on-mesh representation for fast high-resolution rendering.

title: Agent-to-Sim: Learning Interactive Behavior Models from Casual Longitudinal Videos
contribution: Registers an agent and the camera over a month of casual smartphone RGB-D video into a persistent 4D reconstruction and trains a generative behavior model on it for real-to-sim transfer (demonstrated on animals).

title: Interaction-aware Representation Modeling With Co-Occurrence Consistency for Egocentric Hand-Object Parsing
contribution: Proposes InterFormer, a transformer that segments hands and active objects in egocentric images using contact-grounded dynamic queries, a dual-context feature selector and a co-occurrence loss that enforces physically consistent hand-object predictions.

title: EgoHandICL: Egocentric 3D Hand Reconstruction with In-Context Learning
contribution: Reconstructs 3D hand meshes from egocentric images under self-occlusion and hand-object interaction by retrieving VLM-guided exemplars and feeding them through an in-context-learning tokenizer and MAE-based architecture trained with 3D hand geometric and perceptual losses.

title: SesaHand: Enhancing 3D Hand Reconstruction via Controllable Generation with Semantic and Structural Alignment
contribution: Generates diverse synthetic hand images (with arms and interacting objects) via a controllable diffusion pipeline with chain-of-thought semantic extraction and hierarchical structural fusion, and uses them to improve 3D hand reconstruction.
datasets: generated hand images; standard 3D hand benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: UniHand: A Unified Model for Diverse Controlled 4D Hand Motion Modeling
contribution: Unifies 4D hand motion estimation and generation in one latent diffusion model that fuses MANO parameters, 2D skeletons and image features from a frozen backbone, keeping hand motion estimates stable under severe occlusion and missing frames.
sensing: monocular RGB video plus optional structured conditions (MANO, 2D keypoints)
datasets: multiple hand motion benchmarks (not named in abstract)

title: CLUTCH: Contextualized Language model for Unlocking Text-Conditioned Hand motion modelling in the wild
contribution: Builds 3D-HIW, 32K in-the-wild 3D hand-motion sequences with aligned text annotated by combining VLMs and 3D hand trackers, and trains an LLM-based text-to-hand-motion and hand-animation captioning model with a dedicated VQ-VAE hand tokenizer.
sensing: monocular in-the-wild RGB video (for dataset construction); text

title: EgoWorld: Translating Exocentric View to Egocentric View using Rich Exocentric Observations
contribution: Synthesizes an egocentric view of a hand-object interaction from a single exocentric image by lifting estimated depth to a point cloud, reprojecting it with 3D hand poses, and completing the egocentric image with a text-conditioned diffusion model.
sensing: single exocentric RGB with estimated depth and 3D hand pose

title: H2OFlow: Grounding Human-Object Affordances with 3D Generative Models and Dense Diffused Flows
contribution: Learns 3D human-object affordances (contact, orientation and spatial occupancy) from synthetic interactions produced by 3D generative models, using a dense 3D flow representation learned by diffusion on object point clouds.
sensing: object point clouds; synthetic human-object data
datasets: synthetic data from 3D generative models; evaluation on real objects

title: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video
contribution: Releases 829 hours of egocentric video recorded with Apple Vision Pro with paired on-device 3D tracking of every joint of both hands across 194 household manipulation tasks, and benchmarks imitation policies for hand trajectory prediction on it.
sensing: egocentric multi-camera headset (Apple Vision Pro) with on-device SLAM and hand tracking

title: Unleashing Guidance Without Classifiers for Human-Object Interaction Animation
contribution: Generates whole-body human-object interaction animation with diffusion forcing in which human and object components get asynchronous noise schedules so cleaner components guide noisier ones, producing contact-aware guidance without hand-crafted contact priors or classifiers.
sensing: 3D human and object motion data (no image input)
datasets: HOI motion datasets (not named in abstract) plus synthetic object geometries

title: Human-Object Interaction via Automatically Designed VLM-Guided Motion Policy
contribution: Synthesizes long-horizon physics-based human-object interactions with static, dynamic and articulated objects by having a VLM construct goal states and rewards through a part-level relative movement dynamics representation for reinforcement learning, and introduces the Interplay dataset of interaction plans.

title: InfBaGel: Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation with Dynamic Perception and Iterative Refinement
contribution: Generates instruction-conditioned human-object-scene interactions with a coarse-to-fine consistency model that updates scene context from preceding refinement trajectories and applies bump-aware guidance to reduce collisions and penetrations.
sensing: 3D motion and scene data (no image input)
datasets: HOI/HSI motion datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Contact-guided Real2Sim from Monocular Video with Planar Scene Primitives
contribution: CRISP recovers simulatable human motion and scene geometry from monocular video by fitting convex planar primitives to a depth-based point cloud, completing occluded scene parts from human-scene contact, and validating both with an RL humanoid controller.
sensing: monocular RGB video with estimated depth

title: Human3R: Everyone Everywhere All at Once
contribution: Jointly recovers world-frame multi-person SMPL-X bodies, dense scene geometry and camera trajectory online in a single forward pass from monocular video by prompt-tuning the CUT3R 4D reconstruction model.

title: Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud-based Human Motion Capture
contribution: Introduces a structured representation combining skeletal joints and surface anchors with kinematic-geometric factorization, learned by SparkleMotion, for human motion capture from noisy point clouds with robustness to occlusion and sensor domain shift.
sensing: point clouds from depth or LiDAR sensors (multiple sensor types)
datasets: multiple point-cloud mocap datasets (not named in abstract)

title: QuaMo: Quaternion Motions for Vision-based 3D Human Kinematics Capture
contribution: Captures 3D human kinematics from video by modeling pose transitions with quaternion differential equations instead of Euler angles, avoiding discontinuities and giving smoother online motion reconstruction.

title: Zero-shot Human Pose Estimation using Diffusion-based Inverse solvers
contribution: InPose estimates full-body pose from a few on-body sensors by conditioning a pretrained diffusion model on rotations only and guiding sampling with a likelihood term from measured locations, so it generalizes across users of different body size without retraining.
sensing: sparse wearable sensors (location and rotation, e.g. head and wrist trackers)

title: From Sparse to Dense: Spatio-Temporal Fusion for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation with DenseWarper
contribution: Estimates 3D human pose from sparse interleaved multi-view frames captured at different times, fusing them with epipolar-guided warping to raise the output frame rate by the number of cameras.

title: InclusiveVidPose: Bridging the Pose Estimation Gap for Individuals with Limb Deficiencies in Video-Based Motion
contribution: Releases a video pose dataset of about 400 people with amputations, congenital limb differences or prostheses (313 videos, 327k frames) with residual-limb keypoints, masks and prosthesis labels, plus a limb-specific confidence consistency metric and a benchmark of existing pose estimators.

title: Sapiens2
contribution: Trains a family of 0.4B-5B high-resolution human-centric vision transformers on 1 billion human images with combined masked reconstruction and contrastive objectives, and post-trains them for dense human tasks including pose estimation and segmentation.
datasets: 1B curated human images (pretraining); human pose and segmentation benchmarks

title: D-REX: Differentiable Real-to-Sim-to-Real Engine for Learning Dexterous Grasping
contribution: Builds a Gaussian-splat differentiable real-to-sim engine that identifies object mass from real visual observations and robot signals, and converts human demonstrations into simulated robot demonstrations to train force-aware dexterous grasping policies.
sensing: RGB video of real scenes and human demonstrations; robot control signals

title: VLBiMan: Vision-Language Anchored One-Shot Demonstration Enables Generalizable Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Derives reusable bimanual skills from a single human demonstration by decomposing it into invariant anchor primitives and adjustable components that are re-grounded with vision-language models, transferring to new scenes, objects and robot embodiments without retraining.
sensing: single human demonstration plus robot RGB(-D) observation
datasets: own real-world bimanual tool-use and multi-object tasks

title: MoMaGen: Generating Demonstrations under Soft and Hard Constraints for Multi-Step Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
contribution: Augments a few human teleoperated demonstrations of multi-step bimanual mobile manipulation into large simulated datasets by solving base placement and camera visibility as soft and hard constraints during data generation.

title: DexMove: Learning Tactile-Guided Non-Prehensile Manipulation with Dexterous Hands
contribution: Combines simulated wrist-finger trajectories with a wearable device that records multi-finger contact from human demonstrations via vision-based tactile sensors, and trains a flow-based policy for tactile-guided non-prehensile manipulation with a dexterous robot hand.
sensing: wearable vision-based tactile sensors on the human hand; simulation
datasets: own human tactile demonstrations and simulated trajectories

title: ViPRA: Video Prediction for Robot Actions
contribution: Pretrains a video-language model on actionless human and robot videos to predict future frames and motion-centric latent actions, then maps the latent actions to continuous robot control with a small amount of labelled data.

title: Robotic Manipulation by Imitating Generated Videos Without Physical Demonstrations
contribution: RIGVid generates demonstration videos with a video diffusion model, filters them with a VLM, extracts object trajectories with a 6D object pose tracker, and retargets them to a robot to perform tasks such as pouring and wiping.
sensing: RGB-D initial scene image; generated monocular video

title: WholeBodyVLA: Towards Unified Latent VLA for Whole-body Loco-manipulation Control
contribution: Learns humanoid loco-manipulation from low-cost action-free egocentric videos through unified latent action learning, paired with a loco-manipulation-oriented RL controller, and evaluates on the AgiBot X2 humanoid.

title: Articulation in Motion: Prior-free Part Mobility Analysis for Articulated Objects By Dynamic-Static Disentanglement
contribution: AiM reconstructs an interactive articulated 3D digital replica from a start-state 3DGS scan plus a video of a user moving the object's parts, segmenting parts from motion cues and estimating joints with sequential RANSAC without part-structure priors.
sensing: multi-view scan plus monocular user-object interaction video

title: BANZ-FS: BANZSL Fingerspelling Dataset
contribution: Releases over 35,000 annotated two-handed BANZSL fingerspelling instances from broadcasts, lab recordings and vlogs, and benchmarks detection and recognition models on challenges such as hand self-occlusion and coarticulation.

title: Dynamic Texture Modeling of 3D Clothed Gaussian Avatars from a Single Video
contribution: Models dynamic appearance of loose garments in animatable 3D Gaussian avatars built from a single monocular video, addressing limited Gaussian deformation under template articulation.

title: FastAvatar: Towards Unified and Fast 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Large Gaussian Reconstruction Transformers
contribution: Reconstructs a 3D Gaussian avatar within seconds from a single image, multi-view images or monocular video with one feed-forward large Gaussian reconstruction transformer.
sensing: single RGB image, multi-view images or monocular RGB video

title: FastGHA: Generalized Few-Shot 3D Gaussian Head Avatars with Real-Time Animation
contribution: Builds animatable Gaussian head avatars feed-forward from a few input images with per-pixel Gaussian prediction, supporting real-time animation without per-identity optimization.

title: UP2You: Fast Reconstruction of Yourself from Unconstrained Photo Collections
contribution: Reconstructs a 3D clothed human from unconstrained in-the-wild photo collections without tuning, using a data rectifier that converts occluded, cropped and varied-pose photos into clean multi-view inputs.

title: Direct Reward Fine-Tuning on Poses for Single Image to 3D Human in the Wild
contribution: DrPose post-trains a multi-view diffusion model for single-image 3D human reconstruction with a differentiable pose-consistency reward, using only pose-image pairs to improve reconstructions of dynamic or challenging poses.
datasets: human pose-image pairs (not named in abstract)

title: Ultra Inertial Poser: Scalable Motion Capture and Tracking from Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ultra-Wideband Ranging
contribution: Estimates SMPL full-body pose and global translation from six wearable IMU+UWB trackers by fusing per-sensor 3D states with UWB inter-sensor distances in a graph-based network, reducing drift and jitter relative to PIP and TIP.
sensing: 6 wearable IMUs augmented with ultra-wideband ranging (sparse body-worn sensors), no cameras
datasets: AMASS (synthesized IMU and distances for training), DIP-IMU, TotalCapture; introduces UIP-DB (10 participants, 25 motion types, 200 min with optical mocap ground truth)

title: Physical Non-inertial Poser (PNP): Modeling Non-inertial Effects in Sparse-inertial Human Motion Capture
contribution: Models the non-inertial (fictitious-force) effects of the moving body frame in sparse-IMU motion capture and combines learned pose estimation with a physics-based body model to improve pose and global translation estimates (SIGGRAPH 2024 Conference Papers).

title: Spatial and Surface Correspondence Field for Interaction Transfer
contribution: Learns a spatial and surface correspondence field between objects of a category so that a given human-object or hand-object interaction (SMPL-X body with chairs, MANO hand with mugs) can be transferred to new object shapes.
sensing: 3D meshes and parametric body/hand models (no live sensing)
datasets: ShapeNet objects; processed human-chair and hand-mug interaction data released with the code

title: Categorical Codebook Matching for Embodied Character Controllers
contribution: Maps sparse real-time sensor signals (e.g. VR headset and controllers) to full-body avatar motion by matching categorical codebooks for inputs and outputs, learning the motion manifold and how to sample it end to end (ACM TOG 43(4), Article 142).
sensing: sparse VR tracking signals (head and hand devices)
datasets: unstructured motion capture data; releases the Cranberry dataset

title: Hand-Object Interaction Controller (HOIC): Deep Reinforcement Learning for Reconstructing Interactions with Physics
contribution: Trains a deep reinforcement learning controller in the MuJoCo simulator that tracks estimated hand-object motion to reconstruct physically plausible hand-object interactions with a rigid object.
sensing: single depth camera recordings (released sample data is named SingleDepth; Banana, Bottle, Box objects)
datasets: own single-depth hand-object sequences (Banana, Bottle, Box) released with the code

title: NICER: A New and Improved Consumed Endurance and Recovery Metric to Quantify Muscle Fatigue of Mid-Air Interactions
contribution: Defines an arm-motion-based metric that estimates shoulder muscle fatigue and recovery during mid-air (VR/AR) interaction; a borderline upper-limb motion-analysis entry rather than a capture method.
sensing: tracked arm motion during mid-air interaction (VR/AR tracking); exact setup not confirmed

title: VR-GS: A Physical Dynamics-Aware Interactive Gaussian Splatting System in Virtual Reality
contribution: Builds an interactive VR system in which Gaussian-splatting reconstructions of real scenes and objects act as physically simulated digital twins that users can manipulate in real time; borderline S7 entry (SIGGRAPH 2024 Conference Papers).
sensing: multi-view images for Gaussian splatting reconstruction; VR headset and controller interaction

title: Kinematic Motion Retargeting for Contact-Rich Anthropomorphic Manipulations
contribution: Retargets contact-rich hand-object manipulation sequences between differently shaped anthropomorphic hands by transferring contact areas through non-isometric shape matching and then synthesizing the target motion with an IK-based pipeline.
sensing: Kinematic input: captured hand-object manipulation motion sequences (no live sensing); output for arbitrary anthropomorphic hand models
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen; retargeted results and hand assets released via the code repository

title: Transformer IMU Calibrator: Dynamic On-body IMU Calibration for Inertial Motion Capture
contribution: Uses a transformer to estimate and remove non-static IMU drift and sensor-to-body offsets during use, so that sparse inertial motion capture needs no T-pose or heading reset and stays robust over long sessions; the repository lists it as a SIGGRAPH 2025 best paper.
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: Improving Global Motion Estimation in Sparse IMU-based Motion Capture with Physics
contribution: Adds 3D contact modeling and gravity awareness to physics-based sparse-IMU capture, estimating world-aligned body motion, contact points, contact forces, joint torques and proxy-surface interactions in real time from six IMUs.
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: HOIGaze: Gaze Estimation During Hand-Object Interactions in Extended Reality Exploiting Eye-Hand-Head Coordination
contribution: Estimates eye gaze during hand-object interaction in XR. It first identifies which hand is visually attended, then fuses head features with hand-object features from a CNN and a spatio-temporal GCN using cross-modal transformers, and trains with an eye-head coordination loss that up-weights coordinated samples.
sensing: Egocentric XR head-mounted device signals: head pose plus hand and object motion features

title: ForceGrip: Reference-Free Curriculum Learning for Realistic Grip Force Control in VR Hand Manipulation
contribution: Trains a reinforcement-learning hand agent in physics simulation with a three-stage curriculum (finger positioning, intention adaptation, dynamic stabilization). The agent converts VR controller input into grip forces on grasped virtual objects without reference motion data.
sensing: VR controller input (Meta Quest) driving a physically simulated hand
datasets: None (reference-free training in simulation); user study

title: SkillMimic-V2: Learning Robust and Generalizable Interaction Skills from Sparse and Noisy Demonstrations
contribution: Learns physics-based human-object interaction skills, such as ball play, from a few noisy demonstrations. It augments the data with skill-transition and recovery trajectories and improves reinforcement imitation learning, so policies generalize and recover from perturbations.
sensing: Sparse, noisy human-object interaction motion demonstrations used as references in physics simulation
datasets: Own HOI demonstration set (BallPlay tasks in the released code)

title: Hand-Shadow Poser
contribution: Solves the inverse hand-shadow problem: a three-stage pipeline that separates anatomical from semantic constraints finds joint left- and right-hand poses whose shadow resembles a target 2D shape. The paper also releases a benchmark of 210 shadow shapes.
sensing: No sensing; input is a target 2D shadow shape, output is a two-hand articulated pose

title: DAMO: A Deep Solver for Arbitrary Marker Configuration in Optical Motion Capture
contribution: Infers the relationship between each raw optical marker point and the joints of a 3D body model directly, solving body pose without predefined marker labels or a fixed marker configuration. It is a TOG 44(1) paper presented in the SIGGRAPH 2025 program.
sensing: Marker-based multi-camera optical motion capture (raw unlabeled marker point clouds)
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: Encoded Marker Clusters for Auto-Labeling in Optical Motion Capture
contribution: Auto-labels and matches markers in optical motion capture using uniquely coded clusters of reflective markers, which handles heterogeneous targets and unknown marker layouts. It is a TOG paper presented in the SIGGRAPH 2025 program.
sensing: Marker-based multi-camera optical motion capture with coded reflective marker clusters
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: MAGNET: Muscle Activation Generation Networks for Diverse Human Movement
contribution: Reconstructs full-body muscle activations for diverse human movements with a musculoskeletal model, and distills the result into models that generate muscle activations in real time, including on edge devices.
sensing: Human motion data (kinematic motion capture) as input to a musculoskeletal simulation; no direct camera sensing
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: HumanRAM: Feed-forward Human Reconstruction and Animation Model using Transformers
contribution: A transformer that reconstructs and animates a human feed-forward from monocular or sparse-view images. It performs novel-view and novel-pose synthesis without dense capture or per-subject optimization.
datasets: ActorsHQ and AMASS (animation poses shown on the project page); other training data not checked

title: SqueezeMe: Mobile-Ready Distillation of Gaussian Full-Body Avatars
contribution: Distills the corrective decoder of Gaussian-splatting full-body avatars into an efficient linear model, so the avatars animate and render in real time on mobile hardware (72 FPS on a Meta Quest 3).
sensing: Pre-built Gaussian full-body avatars deployed on a standalone VR headset (Meta Quest 3)
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: Relightable Full-Body Gaussian Codec Avatars
contribution: Builds drivable full-body avatars (body, face and hands) with relightable appearance. It combines 3D Gaussians with learnable orientation-dependent zonal harmonics for diffuse transfer, a shadow network for non-local shadowing, and deferred shading for specular transfer.
sensing: Multi-view studio capture of the subject (exact rig not checked); avatars targeted at telepresence and VR
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: EVA: Expressive Virtual Avatars from Multi-view Videos
contribution: Builds an actor-specific Gaussian avatar from multi-view video that renders in real time and allows independent control of facial expressions, body motion and hand gestures.
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: StreamME: Simplify 3D Gaussian Avatar within Live Stream
contribution: Reconstructs a 3D Gaussian head avatar on the fly from live-stream video, recording and training at the same time. It captures basic appearance within about 10 seconds and reaches high fidelity within about 5 minutes.
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: LAM: Large Avatar Model for One-shot Animatable Gaussian Head
contribution: Builds an animatable Gaussian head avatar from a single image in seconds. The avatar can be animated and rendered in real time in standard pipelines, including on mobile phones, without extra networks.
datasets: Not stated in the sources seen

title: Facial Appearance Capture at Home with Patch-Level Reflectance Prior
contribution: Reconstructs high-quality, engine-ready facial reflectance assets from a single co-located smartphone video shot in a dim room, using a patch-level diffusion prior trained on Light Stage scans.
sensing: Single smartphone video with co-located flash, dim room
datasets: Light Stage scans used to train the prior

title: Echoes of the Coliseum: Towards 3D Live streaming of Sports Events
contribution: Builds a pipeline for 3D live streaming and interactive replay of sports events, and releases a large synthetic multi-view dataset for benchmarking realism, motion and human interaction in dynamic scenes (journal track).
sensing: Multi-camera capture of dynamic sports scenes with multiple people
datasets: New large-scale synthetic multi-view basketball dataset (basket-multiview)

title: ELGAR: Expressive Cello Performance Motion Generation for Audio Rendition
contribution: A diffusion model that generates whole-body cello performance motion, including hand-instrument and bow interaction, from audio alone. The paper adds interaction-aware losses, metrics and a dataset. It is included generously: it generates motion and does not capture it.
sensing: Audio input; training data from markerless motion capture of string performance
datasets: SPD-GEN (derived from the String Performance Dataset, SPD)

title: AGILE: Hand-object Interaction Reconstruction from Video via Agentic Generation
contribution: Reconstructs 3D hand-object interactions from monocular video by having a VLM-guided generative model synthesize a complete watertight object mesh, initializing object pose at one interaction-onset frame and tracking it without SfM, then refining with contact-aware optimization to yield simulation-ready assets (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers, DOI 10.1145/3799902.3811134).

title: EgoForce: Forearm-Guided Camera-Space 3D Hand Pose from a Monocular Egocentric Camera
contribution: Recovers absolute camera-space 3D hand pose, shape and position from a single head-mounted camera using a differentiable forearm representation, a unified arm-hand transformer and a ray-space closed-form solver that works across fisheye, perspective and wide-FOV camera models (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers).
datasets: HOT3D plus two other egocentric hand benchmarks

title: MOCHI: Motion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions
contribution: Cleans noisy multi-human collaborative object-interaction captures in two stages: optimizes physically plausible hand grasps from noisy body input and extends them to hand-object sequences, then refines all participants' full-body motion by diffusion noise optimization with single-person priors plus human-object and human-human interaction objectives (SIGGRAPH 2026 Journal Track, ACM TOG).
sensing: input is captured or generated multi-person body plus object motion (mocap-derived), no raw sensor input
datasets: existing multi-human-object interaction captures; OMOMO-generated sequences

title: FLASHand: Feed-forward reLightable and Animatable Single-view Hand Reconstruction
contribution: Reconstructs a relightable, animatable 3D hand avatar from a single RGB image in one feed-forward pass using NIMBLE hand priors and mesh-based 2D Gaussian splatting with disentangled appearance (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers; hand only, no object).

title: TwinPose: Person-Specific Subspaces for Multi-View 3D Pose Estimation
contribution: Performs real-time multi-person 3D pose estimation from sparse multi-view cameras by building instance-aware twin poses in person-specific subspaces that join 2D pose semantics with multi-view geometric consistency, aimed at occlusion and dense interaction (SIGGRAPH 2026 Journal Track, ACM TOG).
datasets: public multi-view human pose datasets (not named in sources seen)

title: AMOR: Airborne Motion Reconstruction via Homotopy-Aware Trajectory Optimization
contribution: Refines human mesh recovery output for dynamic airborne motions by selecting reliable motion segments and applying homotopy-aware trajectory optimization to enforce physical consistency (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers).
datasets: in-the-wild and challenging videos (not named in sources seen)

title: PEAR: Pixel-aligned Expressive humAn mesh Recovery
contribution: Regresses SMPL-X body plus scaled-FLAME face parameters from a single image at over 100 FPS with a single ViT model, using pixel-level supervision to sharpen hands and face and a modular annotation strategy to enrich training data (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers).
datasets: multiple human mesh recovery benchmarks (not named in sources seen)

title: EgoRelight: Egocentric Human Capture and Illumination Recovery for Relightable and Photoreal Avatar Rendering
contribution: Captures full-body performance from a single headset using dense depth from stereo down-facing cameras to drive a mesh avatar, renders it relightably with a learned specular/diffuse appearance model, and recovers an HDR environment map by test-time inverse rendering for egocentric telepresence (SIGGRAPH 2026, session VR, Haptics and Hardware).
sensing: egocentric HMD stereo down-facing cameras (depth from stereo)

title: MUSIC: Learning Muscle-Driven Dexterous Hand Control
contribution: Learns physics-based control of a musculoskeletal hand model by training an RL tracking policy on muscle-tendon activations, distilling it into a VAE latent space, and training piece-specific high-level controllers as decentralized two-hand agents to play piano bimanually (SIGGRAPH 2026 Journal Track, ACM TOG; simulation, not capture).
sensing: none at run time (physics simulation driven by reference hand motion data and score note events)
datasets: reference piano-playing hand motion dataset; 15 piano pieces; human EMG comparison

title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting
contribution: Retargets human motion to physically simulated characters and robots of other morphologies (humanoid, quadruped) with a bilevel optimization that uses reinforcement learning so the retargeted motion is physically executable (SIGGRAPH 2026 Journal Track, ACM TOG; body motion, not hand-object).
sensing: input is human motion capture data

title: TopoCap: Learning Topology-Agnostic Motion Priors for Monocular Video-to-Animation
contribution: Extracts motion from monocular video and retargets it onto characters with arbitrary skeletal topologies by learning a graph-CVAE universal motion manifold conditioned on rig structure and predicting its codes from video with conditional flow matching, and introduces the Mobjaverse dataset of 5,000+ skeletal topologies (SIGGRAPH 2026; general characters rather than human-specific).

title: 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Low-Overlap Captures
contribution: Reconstructs dynamic 4D human scenes from a few sparse, low-overlap cameras (StudioRecon) by separating background and humans, densifying background supervision with video-diffusion novel views, initializing deformable Gaussian humans by cross-view identity association and triangulated keypoint fitting, and harmonizing the result with a recursive enhancement module (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers).
datasets: four real-world multi-view human datasets (not named in sources seen)

title: Retrofitting Existing 3D Objects with Surface-Conforming Capacitive Sensing
contribution: Adds surface-conforming capacitive touch-sensing electrodes to existing 3D objects so that multi-touch contact on arbitrary curved object surfaces can be sensed; included as a marginal S1 entry because it provides hand-object contact sensing (cited as such by later hand-object contact work), not visual tracking (SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference Papers).
sensing: capacitive touch sensing on the object surface

title: World-Grounded Human Motion Recovery via Gravity-View Coordinates
contribution: GVHMR predicts per-frame human pose in a gravity-view coordinate frame defined by the gravity direction and the camera view direction, then chains frames with relative camera rotations to recover world-grounded SMPL-X motion from monocular video without autoregressive drift.
sensing: monocular RGB video (static or moving camera)

title: RoMo: A Robust Solver for Full-body Unlabeled Optical Motion Capture
contribution: RoMo labels raw unlabeled optical marker point clouds by alignment, full-body segmentation and part-specific labeling with K-partite graph tracklet clustering, then solves body and hand motion with a hybrid IK solver that uses joint positions as an intermediate representation, handling mislabeling, occlusion and marker noise.
sensing: multi-camera optical marker-based mocap (raw marker point clouds), body and hands
datasets: Production and Front-waist studio mocap sets; GRAB with simulated noise and occlusion

title: FurElise: Capturing and Physically Synthesizing Hand Motion of Piano Performance
contribution: Builds a markerless capture of about 10 hours of bimanual 3D piano-playing hand motion from 15 pianists (multi-view triangulation of HaMeR keypoints refined by MIDI-constrained IK), and uses it with a diffusion reference-motion generator, music-similarity retrieval and reinforcement learning to drive physics-simulated hands that play unseen pieces.
sensing: 5 calibrated multi-view RGB cameras (GoPro, 4K, 59.94 fps) plus MIDI key/pedal sensors in a Yamaha Disklavier
datasets: introduces FurElise dataset (about 10 h, 15 pianists, 153 pieces, synchronized audio/MIDI)

title: Synchronize Dual Hands for Physics-Based Dexterous Guitar Playing
contribution: Trains separate single-hand control policies for the fretting and strumming hands in physics simulation and then couples them through a latent-space synchronizer into a joint bimanual policy that plays guitar with high temporal precision.
sensing: none (physics simulation in IsaacGym; reference hand motion data)
datasets: guitar playing reference motion and note data released with the code (notes from about 500 songs)

title: DiffH2O: Diffusion-Based Synthesis of Hand-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions
contribution: Synthesizes dexterous one- and two-hand object manipulation sequences from text with a diffusion model that splits grasping and interaction stages, adds grasp guidance and subsequence inpainting, and contributes fine-grained text annotations for GRAB.
sensing: none at inference (text plus object mesh); trained on marker-based mocap data
datasets: GRAB with new detailed text annotations

title: Casper DPM: Cascaded Perceptual Dynamic Projection Mapping onto Hands
contribution: Combines a slower 3D hand pose estimator with two fast 2D screen-space corrections (moving-least-squares alignment and perceptual boundary reduction) on a coaxial high-speed camera-projector rig to project content onto moving bare hands with low perceived latency, validated by user studies.
sensing: Leap Motion IR stereo for 3D hand pose plus coaxial high-speed IR camera (about 525 fps) and high-speed projector (about 1000 fps)
datasets: user studies (JND latency study, character-guessing task); no public dataset

title: Measuring Human Motion Under Clothing
contribution: Measures human body motion underneath clothing with wearable electromagnetic sensing so that skin and body motion can be recorded where cameras cannot see it (details from index tags; abstract not fetched).
sensing: wearable electromagnetic sensors (per index tags; not confirmed on a fetched abstract)

title: EgoAvatar: Egocentric View-Driven and Photorealistic Full-body Avatars
contribution: Drives a person-specific, photorealistic full-body Gaussian avatar from a single head-mounted downward-facing egocentric camera by personalized egocentric 3D keypoint detection, IK, motion-driven mesh deformation, test-time silhouette refinement and UV-space dynamic Gaussians.
sensing: single head-mounted egocentric fisheye RGB camera at inference; 120-camera multi-view studio for avatar training
datasets: introduces paired 4K multi-view plus egocentric full-body dataset (3 subjects)

title: EgoHDM: A Real-time Egocentric-Inertial Human Motion Capture, Localization, and Dense Mapping System
contribution: Couples sparse-IMU body motion capture with head-mounted monocular visual SLAM in a closed loop, aligning inertial, body and camera frames and using physics-based foot-ground contact correction to jointly estimate body pose, global localization and a dense scene map in near real time (journal-track TOG paper presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2024).
sensing: 6 body-worn IMUs plus one head-mounted monocular RGB camera

title: ELMO: Enhanced Real-time LiDAR Motion Capture through Upsampling
contribution: Upsamples 20 fps point clouds from a single LiDAR to 60 fps full-body motion in real time with a conditional autoregressive transformer, and releases a synchronized LiDAR, optical mocap and video dataset (journal-track TOG paper presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2024).
sensing: single LiDAR (depth point clouds), real time
datasets: introduces ELMO dataset (20 subjects, LiDAR plus optical mocap plus video); MOVIN dataset

title: Look Ma, no markers: holistic performance capture without the hassle
contribution: Captures body, face (including eyes and tongue) and both hands jointly without markers or calibration by predicting dense 2D landmarks and initial pose/shape with networks trained only on synthetic data and fitting a unified parametric body model, for any number of cameras and in world coordinates (journal-track TOG paper).
sensing: one or more uncalibrated RGB cameras
datasets: synthetic training data; evaluated on EHF and per-part benchmarks

title: MaskedMimic: Unified Physics-Based Character Control Through Masked Motion Inpainting
contribution: Trains one physics-based humanoid controller to complete full-body motion from randomly masked partial constraints (keyframes, sparse joints, text, objects), which covers full-body tracking, VR tracking from head and hand signals only, path following and object interaction such as sitting (journal-track TOG paper).
sensing: physics simulation; sparse head-and-hands VR tracking signals as one input mode

title: Autonomous Character-Scene Interaction Synthesis from Text Instruction
contribution: Synthesizes multi-stage human motion combining walking, hand reaching and human-object/scene interaction in 3D scenes from a text instruction and a goal location with a diffusion model, and releases the 16-hour VR-assisted mocap dataset LINGO (synthesis rather than capture).
sensing: none at inference (text plus 3D scene); training data from VR-assisted optical mocap
datasets: introduces LINGO dataset (16 h human-scene interaction mocap)

title: Gaussian Surfel Splatting for Live Human Performance Capture
contribution: Represents a performing human with Gaussian surfels for live (online) human performance capture and free-view rendering (journal-track TOG paper; abstract not fetched, description from title and index only).
sensing: multi-view RGB video (exact camera count not confirmed)

title: Robust Dual Gaussian Splatting for Immersive Human-centric Volumetric Videos
contribution: DualGS disentangles motion (joint Gaussians) from appearance (skin Gaussians) with coarse-to-fine per-frame optimization and a hybrid compression scheme to track and render human performances, including musicians handling instruments, as roughly 350 KB per frame volumetric video playable in VR headsets (journal-track TOG paper).
datasets: introduces multi-view dataset of 8 performers playing musical instruments

title: VOODOO XP: Expressive One-Shot Head Reenactment for VR Telepresence
contribution: Performs real-time 3D-aware head reenactment from a single source portrait by injecting driver expression features into the 3D lifting transformer with multi-stage self-supervised disentanglement, and integrates it into an end-to-end two-way VR telepresence system (journal-track TOG paper).
sensing: monocular RGB driving video plus one source portrait image

title: URAvatar: Universal Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars
contribution: Builds a drivable, real-time relightable photorealistic head avatar from a single phone scan by personalizing a universal relightable Gaussian prior learned from multi-view, multi-illumination captures of hundreds of people.
sensing: mobile phone video scan at use time; multi-view multi-light studio capture for prior training
datasets: internal multi-view multi-light head capture of hundreds of subjects; LED-dome relighting ground truth

title: SPARK: Self-supervised Personalized Real-time Monocular Face Capture
contribution: Reconstructs a personalized 3D face avatar from a set of unconstrained videos of one person, then replaces the decoder of a pretrained feed-forward face tracker with it and fine-tunes the encoder to regress detailed face geometry in real time from a single camera.
datasets: 6 per-subject collections of unconstrained videos (k-fold evaluation)

title: Real-time 3D Human Reconstruction and Rendering System from a Single RGB Camera
contribution: Technical Communication (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) presenting a system that reconstructs and renders a 3D human in real time from one RGB camera; description from title only.

title: 3D Reconstruction of a Soft Object Surface and Contact Areas in Hand-Object Interactions
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) that reconstructs the 3D surface of a deformable object and the hand-object contact areas during manipulation; description from title only.

title: 3D Human Pose Estimation Using Ultra-low Resolution Thermal Images
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) estimating 3D human pose from ultra-low-resolution thermal images; description from title only.

title: Signal2Hand: Sensor Modality Translation from Body-Worn Sensor Signals to Hand-Depth Images
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) that translates body-worn sensor signals into hand depth images to recover hand shape; description from title only.
sensing: body-worn sensors, translated to hand depth images

title: Mixed Reality Solutions for Tremor Disorders: Ergonomic Hand Motion and AR Rehabilitation
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) on mixed-reality hand-motion support and AR rehabilitation for tremor disorders; description from title only.
sensing: mixed reality / AR device (details not determined)

title: Jaku-in: A Cultural Skills Training System for Recording and Reproducing Three-dimensional Body, Eye, and Hand Movements
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) describing a system that records and replays 3D body, eye and hand movements of experts for skills training; description from title only.
sensing: not determined (records 3D body, eye and hand motion)

title: An immersive interface for remote collaboration with multiple telepresence robots through digital twin spaces
contribution: Poster (listed with the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 conference, not a full technical paper) presenting an immersive interface for operating multiple telepresence robots via a digital twin of the remote space; description from title only.
sensing: telepresence robots plus digital twin (details not determined)

title: PhysHMR: Learning Humanoid Control Policies from Vision for Physically Plausible Human Motion Reconstruction
contribution: Learns a single visual-to-action humanoid control policy in a physics simulator that reconstructs human motion from monocular video, lifting 2D keypoints to global 3D rays as policy input and distilling a mocap-trained expert before RL refinement.
datasets: AMASS (expert training); evaluated on EMDB2 and AIST++

title: PhySIC: Physically Plausible 3D Human-Scene Interaction and Contact from a Single Image
contribution: Recovers a metric SMPL-X body, dense scene surfaces and vertex-level contact maps in one frame from a single image by occlusion-aware inpainting, fusing monocular depth into a metric scene scaffold, and confidence-weighted optimization with depth, contact, interpenetration and reprojection terms; handles multiple people.
sensing: single RGB image (with monocular depth estimates)

title: Shape-aware Inertial Poser: Motion Tracking for Humans with Diverse Shapes Using Sparse Inertial Sensors
contribution: Makes sparse-IMU motion capture work across body shapes (including children) by regressing real-body IMU accelerations to a template body, estimating template motion, mapping joint velocities back with a shape-aware physics optimization, and estimating body shape from IMUs alone; also releases a 20-subject IMU-motion dataset. ACM TOG journal paper presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2025.
datasets: introduces MID dataset (10 children, 10 adults, heights 110-190 cm, 400 min paired IMU-motion)

title: Learning Human Motion with Temporally Conditional Mamba
contribution: Injects time-varying conditions into the selection matrices of Mamba blocks inside a diffusion model so generated or estimated motion stays frame-aligned with the condition, evaluated on music-to-dance, egocentric-video-to-body-motion estimation and object-trajectory-to-full-body HOI motion.
sensing: conditioning signals: egocentric head-mounted video, music, object trajectories (from mocap datasets)

title: MaskedManipulator: Versatile Whole-Body Control for Loco-Manipulation
contribution: Distills a tracking controller trained on large-scale human-object mocap into a generative goal-conditioned policy that drives a physically simulated humanoid to perform full-body object manipulation from sparse targets such as object or body poses (character animation, not capture).
sensing: none at inference (physics simulation); trained on optical mocap of human-object interaction

title: Uni-Inter: Unifying 3D Human Motion Synthesis Across Diverse Interaction Contexts
contribution: Encodes humans, objects and scenes into a shared volumetric field (Unified Interactive Volume) and predicts joint-wise distributions over it, so one diffusion model generates human-object, human-human and human-scene interaction motion (generation, not capture).
sensing: none (motion synthesis trained on mocap datasets)

title: HOMA: Towards Generic Human-Object Interaction in Multimodal Driven Human Animation with Weak Conditions
contribution: Generates human-object interaction videos from weak, sparse and decoupled motion guidance plus appearance and audio inputs, using an MMDiT with a parameter-space HOI adapter and a facial cross-attention adapter for lip sync (2D video generation, not 3D capture).
sensing: reference image, audio, text and sparse motion guidance (video generation)
datasets: not stated in the sources seen

title: SymBridge: A Human-in-the-Loop Cyber-Physical Interactive System for Adaptive Human-Robot Symbiosis
contribution: Builds an AR system in which real people interact with virtual humanoid robots in physical space, with LiDAR-based human motion capture feeding a real-time robot interaction model that is continually fine-tuned from human feedback.
sensing: LiDAR-based human motion capture plus AR glasses
datasets: Inter-X retargeted to Unitree H1 and LEJU Kuavo humanoids; user studies

title: Unifying Latent Action and Latent State Pre-training for Policy Learning from Videos
contribution: UniMimic trains a tokenizer that yields latent states from video frames and latent actions between them, pre-trains a policy on action-free videos to predict both, then fine-tunes on action-labelled robot data for manipulation.
sensing: unlabelled RGB videos plus action-labelled robot demonstrations

title: HRM^2Avatar: High-Fidelity Real-Time Mobile Avatars from Monocular Phone Scans
contribution: Builds animatable full-body avatars from smartphone static-pose and motion scans using extracted garment meshes with illumination-aware Gaussians, and renders them with a GPU-driven pipeline at 120 FPS on phones and 90 FPS on standalone VR headsets.
datasets: own smartphone captures (static pose and dynamic motion sequences)

title: PriorAvatar: Efficient and Robust Avatar Creation from Monocular Video Using Learned Priors
contribution: Fits a 3D Gaussian human avatar to monocular video by fine-tuning a learned multi-person latent codebook and shared U-Net decoder (trained on human scans) with 2D photometric losses, tolerating imperfect segmentation and body pose.
datasets: human scans for the prior; evaluation datasets not stated in the sources seen

title: Audio Driven Real-Time Facial Animation for Social Telepresence
contribution: Animates photorealistic 3D face avatars from live audio in under 15 ms GPU time using an online transformer encoder and a diffusion model distilled to one step, with optional emotion and VR-headset eye-camera inputs, for VR social telepresence.
sensing: microphone audio, optionally head-mounted eye cameras on a VR headset
datasets: in-house dataset of 265 subjects (free-form and read speech)

title: Generative Head-Mounted Camera Captures for Photorealistic Avatars
contribution: Trains a keypoint-and-segmentation-conditioned diffusion model on unpaired headset-camera images to synthesize HMC views for any dome-captured avatar expression, producing paired data that improves a universal VR face encoder for driving photorealistic avatars. ACM TOG journal paper presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2025.
sensing: VR headset infrared head-mounted cameras plus multi-camera dome
datasets: large unpaired HMC captures and dome captures (Meta internal)

title: Topology-Aware Optimization of Gaussian Primitives for Human-Centric Volumetric Videos
contribution: TaoGS represents human-centric dynamic scenes with sparse motion Gaussians driven by a spatio-temporal tracker that anchor local appearance Gaussians, enabling long-range tracking through topology changes such as removing clothes and human-object interaction, with a codec-friendly volumetric video format.

title: StableMotion: Training Motion Cleanup Models with Unpaired Corrupted Data
contribution: Trains a quality-aware diffusion model on raw, mixed-quality mocap using per-frame motion quality indicators, so the same model detects and repairs corrupted frames such as pops and freezes without paired clean data.
datasets: SoccerMocap (245 h production soccer mocap); authors' cleanup benchmark

title: OKAMI: Teaching Humanoid Robots Manipulation Skills through Single Video Imitation
contribution: Builds a manipulation plan from a single human RGB-D video using open-world vision models to localize task objects, and performs object-aware retargeting of body motion and hand pose separately so a humanoid can reproduce the task at new object locations; CoRL 2024 oral.
datasets: own human demonstration videos and humanoid rollouts

title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
contribution: Trains a low-level humanoid policy on 40 hours of human motion data so a 33-DoF humanoid can shadow human body and hand motion estimated in real time from a single RGB camera, then uses the shadowing data to train egocentric-vision behavior cloning skills.
sensing: single RGB camera for human body and hand pose; egocentric cameras on robot
datasets: existing 40-hour human motion datasets; own teleoperated humanoid demonstrations

title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
contribution: Uses kinematic pose as a control interface so a dexterous full-size humanoid can be teleoperated from a VR headset, an RGB camera or language, trains a sparse-input sim-to-real policy from retargeted human motion data, and releases the OmniH2O-6 whole-body demonstration dataset.
sensing: VR headset sparse tracking or RGB camera human pose

title: Open-TeleVision: Teleoperation with Immersive Active Visual Feedback
contribution: Builds an immersive teleoperation system that streams stereoscopic active-camera views to the operator and mirrors tracked operator arm and hand motion onto humanoid robots, and uses it to collect data for imitation learning on four long-horizon tasks.
sensing: VR/stereo headset with operator hand and arm tracking; robot stereo head camera

title: ACE: A Cross-platform and visual-Exoskeletons System for Low-Cost Dexterous Teleoperation
contribution: Combines a hand-facing camera for real-time 3D hand pose estimation with a back-mounted arm exoskeleton to teleoperate bimanual dexterous robots across six platforms and collect demonstrations for policy learning.
sensing: hand-facing RGB camera for hand pose plus exoskeleton joint encoders

title: OPEN TEACH: A Versatile Teleoperation System for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Provides an open-source mixed-reality teleoperation app on Meta Quest 3 that maps tracked hand gestures to multi-fingered hands, bimanual arms and mobile manipulators at up to 90 Hz, evaluated on 38 tasks and a user study against AnyTeleop.
sensing: Meta Quest 3 VR headset hand tracking
datasets: own teleoperation data on 38 tasks; 10 policy-learning tasks

title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation using Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
contribution: Adds a mobile base and whole-body teleoperation interface to ALOHA to collect bimanual mobile manipulation demonstrations and shows co-training with static ALOHA data improves behavior cloning.
datasets: own Mobile ALOHA demonstrations; static ALOHA datasets

title: ALOHA Unleashed: A Simple Recipe for Robot Dexterity
contribution: Combines large-scale teleoperated data collection on ALOHA 2 with diffusion policies to learn bimanual dexterous tasks with deformable objects and rich contact.

title: Twisting Lids Off with Two Hands
contribution: Trains sim-to-real RL policies for two multi-fingered robot hands to twist lids off bottle-like objects, with physical modeling, real-time perception and reward design choices enabling transfer to unseen objects.
sensing: real-time visual perception of the object on a bimanual multi-fingered robot

title: InterACT: Inter-dependency Aware Action Chunking with Hierarchical Attention Transformers for Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: Proposes an imitation learning architecture with hierarchical attention encoders and a synchronized multi-arm decoder to model inter-dependencies between the two arms in bimanual manipulation.
sensing: robot RGB cameras and dual-arm joint states

title: VoxAct-B: Voxel-Based Acting and Stabilizing Policy for Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: Uses VLMs to select task-relevant regions, reconstructs a voxel grid of them, and learns separate acting and stabilizing arm policies for language-conditioned bimanual manipulation.
sensing: RGB-D cameras reconstructed into voxel grids; two UR5 arms
datasets: simulated bimanual tasks; real Open Drawer and Open Jar

title: 3D-ViTac: Learning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Visuo-Tactile Sensing
contribution: Builds dense low-cost tactile sensors for a bimanual robot and fuses tactile and visual data into a unified 3D point representation used by diffusion policies for fine-grained and in-hand bimanual manipulation.
sensing: 3D visual point clouds plus dense tactile sensor arrays

title: Generative Factor Chaining: Coordinated Manipulation with Diffusion-based Factor Graph
contribution: Represents multi-step multi-manipulator planning as a spatio-temporal factor graph whose factors are composable diffusion models, applied to long-horizon bimanual manipulation planning.
sensing: not a sensing paper (planning over object and robot states)

title: RP1M: A Large-Scale Motion Dataset for Piano Playing with Bi-Manual Dexterous Robot Hands
contribution: Releases over one million simulated bimanual dexterous robot piano-playing trajectories, using optimal-transport finger placement to annotate songs automatically, and benchmarks imitation learning on it.

title: PianoMime: Learning a Generalist, Dexterous Piano Player from Internet Demonstrations
contribution: Extracts features from YouTube videos of pianists to train song-specific expert policies for bimanual dexterous robot hands and distils them into a single generalist piano-playing policy.
sensing: monocular internet RGB videos of human pianists

title: ManiWAV: Learning Robot Manipulation from In-the-Wild Audio-Visual Data
contribution: Introduces an ear-in-hand handheld data collection device that records synchronized audio and vision during in-the-wild human demonstrations and a policy interface that learns contact-rich robot skills from them.
sensing: handheld gripper with camera and contact microphone

title: MimicTouch: Leveraging Multi-modal Human Tactile Demonstrations for Contact-rich Manipulation
contribution: Collects multi-modal tactile data while humans perform contact-rich tasks with their own hands, learns a tactile-guided policy by imitation, and bridges the hand-to-gripper gap with online residual RL.

title: ResPilot: Teleoperated Finger Gaiting via Gaussian Process Residual Learning
contribution: Learns a Gaussian-process residual on the human-to-robot hand mapping to expand the reachable workspace of a teleoperated multi-fingered hand and adds coupled fingertip constraints to support finger-gaiting tasks.
sensing: operator hand tracking for dexterous hand teleoperation

title: Flow as the Cross-domain Manipulation Interface
contribution: Im2Flow2Act trains an object-flow generator on human demonstration videos and a flow-conditioned policy on simulated robot play data, so real-world manipulation is learned without real robot data.
datasets: own human videos; simulated robot play data

title: TieBot: Learning to Knot a Tie from Visual Demonstration through a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Approach
contribution: Estimates a sequence of tie meshes from a demonstration video by hierarchical feature matching, uses them as subgoals for a privileged teacher policy, and distils a point-cloud student policy executed on a dual-arm robot; CoRL 2024 oral.
sensing: RGB demonstration video; point clouds at execution

title: Bi-Level Motion Imitation for Humanoid Robots
contribution: Alternately optimizes a humanoid policy and the human MoCap reference motions, using a self-consistent auto-encoder latent dynamics model to make retargeted references physically feasible.
datasets: human MoCap data (not named in abstract)

title: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Tracking for Graph-Based Neural Dynamics Modeling
contribution: Densely tracks 3D Gaussian reconstructions of deformable objects from multi-view RGB videos of robot interactions and learns a GNN particle dynamics model for action-conditioned prediction and planning.
datasets: own robot interaction data with ropes, clothes and stuffed animals

title: Physically Embodied Gaussian Splatting: A Visually Learnt and Physically Grounded 3D Representation for Robotics
contribution: Couples physics particles with attached 3D Gaussians so a particle simulator predicts object states while rendered-versus-observed image differences apply visual forces that keep the representation synchronized with the real scene, evaluated on 2D and 3D tracking; CoRL 2024 oral.

title: Learning Visuotactile Estimation and Control for Non-prehensile Manipulation under Occlusions
contribution: Learns a Bayesian visuotactile object state estimator from simulated privileged-policy interaction data and trains uncertainty-aware RL control on top of it, handling object occlusion with a single onboard camera after sim-to-real transfer.
sensing: onboard RGB camera plus tactile sensing

title: Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
contribution: VideoMimic is a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that jointly reconstructs humans and their surrounding environment from casually captured everyday videos and trains environment-conditioned whole-body humanoid control policies from them, for example stair climbing and sitting on chairs (oral).
sensing: monocular RGB video of humans (casual or in-the-wild capture)
datasets: everyday human motion videos collected by the authors; no named benchmark in the abstract

title: Tool-as-Interface: Learning Robot Policies from Observing Human Tool Use
contribution: Transfers tool-use skills from human videos to robots. It reconstructs 3D scenes from two RGB cameras, uses Gaussian splatting for novel-view augmentation, and learns embodiment-invariant policies on segmented observations with tool-centric task-space actions.
sensing: two RGB cameras recording human tool use; 3D reconstruction with Gaussian splatting
datasets: human tool-use demonstrations collected by the authors

title: Point Policy: Unifying Observations and Actions with Key Points for Robot Manipulation
contribution: Learns robot policies only from offline human demonstration videos. Human hand poses are translated into robot poses, and object state is captured with semantically meaningful key points, which gives a morphology-agnostic representation.
sensing: human demonstration videos (RGB, with hand pose and key point extraction from vision models)
datasets: human video demonstrations collected by the authors; real-world robot tasks

title: BEHAVIOR Robot Suite: Streamlining Real-World Whole-Body Manipulation for Everyday Household Activities
contribution: Builds a bimanual wheeled robot with a 4-DoF torso, a low-cost whole-body teleoperation interface for collecting demonstrations, and a whole-body visuomotor policy learning algorithm, evaluated on five household tasks.
sensing: whole-body teleoperation interface; robot onboard cameras
datasets: five real-world household tasks collected with the BRS teleoperation interface

title: UnPose: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Priors for Zero-Shot Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates novel-object 6D pose without a CAD model and reconstructs the object. It builds an initial 3D Gaussian Splatting model from one RGB-D frame with a multi-view diffusion prior and pixel-wise uncertainty, refines it incrementally from new views, and jointly optimizes the result in a pose graph.
sensing: single-view RGB-D frame, incrementally extended with additional views
datasets: 6D pose and reconstruction benchmarks (not named in the abstract); real-world robot manipulation

title: UniTac2Pose: A Unified Approach Learned in Simulation for Category-level Visuotactile In-hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates in-hand object pose from CAD models with an energy-based diffusion model trained only in simulation. It samples and pre-ranks candidates, refines them iteratively with render-and-compare, post-ranks them, and also provides pose tracking and uncertainty estimates.
sensing: visuotactile sensing on a robot gripper; object CAD model
datasets: simulated training data; real-world in-hand pose experiments

title: UniSkill: Imitating Human Videos via Cross-Embodiment Skill Representations
contribution: Learns embodiment-agnostic skill representations from large-scale unlabeled cross-embodiment video, so that skills extracted from a human video prompt can condition robot policies trained only on robot data.
sensing: monocular RGB human and robot videos
datasets: large-scale cross-embodiment video data; simulation and real-world robot evaluations

title: Phantom: Training Robots Without Robots Using Only Human Videos
contribution: Converts human demonstration videos into robot observation-action pairs. It estimates hand pose, inpaints the human arm and overlays a rendered robot, and then trains policies that deploy zero-shot without any robot data.
sensing: human demonstration video (RGB/RGB-D) with hand pose estimation
datasets: human video demonstrations collected by the authors (deformable manipulation, sweeping, insertion)

title: CLONE: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation for Long-Horizon Tasks
contribution: Provides whole-body humanoid teleoperation for collecting long-horizon interaction data. It uses a mixture-of-experts whole-body controller, closed-loop drift correction with LiDAR odometry, and data augmentation for unseen operator poses.
sensing: operator pose tracking for teleoperation; robot LiDAR odometry

title: GLOVER++: Unleashing the Potential of Affordance Learning from Human Behaviors for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Introduces HOVA-500K, an affordance-annotated dataset of human-object interaction images, and GLOVER++, a global-to-local affordance model that transfers actionable affordances from human behavior to open-vocabulary robot manipulation.

title: Humanoid Policy ~ Human Policy
contribution: Collects an egocentric, task-oriented human demonstration dataset aligned with humanoid demonstrations. It trains the Human Action Transformer (HAT) on a state-action space shared by humans and humanoids that is differentiably retargeted to robot actions, co-trained with robot data.
sensing: egocentric human demonstrations with hand tracking; humanoid teleoperation data

title: Lucid-XR: An Extended-Reality Data Engine for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Runs physics simulation and human-to-robot pose retargeting on an XR headset to collect virtual demonstrations, then amplifies them with physics-guided video generation to train visual policies that transfer zero-shot to bimanual and dexterous tasks.
sensing: XR headset hand and head tracking

title: LodeStar: Long-horizon Dexterity via Synthetic Data Augmentation from Human Demonstrations
contribution: Segments a few human demonstrations into skills with foundation models, generates synthetic demonstrations for each skill with RL in simulation, and chains the skills with a Skill Routing Transformer for long-horizon dexterous manipulation.
sensing: a few human demonstrations (collection device not stated in the abstract); simulation

title: Vision in Action: Learning Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
contribution: Learns active head-camera perception strategies for bimanual manipulation under occlusion from human demonstrations. It uses a 6-DoF robot neck and a VR teleoperation interface that renders from an intermediate 3D scene representation to reduce latency.
sensing: VR headset teleoperation; robot head RGB camera on a 6-DoF neck
datasets: three multi-stage bimanual tasks with visual occlusion

title: exUMI: Extensible Robot Teaching System with Action-aware Task-agnostic Tactile Representation
contribution: Extends the handheld UMI data collection device with AR motion capture and rotary-encoder proprioception, modular visuo-tactile sensing and automated calibration. It also proposes Tactile Prediction Pretraining on more than one million collected tactile frames.
sensing: handheld gripper with AR MoCap tracking, rotary encoder, visuo-tactile sensors and camera
datasets: over 1M tactile frames collected with exUMI

title: Real2Render2Real: Scaling Robot Data Without Dynamics Simulation or Robot Hardware
contribution: Generates thousands of rendered, robot-agnostic demonstrations from a smartphone scan of the objects and one human demonstration video. It reconstructs object geometry and appearance with 3D Gaussian Splatting and tracks the 6-DoF motion of rigid and articulated objects (oral).
sensing: smartphone multi-view object scan plus a single monocular human demonstration video

title: TWIST: Teleoperated Whole-Body Imitation System
contribution: Teleoperates humanoids through whole-body motion imitation. Human motion capture data is retargeted to the robot, and an RL+BC whole-body controller that uses privileged future frames and real-world MoCap data tracks the result.
sensing: human motion capture (MoCap) of the operator
datasets: retargeted human motion capture clips; real-world MoCap data

title: KineDex: Learning Tactile-Informed Visuomotor Policies via Kinesthetic Teaching for Dexterous Manipulation
contribution: Collects tactile-rich dexterous demonstrations by hand-over-hand kinesthetic teaching, inpaints the occluding human hand out of the visual observations, and trains tactile-augmented visuomotor policies with force control.
sensing: kinesthetic teaching on a dexterous hand with tactile sensors; RGB cameras with hand inpainting
datasets: contact-rich dexterous tasks collected by the authors

title: Action-Free Reasoning for Policy Generalization
contribution: RAD trains reasoning-based robot policies on robot data with reasoning and action labels plus action-free human videos with reasoning labels only. It also releases 3,377 human-hand demonstrations with chain-of-thought annotations and hand-tracking data.
sensing: monocular RGB human-hand demonstration videos with hand tracking
datasets: new 3,377 human-hand demonstration dataset compatible with Bridge V2 (introduced); Bridge V2

title: IRIS: An Immersive Robot Interaction System
contribution: An extended-reality system for immersive robot interaction and demonstration collection across simulators and the real world. It visualizes rigid and deformable objects and robots, streams real-time sensor point clouds, and supports multiple users in a shared scene.
sensing: XR headset; real-time sensor point clouds from depth cameras
datasets: simulated and real-world data collection experiments

title: Hand-Eye Autonomous Delivery: Learning Humanoid Navigation, Locomotion and Reaching
contribution: Learns humanoid navigation and reaching from human data. A low-level whole-body controller tracks eye and both-hand targets learned from large-scale human motion capture, and a high-level planner is learned from egocentric human data recorded with Aria glasses.
sensing: human motion capture data; egocentric Aria glasses recordings
datasets: existing large-scale human motion capture data; egocentric human data collected with Aria glasses

title: Latent Adaptive Planner for Dynamic Manipulation
contribution: Learns a latent-space variational replanner for dynamic nonprehensile manipulation from human demonstration videos. Model-based proportional mapping regenerates kinematic-dynamic joint states and object positions from the human videos to bridge the embodiment gap.
datasets: multiple manipulation benchmarks (not named in the abstract)

title: FLARE: Robot Learning with Implicit World Modeling
contribution: Aligns diffusion-transformer policy features with latent embeddings of future observations. This adds implicit world modeling to VLA policies and allows co-training with action-free egocentric human videos; the human-video part is a secondary result.
sensing: robot camera observations; egocentric human video without action labels
datasets: two multitask simulation imitation learning benchmarks (single-arm and humanoid tabletop); egocentric human demonstrations

title: DexCap: Scalable and Portable Mocap Data Collection System for Dexterous Manipulation
contribution: Builds a portable hand motion-capture rig that tracks wrists and fingers with SLAM plus electromagnetic gloves and records 3D scene observations, and trains dexterous robot hands from that data with DexIL, an inverse-kinematics retargeting and point-cloud imitation method with optional human-in-the-loop correction.
sensing: wearable EM-field finger mocap gloves plus wrist SLAM tracking cameras plus body-mounted 3D (RGB-D/point cloud) scene capture
datasets: introduces in-the-wild DexCap hand mocap demonstrations; evaluated on six dexterous manipulation tasks

title: Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots
contribution: Collects bimanual and dynamic manipulation demonstrations with hand-held camera grippers and turns them into hardware-agnostic robot policies through a policy interface with inference-time latency matching and relative-trajectory actions.
sensing: hand-held gripper with wrist-mounted fisheye camera (GoPro) and visual-inertial SLAM; single or two grippers for bimanual
datasets: introduces the UMI in-the-wild demonstration dataset

title: ScrewMimic: Bimanual Imitation from Human Videos with Screw Space Projection
contribution: Models the relative motion of two hands in a human video as a screw motion, uses that screw action space to initialise bimanual robot behaviour from a single human demonstration, and refines it with self-supervised fine-tuning on the robot.
sensing: single human demonstration video with estimated two-hand trajectories (RGB-D camera setup; exact camera not confirmed on the fetched page)
datasets: own human video demonstrations of bimanual tasks; real-robot evaluation

title: Vid2Robot: End-to-end Video-conditioned Policy Learning with Cross-Attention Transformers
contribution: Trains an end-to-end policy that takes a human video of a manipulation task as the prompt and outputs robot actions, using cross-attention between video features and robot state plus contrastive losses aligning human and robot video representations.
sensing: monocular RGB human prompt videos and robot camera observations
datasets: large dataset of paired human prompt videos and robot trajectories; compared against BC-Z

title: Any-point Trajectory Modeling for Policy Learning
contribution: Pre-trains a model that predicts future 2D trajectories of arbitrary points in video frames and uses those predicted tracks to guide visuomotor policies learned from few action-labelled demonstrations, including transfer from human videos.
sensing: monocular RGB video (robot and human videos)
datasets: 130 language-conditioned tasks in simulation (LIBERO) and real world; human video transfer experiments

title: HRP: Human affordances for Robotic Pre-training
contribution: Fine-tunes pre-trained visual representations on hand, object and contact affordance labels automatically extracted from internet human videos, improving downstream robot policies by at least 15 percent on 5 real tasks.
sensing: monocular RGB internet human video for pre-training; robot cameras (three views) at deployment
datasets: internet-scale human video with automatically extracted affordance labels; 5 real-world tasks on three robot morphologies including a dexterous hand

title: Human-oriented Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Fine-tunes pre-trained visual encoders on multiple human-interaction perception tasks such as hand detection and state estimation, fused through a Task Fusion Decoder, to produce representations for downstream robot manipulation policies.
sensing: monocular RGB (egocentric human video for perception tasks; robot cameras downstream)
datasets: human-interaction perception tasks on egocentric video; encoders R3M, MVP and EgoVLP; simulated and real robot tasks

title: Learning Manipulation by Predicting Interaction
contribution: Pre-trains a visual representation on human video by predicting the transition frame between initial and final keyframes and detecting the interaction object, conditioned on language, then uses it for robot policy learning.
sensing: monocular RGB human video for pre-training; robot cameras downstream
datasets: large-scale human video datasets for pre-training; four robotic tasks in simulation and real world

title: Demonstrating Learning from Humans on Open-Source Dexterous Robot Hands
contribution: Demonstration-track paper showing low-cost open-source robot hands taught by teleoperation with a mobile arm-and-hand motion-capture system, by human video and human motion, and then improved with reinforcement learning in simulation and the real world.
sensing: arm and hand motion capture for teleoperation; human video

title: Tilde: Teleoperation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Learning with a DeltaHand
contribution: Collects in-hand manipulation demonstrations with TeleHand, a kinematic-twin teleoperation device that maps human finger motion one-to-one to a soft DeltaHand, and trains diffusion policies on seven dexterous tasks.
sensing: kinematic-twin hand-worn teleoperation interface; robot-side cameras
datasets: own teleoperated demonstrations on seven dexterous in-hand tasks

title: Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots
contribution: Trains a humanoid whole-body controller with reinforcement learning to imitate human motion-capture clips in the upper body while the legs only track a commanded velocity, and transfers it sim-to-real on a full-size humanoid.
sensing: offline human motion-capture data retargeted to a humanoid (Unitree H1)
datasets: large-scale human motion capture data from the graphics community

title: PoCo: Policy Composition from and for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
contribution: Composes diffusion-model policies trained separately on simulation, human and real-robot data, across tasks and analytic cost functions, to produce tool-use manipulation policies at inference time.
sensing: heterogeneous: RGB, depth, tactile and proprioception; human demonstration data
datasets: own simulation, human and real-robot tool-use data

title: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-To-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation
