contribution: Scans real scenes into digital-twin simulations on the fly and robustifies real-world imitation policies with reinforcement learning in those twins, using inverse distillation to bring real demonstrations into simulation.
sensing: consumer scanning of real scenes to build digital twins; robot cameras
datasets: six real-world manipulation tasks (dish stacking, book placing and others)

title: URDFormer: A Pipeline for Constructing Articulated Simulation Environments from Real-World Images
contribution: Infers articulated kinematic scene structure from natural images to generate simulation scenes, training the image-to-simulation model on paired data synthesised with controllable text-to-image generation.
datasets: synthetic paired image-scene data generated with text-to-image models; web-scale image collections

title: CLOSURE: Fast Quantification of Pose Uncertainty Sets
contribution: Computes an inner approximation of the minimum enclosing geodesic ball of the set of 6D object poses consistent with bounded-noise keypoint measurements by GPU random-walk sampling of its boundary, giving a pose estimate with a worst-case error bound.
sensing: learned keypoint and pose-hypothesis measurements from RGB images
datasets: 6D object pose estimation benchmarks (not named in the abstract)

title: ViTaSCOPE: Visuo-tactile Implicit Representation for In-hand Pose and Extrinsic Contact Estimation
contribution: Represents the in-hand object as a signed distance field conditioned on vision and tactile shear fields to jointly estimate in-hand object pose and register extrinsic contacts on the object geometry, trained in simulation and transferred to real dexterous manipulation.
sensing: vision plus high-resolution tactile (shear field) sensing on a robot hand
datasets: simulation-generated training data; simulated and real-world experiments (no named dataset)

title: Vysics: Object Reconstruction Under Occlusion by Fusing Vision and Contact-Rich Physics
contribution: Tracks and reconstructs a rigid object from a seconds-long RGB-D video with BundleSDF and adds geometry inferred from contact physics (via implicit contact dynamics on the tracked trajectory) to complete the shape of objects heavily occluded during robot interaction.
sensing: single RGB-D video plus robot proprioception
datasets: own RGB-D robot-object interaction recordings under heavy occlusion (no named dataset)

title: CordViP: Correspondence-based Visuomotor Policy for Dexterous Manipulation in Real-World
contribution: Builds interaction-aware point clouds from 6D object pose estimates and robot hand proprioception, to compensate for single-view point clouds degraded by hand occlusion, and pretrains a dexterous visuomotor policy on object-centric contact maps and hand-arm coordination.
sensing: single-view RGB-D camera plus robot proprioception
datasets: four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks with teleoperated demonstrations

title: DexWild: Dexterous Human Interactions for In-the-Wild Robot Policies
contribution: Builds DW-Mocap, a low-cost mobile system that records people's own hand-object interactions in many environments, and co-trains dexterous robot policies on the resulting human data together with a small set of robot teleoperation demonstrations.
sensing: DW-Mocap low-cost mobile wearable hand motion capture system for in-the-wild human data, plus robot teleoperation data
datasets: DexWild human hand interaction dataset and robot demonstrations (introduced)

title: DOGlove: Dexterous Manipulation with a Low-Cost Open-Source Haptic Force Feedback Glove
contribution: Builds an open-source glove for under 600 USD that captures 21-DoF hand motion and gives 5-DoF force and fingertip haptic feedback, uses action and force retargeting to teleoperate dexterous robot hands, and trains imitation policies on the collected demonstrations.
sensing: wearable 21-DoF hand motion capture glove with force and haptic feedback
datasets: teleoperated dexterous demonstrations collected with the glove

title: HOMIE: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Isomorphic Exoskeleton Cockpit

contribution: Builds a low-cost, fast active-vision camera system that reaches sub-millimetre accuracy in fiducial-marker pose estimation.
sensing: actively steered camera with fiducial markers

title: RTAGrasp: Learning Task-Oriented Grasping from Human Videos via Retrieval, Transfer, and Alignment
contribution: Retrieves a relevant human video demonstration, transfers the human grasp constraints to the target object, and aligns them to produce task-oriented robot grasps.
sensing: human demonstration RGB videos; robot RGB-D at test time

title: ForceMimic: Force-Centric Imitation Learning with Force-Motion Capture System for Contact-Rich Manipulation
contribution: Introduces a robot-free handheld capture system that records both force and motion during human demonstrations and trains a hybrid force-motion imitation policy for contact-rich tasks.
sensing: handheld device with 6-axis force/torque sensor and pose tracking

title: How to Train Your Robots? The Impact of Demonstration Modality on Imitation Learning
contribution: Compares demonstration collection modalities such as kinesthetic teaching and teleoperation interfaces on ease of collection and on downstream imitation learning performance.

title: Human-Agent Joint Learning for Efficient Robot Manipulation Skill Acquisition
contribution: Shares control between a human teleoperator and a learning agent during data collection so that the agent takes over more of the work as it learns, reducing human effort in collecting demonstrations.

title: ViViDex: Learning Vision-Based Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos
contribution: Extracts reference hand-object trajectories from human videos, trains state-based dexterous policies with RL and trajectory-guided rewards in simulation, and distills them into a vision-based policy.
sensing: monocular RGB human videos; simulated and real robot cameras

title: Bridging the Human to Robot Dexterity Gap Through Object-Oriented Rewards
contribution: Retargets the hand motion in a single human video to a robot hand and fine-tunes the policy online with rewards computed from object motion tracked in the video and in robot rollouts.
sensing: RGB(-D) human video with hand pose estimation; robot camera

title: SPOT: SE(3) Pose Trajectory Diffusion for Object-Centric Manipulation
contribution: Represents demonstrations as object SE(3) pose trajectories, learns to generate them with a diffusion model, and converts them to robot actions, so human or robot demonstrations can be used without embodiment-specific actions.

title: Mobile-TeleVision: Predictive Motion Priors for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
contribution: Learns predictive motion priors from human motion data so that a humanoid can be teleoperated through VR for upper-body manipulation while its lower body stays balanced.
sensing: VR headset teleoperation; human motion capture data for priors
datasets: human motion capture data (source not checked)

title: Chain-of-Modality: Learning Manipulation Programs from Multimodal Human Videos with Vision-Language-Models
contribution: Prompts a vision-language model to reason over human demonstration videos together with extra signals such as muscle activity and audio, and extracts a manipulation program that a robot then executes.
sensing: RGB video plus wearable force/EMG and audio signals

title: Feasibility-Aware Imitation Learning from Observations Through a Hand-Mounted Demonstration Interface
contribution: Collects demonstrations with a hand-mounted interface worn by the human and accounts for whether demonstrated motions are feasible for the robot when learning from these observations.

title: R+X: Retrieval and Execution from Everyday Human Videos
contribution: Retrieves clips relevant to a language command from long unlabeled first-person human videos with a vision-language model, extracts hand trajectories, and executes the skill on a robot via in-context imitation.

title: ARCap: Collecting High-Quality Human Demonstrations for Robot Learning with Augmented Reality Feedback
contribution: Builds a portable capture system that records human hand demonstrations and shows the demonstrator augmented-reality feedback on whether the robot can reproduce them, for parallel-jaw and multi-finger robots.
sensing: AR headset plus motion-capture gloves and wearable camera

title: Motion Tracks: A Unified Representation for Human-Robot Transfer in Few-Shot Imitation Learning
contribution: Represents actions as short-horizon 2D keypoint tracks in images that are shared by human hands and robot grippers, so policies can be trained on human videos plus a few robot demonstrations and lifted back to 6-DoF.
sensing: multi-view RGB with hand keypoint detection

title: Simultaneous Localization and Affordance Prediction of Tasks from Egocentric Video
contribution: Learns from egocentric human video where in a space tasks are performed, predicting task affordance locations for robot use.

title: One-Shot Video Imitation via Parameterized Symbolic Abstraction Graphs
contribution: Abstracts a single human demonstration video into a graph of objects and relations with physical parameters and uses it to reproduce the task on a robot.

title: LEMMo-Plan: LLM-Enhanced Learning from Multi-Modal Demonstration for Planning Sequential Contact-Rich Manipulation Tasks
contribution: Uses a language model to segment and interpret multimodal human demonstrations (vision plus force/tactile signals) into task plans for sequential contact-rich manipulation.
sensing: RGB video plus wearable tactile/force sensing (details not checked)

title: EgoMimic: Scaling Imitation Learning via Egocentric Video
contribution: Full-stack framework co-training a unified policy on egocentric human data with 3D hand tracking from Project Aria glasses and a low-cost bimanual robot, showing an hour of hand data beats an hour of robot data.
sensing: egocentric RGB glasses (Project Aria) with SLAM and hand tracking
datasets: introduces EgoMimic human and robot data

title: DART: Dexterous Augmented Reality Teleoperation Platform for Large-Scale Robot Data Collection in Simulation
contribution: Lets operators teleoperate dexterous robots in a cloud-hosted simulation through an AR headset with hand tracking, so demonstrations can be collected at scale without physical robots.
sensing: AR headset hand and head tracking

title: ZeroMimic: Distilling Robotic Manipulation Skills from Web Videos
contribution: Distils deployable image-goal-conditioned skill policies for opening, closing, pouring, pick-and-place, cutting and stirring from egocentric human videos without robot demonstrations.
sensing: monocular egocentric RGB web video; robot RGB-D at deployment

title: One-Shot Imitation Under Mismatched Execution
contribution: Imitates a long-horizon task from one human video even when human and robot execute sub-steps differently, by retrieving and composing robot clips matched to the human video with optimal-transport sequence alignment.
sensing: RGB human video and robot video

title: RoboCrowd: Scaling Robot Data Collection Through Crowdsourcing
contribution: Collects bimanual robot demonstrations from members of the public through a crowdsourced teleoperation station with incentive mechanisms, and evaluates the resulting data for policy training.

title: Robot Utility Models: General Policies for Zero-Shot Deployment in New Environments
contribution: Collects large, diverse demonstration sets with a handheld gripper-and-phone tool and trains policies that run in unseen homes without fine-tuning.
sensing: handheld demonstration tool with phone RGB(-D) camera

title: Pose Retargeting from a Single RGB Camera: Optimization-Based Hand Pose Retargeting and Wrist Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates the operator's hand pose with MediaPipe and recovers the wrist pose by optimization-based 2D/3D hand-joint matching with hand-based camera calibration, retargeting both to a robot for teleoperation data collection.

title: HOGraspFlow: Taxonomy-Aware Hand-Object Retargeting for Multi-Modal SE(3) Grasp Generation
contribution: Retargets a single RGB image of a hand-object interaction into multi-modal executable SE(3) parallel-jaw grasps using flow matching conditioned on foundation-model features, reconstructed HOI contacts and a grasp-taxonomy prior.

title: TransDexNet: An End-To-End Motion Retargeting Network with Transformer for Dexterous Hand Teleoperation from RGB Images
contribution: Regresses dexterous robot-hand joint angles directly from a single RGB image of a human hand with a dual-branch Vision Transformer and introduces the paired TransDexData set of 91,000 human/robot hand images.
sensing: monocular RGB image of the operator hand

title: Robust Hand Tracking from Visual-Inertial Fusion
contribution: Tracks the hand markerlessly during object manipulation by fusing high-rate glove IMU propagation with a lightweight ViT keypoint detector in probabilistic inference, trained on an annotation-free synthetic and real data generation scheme.
datasets: synthetic and real glove data generated by the authors

title: TIGeR: Text-Instructed Generation and Refinement for Template-Free Hand-Object Interaction
contribution: Reconstructs the shape and pose of a hand-held object without a pre-defined template by generating a text-driven shape prior with off-the-shelf models and calibrating it to the image via 2D-3D collaborative attention.

title: Simultaneous Extrinsic Contact and In-Hand Pose Estimation Via Distributed Tactile Sensing
contribution: Jointly estimates in-hand object pose and extrinsic contacts in a factor graph that combines distributed tactile observations with quasi-static rigid-body kinematic and force constraints.
sensing: distributed tactile sensors on the gripper (vision optional)

title: Filament Sliding Linear Potentiometer-Based Data Glove (FLiPo) for Precisely Annotating Human Finger Poses
contribution: Builds a data glove whose 0.1 mm filaments and arm-mounted linear potentiometers measure finger joint angles (2.15 deg MAE) while leaving finger appearance visible, with an occlusion score, to enable automatic finger-pose annotation of RGB images.
sensing: wearable filament/potentiometer glove plus RGB cameras

title: APEX-Glove: An Actuated, Open-Source, Hand-Exoskeleton Glove for Finger Motion Tracking and Kinesthetic 3D Force Feedback
contribution: Builds an open-source dorsal-mounted hand-exoskeleton glove that tracks finger motion and renders active 3D kinesthetic force feedback, with data-driven actuator compensation, for dexterous robot-hand teleoperation and data collection.
sensing: wearable hand exoskeleton (joint encoders, Dynamixel actuators)

title: Rendering Multi-Human and Multi-Object with 3D Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Renders dynamic scenes of multiple interacting humans and objects from sparse views with MM-GS, a hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting framework with per-instance multi-view fusion and scene-graph interaction refinement under mutual occlusion.

title: ExFMan: Rendering 3D Dynamic Humans with Hybrid Monocular Blurry Frames and Events
contribution: Reconstructs and renders 3D dynamic humans in rapid motion from monocular blurry RGB frames fused with event-camera data in a neural rendering framework.

title: Stereo-Inertial Poser: Towards Metric-Accurate Shape-Aware Motion Capture Using Sparse IMUs and a Single Stereo Camera
contribution: Performs real-time (over 200 FPS) metric-accurate, shape-aware full-body motion capture by fusing 3D keypoints and body shape from a single stereo camera with six IMUs.
sensing: single stereo camera plus six body-worn IMUs
datasets: multiple public datasets (not named in abstract)

title: HHI-Assist: A Dataset and Benchmark of Human-Human Interaction in Physical Assistance Scenario
contribution: Releases a motion-capture dataset of caregiver/care-receiver physical assistance interactions and a conditional Transformer diffusion model that predicts the poses of both interacting people.

title: Integrating Artificial Vision and Wearable Robotics: Adaptive Assistance Enabled by Manipulation Context Awareness
contribution: Drives a bimanual upper-limb soft exoskeleton from vision by combining tool recognition and segmentation with hand tracking and gesture recognition, modulating lifting assistance by grasped-object weight and remaining robust to hand-object occlusion.

title: A Physiotherapy Video Matching Method Supporting Arbitrary Camera Placement Via Angle-Of-Limb-Based Posture Structures
contribution: Aligns patient and mentor physiotherapy exercise videos recorded from arbitrary phone viewpoints using Angle-of-Limb posture structures, a camera-angle-free transform and a three-phase matching algorithm.
sensing: monocular RGB video from mobile devices

title: Enabling Automated and Personalized Motor Assessment in Neurorehabilitation: Generating Patient-Specific Reference Movements with a Virtual Humanoid Twin
contribution: Generates patient-specific upper-limb reference motions from the patient's hand pose with a personalized Virtual Humanoid Twin solved as an ergonomic optimal-control problem, validated on reaching and pouring with and without an elbow orthosis.
sensing: human hand pose input; capture sensor not stated in abstract

title: Towards Real-World Identification of Fatigued Muscle Groups Via Musculoskeletal Simulation
contribution: Identifies which upper-limb muscle group is fatigued without contact by comparing a subject's real free-space motion with motions simulated under fatigue conditions in a physics-based musculoskeletal model.
sensing: contactless motion measurement of the arm (sensor not stated in abstract)

title: Robotic Classification of Divers' Swimming States Using Visual Pose Keypoints As IMUs
contribution: Turns 3D human joint keypoints estimated from AUV camera video into pseudo-IMU signals to classify scuba-diver swimming states and detect distress onboard an AUV.
sensing: camera on an autonomous underwater vehicle (vision-derived 3D keypoints)

title: Legs Over Arms: On the Predictive Value of Lower-Body Pose for Human Trajectory Prediction from Egocentric Robot Perception
contribution: Evaluates 2D/3D skeletal keypoints and biomechanical cues as inputs to multi-agent human trajectory prediction from robot perception and finds lower-body 3D keypoints most predictive.

title: Real-Time Sit-To-Stand Phase Classification with a Mobile Assistive Robot from Close Proximity Utilizing 3D Visual Skeleton Recognition
contribution: Classifies sit-to-stand phases in real time from 3D visual skeleton recognition at close proximity on a robotic walker that assists standing.
sensing: robot-mounted camera at close range (3D skeleton); exact modality not stated in abstract excerpt

title: Diffusion Policy for Robot-Assisted Dressing with Moving Human Arms
contribution: Late-breaking result listed in the ICRA 2026 technical program: learns a point-cloud diffusion dressing policy and infers the moving human arm's axial distribution from cluttered points with a diffused scalar field and local registration.
sensing: point clouds from a depth camera

title: MGS-Track: Monocular 6DoF Pose Tracking Via Masked 3D Prior and Online Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Tracks the 6DoF pose of unseen objects from monocular RGB video by initializing an online 3D Gaussian Splatting model from mask-augmented DUSt3R point maps and jointly optimizing Gaussians and pose.

title: Keypoint-Based Dynamic Object 6-DoF Pose Tracking Via Event Camera
contribution: Tracks the 6-DoF pose of fast-moving objects by detecting keypoints in event-stream time surfaces and tracking them for pose estimation.

title: Event-Based Motion & Appearance Fusion for 6D Object Pose Tracking
contribution: Tracks 6D object pose at high speed without learning by propagating pose with object velocity from event-based optical flow and correcting it with template-based local refinement.

title: DynOPETs: A Versatile Benchmark for Dynamic Object Pose Estimation and Tracking in Moving Camera Scenarios
contribution: Introduces a real-world dataset and pseudo-label annotation pipeline (pose estimation plus tracking refined by pose-graph optimization) for dynamic object pose estimation and tracking from moving cameras, benchmarking 18 methods.
sensing: moving-camera video (modality not specified in abstract)

title: HIPPo: Harnessing Image-To-3D Priors for Model-Free Zero-Shot 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates 6D pose of novel objects without CAD models or reference images by generating a mesh from a single glance with a multiview-diffusion image-to-3D prior and refining it online from new observations.
sensing: camera observations from a single glance onward (modality not specified in abstract excerpt)

title: InstantPose: Zero-Shot Instance-Level 6D Pose Estimation from a Single View
contribution: Estimates instance-level 6D pose of unseen objects from a single view by building the object model with a Large Reconstruction Model instead of a CAD model or multiple views.

title: M-VTOP: Modular Visuo-Tactile Object Pose Estimation for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Estimates in-hand object pose to sub-millimeter accuracy with a modular particle filter that fuses vision, tactile and contact observations through a mask-based geometric representation, requiring only a CAD model.
sensing: camera plus tactile and contact sensing

title: InvariantCloud: A Globally Invariant, Uniquely Indexed Point Cloud Framework for Robust 6-DoF Tactile Pose Tracking
contribution: Tracks 6-DoF object pose from vision-based tactile sensors by one-shot globally invariant registration of uniquely indexed marker-constellation point clouds, suppressing drift and yaw error.

title: TwinTrack: Bridging Vision and Contact Physics for Real-Time Tracking of Unknown Objects in Contact-Rich Scenes
contribution: Tracks unseen dynamic objects in real time during contact-rich scenes such as multi-fingered in-hand manipulation by fusing a visual tracker with predictions from a contact-physics digital twin whose geometry and physical parameters are estimated online.
sensing: vision-based tracker plus GPU physics simulation (MJX)

title: DisFlow: Scene Flow from Distance Field for Object Pose, Velocity Tracking, and Surface Reconstruction
contribution: Estimates scene flow from a Gaussian-process implicit distance field to obtain 6DoF dynamic object pose, velocity tracking and surface reconstruction online.

title: Color-Pair Guided Robust Zero-Shot 6D Pose Estimation and Tracking of Cluttered Objects on Edge Devices
contribution: Estimates and tracks the 6D pose of novel textured objects in clutter on edge devices with a lighting-invariant color-pair feature shared by registration-based initialization and a fast motion-based tracker.

title: SE(3)-PoseFlow: Estimating 6D Pose Distributions for Uncertainty-Aware Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Estimates multi-modal 6D object pose distributions with flow matching on SE(3) to represent ambiguity from occlusion and symmetry for uncertainty-aware manipulation.

title: Active Tactile Exploration for Rigid Body Pose and Shape Estimation
contribution: Simultaneously estimates shape and location of unrestrained rigid objects from tactile data alone with a learning and active exploration framework.

title: SilRef: Joint Visual Silhouette and Tactile Pose Optimization for Transparent Object Manipulation
contribution: Optimizes transparent-object pose jointly from visual silhouettes and tactile measurements for manipulation (abstract not available in the program listing; described from the title).
sensing: RGB silhouettes plus tactile sensing (from title)

title: Benchmarking the Effects of Object Pose Estimation and Reconstruction on Robotic Grasping Success
contribution: Benchmarks how errors in object pose estimation and object reconstruction affect robotic grasping success (abstract not available in the program listing; described from the title).

title: IndustryShapes: An RGB-D Benchmark Dataset for 6D Object Pose Estimation of Industrial Assembly Components and Tools
contribution: Introduces an RGB-D benchmark of industrial tools and assembly components for instance-level and novel-object 6D pose estimation in realistic manufacturing settings.

title: Learning 6D Object Pose Estimation with Event Cameras Using Synthetic Data and Domain Randomization
contribution: Learns 6D object pose estimation from event-camera data using synthetic training data with domain randomization.

title: GraspClutter6D: A Large-Scale Real-World Dataset for Robust Perception and Grasping in Cluttered Scenes
contribution: Introduces a real-world dataset of 1,000 highly cluttered scenes (14.1 objects per scene, 62.6 percent occlusion) over 200 objects with annotations for perception and grasping under heavy occlusion.

title: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
contribution: Learns bimanual robot policies from a single-arm robot by collecting demonstrations where a teleoperated arm performs one side of the task and a human the other, then swapping roles.

title: LLM-Handover: Exploiting LLMs for Task-Oriented Robot-Human Handovers
contribution: Selects task-oriented robot-to-human handover grasps by combining LLM reasoning about the receiver's next action with object part segmentation from an RGB-D image.

title: ROPA: Synthetic Robot Pose Generation for RGB-D Bimanual Data Augmentation
contribution: Augments third-person RGB-D bimanual demonstrations by synthesizing novel robot poses with paired action labels for imitation learning.

title: Towards Exploratory and Focused Manipulation with Bimanual Active Perception: A New Problem, Benchmark and Strategy
contribution: Defines a bimanual active-perception manipulation problem together with a benchmark and a strategy (abstract not available in the program listing; described from the title).

title: DemoBot: Efficient Learning of Bimanual Manipulation with Dexterous Hands from Third-Person Human Videos
contribution: Extracts both-hand and object trajectories from a single unannotated RGB-D human video and refines them with temporally segmented reinforcement learning for long-horizon bimanual dexterous assembly.

title: Masquerade: Learning from In-The-Wild Human Videos Using Data-Editing
contribution: Edits in-the-wild egocentric human videos into robotized bimanual demonstrations by estimating 3D hand poses, inpainting arms and overlaying a rendered robot, then co-trains policies on them.
datasets: 675K edited frames from in-the-wild human video

title: TWIST2: Scalable, Portable, and Holistic Humanoid Data Collection System
contribution: Builds a portable mocap-free humanoid teleoperation and data collection system using PICO4U VR whole-body human motion tracking and a 2-DoF robot neck with egocentric vision.
sensing: VR headset and body trackers (PICO4U) plus egocentric camera on a 2-DoF robot neck

title: EgoMI: Learning Active Vision and Whole-Body Manipulation from Egocentric Human Demonstrations
contribution: Captures synchronized end-effector and active head trajectories during human manipulation and retargets them to a bimanual robot with an actuated camera head, using a memory-augmented policy.
sensing: egocentric head-mounted camera plus end-effector trajectory tracking

title: ActiveUMI: Robotic Manipulation with Active Perception from Robot-Free Human Demonstrations
contribution: Transfers in-the-wild human demonstrations to bimanual robots with a portable VR kit and sensorized controllers that mirror the end-effectors while recording active egocentric head-camera perception.
sensing: VR headset with egocentric camera plus tracked hand-held controllers

title: DexTele: A Dual-Arm Dexterous Teleoperation System Based on Motion Retargeting and Adaptive Force Control
contribution: Teleoperates dual-arm dexterous robots with vision-based motion retargeting from human images (motion-graph encoder plus latent optimization) and VLM-plus-MPC adaptive grasp-force control.

title: Developing Vision-Language-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
contribution: Extracts 6DoF object manipulation trajectories from raw egocentric videos with EgoScaler to build a large VLA pretraining dataset and pretrains a pi0 policy on it.
datasets: four large-scale egocentric video datasets (not named in abstract)

title: UMI-On-Air: Embodiment-Aware Guidance for Embodiment-Agnostic Visuomotor Policies
contribution: Deploys policies trained on handheld-gripper UMI human demonstrations to aerial manipulators with an embodiment-aware diffusion policy that guides sampling with the robot's controller feedback.

title: MIMO: A Multimodal Imitation Learning Framework for Mobile Manipulation with Exoskeleton-VR Teleoperation
contribution: Combines an exoskeleton-VR teleoperation system for single-operator whole-body mobile manipulation with a multimodal imitation learning policy.

title: Learning Generalizable Robot Policy with Human Demonstration Video As a Prompt
contribution: Trains a policy that takes a human demonstration video as a prompt, via a cross-predictive human/robot video generation model and a prototypical contrastive shared action space.

title: Influence of Gripper Design on Human Demonstration Quality for Robot Learning
contribution: Evaluates how UMI handheld gripper designs affect human demonstration quality and usability on a medical bandage-opening task.

title: In-The-Wild Compliant Manipulation with UMI-FT
contribution: Adds six-axis force/torque sensors to each finger of a handheld UMI data-collection device and trains an adaptive-compliance policy from the multimodal data.
sensing: handheld gripper with RGB, depth, pose and finger F/T sensors

title: Zero-Shot Exocentric Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning (VIL): Bridging Handheld Gripper and Exocentric Views
contribution: Aligns handheld-gripper demonstrations with exocentric camera views so imitation policies are robust to third-person viewpoint shifts.
sensing: handheld gripper wrist camera plus exocentric cameras

title: Flow-Enabled Generalization to Human Demonstrations in Few-Shot Imitation Learning
contribution: Uses flow of the interaction between hand or robot and object as an intermediate representation so few-shot imitation policies generalize from human demonstrations.

title: EMMA: Scaling Mobile Manipulation Via Egocentric Human Data
contribution: Co-trains mobile manipulation policies on egocentric human full-body motion data and static robot data, avoiding mobile robot teleoperation.
sensing: egocentric human recordings plus robot cameras
datasets: authors' human data; Mobile ALOHA baselines

title: Scaling Single Human Demonstrations for Imitation Learning Using Generative Foundational Models
contribution: Transfers a single human demonstration into simulation where a programmable expert generates many demonstrations to train a manipulation policy (Real2Gen).

title: Dexterity from Smart Lenses: Multi-Fingered Robot Manipulation with In-The-Wild Human Demonstrations
contribution: Learns multi-fingered robot policies from in-the-wild human demonstrations recorded with Aria Gen 2 glasses using on-board head and hand poses and stereo depth for 3D point-based policies (Aina).
sensing: egocentric smart glasses (Aria Gen 2: RGB, stereo, 3D hand and head pose)

title: EasyMimic: A Low-Cost Framework for Robot Imitation Learning from Human Videos
contribution: Extracts 3D hand trajectories from RGB human videos, maps them to a low-cost gripper action space with hand visual augmentation, and co-trains with a little robot data.

title: RoboPCA: Pose-Centered Affordance Learning from Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
contribution: Jointly predicts contact regions and contact poses as pose-centered affordances learned from human demonstrations for robot manipulation.
datasets: human demonstration data (not named in abstract)

title: OCRA: Object-Centric Learning with 3D and Tactile Priors for Human-To-Robot Action Transfer
contribution: Reconstructs object-centric 3D point clouds from multi-view RGB human demonstration videos with VGGT and adds tactile priors to transfer actions to robots.
sensing: multi-view RGB video plus tactile priors

title: DemoDiffusion: One-Shot Human Imitation Using Pre-Trained Diffusion Policy
contribution: Imitates a single human demonstration by kinematically retargeting hand motion to an end-effector trajectory and refining it with a pre-trained diffusion policy.
sensing: RGB video of a human demonstration

title: X-Diffusion: Training Diffusion Policies on Cross-Embodiment Human Demonstrations
contribution: Trains diffusion policies on human video actions only at high-noise timesteps, treating human actions as noisy robot actions to avoid infeasible embodiment-specific behavior.
sensing: human RGB videos plus robot data

title: Generate, Transfer, Adapt: Learning Functional Dexterous Grasping from a Single Human Demonstration
contribution: Generates synthetic functional dexterous grasp data from a single human demonstration via correspondence-based transfer and optimization, then trains a multimodal grasp predictor (CorDex).
datasets: synthetic data generated by the method

title: RynnVLA-001: Using Human Demonstrations to Improve Robot Manipulation
contribution: Two-stage VLA pre-training: egocentric video generative pre-training on 12M manipulation videos and human-centric trajectory-aware modelling of keypoint trajectories, plus ActionVAE.

title: FreeTacMan: Robot-Free Visuo-Tactile Data Collection System for Contact-Rich Manipulation
contribution: Builds a human-centric robot-free visuo-tactile data collection device for contact-rich manipulation demonstrations.
sensing: wearable visuo-tactile gripper device with camera

title: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Model Pretraining for Robotic Dexterous Manipulation with Real-Life Human Activity Videos
contribution: Converts unscripted egocentric human hand videos into a 1M-episode hand-VLA dataset with framewise 3D hand and camera motion and language, and pretrains a dexterous-hand VLA on it.

title: Few-Shot Transfer of Tool-Use Skills Using Human Demonstrations with Proximity and Tactile Sensing
contribution: Transfers tool-use skills from few human demonstrations using proximity and tactile sensing with simulation-based pretraining.

title: Video-To-BT: Generating Reactive Behavior Trees from Human Demonstration Videos for Robotic Assembly
contribution: Generates reactive behavior trees for robotic assembly from human demonstration videos with VLM-based planning.

title: TacUMI: A Multi-Modal Universal Manipulation Interface for Contact-Rich Tasks
contribution: Extends the UMI handheld demonstration device with multi-modal tactile and force sensing and segments demonstrations into task modules.
sensing: handheld gripper with camera plus tactile/force sensors

title: HumanoidExo: Scalable Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation Via Wearable Exoskeleton
contribution: Collects whole-body humanoid training data by transferring human motion captured with a wearable exoskeleton, used alongside few real-robot demonstrations.

title: Joint Flow Trajectory Optimization for Feasible Robot Motion Generation from Video Demonstrations
contribution: Generates feasible robot grasp poses and object trajectories from human video demonstrations by treating them as object-centric guides in a joint trajectory optimization.

title: HAND Me the Data: Fast Robot Adaptation Via Hand Path Retrieval
contribution: Extracts human hand motion from a demonstration with a visual tracking pipeline and retrieves matching robot sub-trajectories from play data to fine-tune a policy in minutes.

title: MimicDroid: In-Context Learning for Humanoid Robot Manipulation from Human Play Videos
contribution: In-context learning for humanoid manipulation trained from human play videos, adapting to new tasks from a few human video prompts.

title: ViSA-Flow: Accelerating Robot Skill Learning Via Large-Scale Video Semantic Action Flow
contribution: Learns semantic action flow capturing manipulator-object interactions self-supervised from unlabeled large-scale video and transfers it to robot skill learning.

title: MotionTrans: Human VR Data Enable Motion-Level Learning for Robotic Manipulation Policies
contribution: VR human data collection, human-to-robot transformation and weighted co-training that transfers more than 10 motions from human data to robot policies across 30 tasks.
sensing: VR headset hand and head tracking
datasets: human VR data collected by the authors

title: PokeNet: Learning Kinematic Models of Articulated Objects from Human Observations
contribution: Learns kinematic models of multi-DoF articulated objects, including manipulation order and joints revealed only during interaction, from point clouds of humans interacting with them.

title: AMPLIFY: Actionless Motion Priors for Robot Learning from Videos
contribution: Encodes visual dynamics of action-free videos as discrete keypoint-trajectory motion tokens and decouples motion prediction from action inference for policy learning.

title: Actron3D: Learning Actionable Neural Functions from Videos for Transferable Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Learns transferable 6-DoF manipulation skills from monocular uncalibrated RGB human videos by distilling geometry, contact priors and action flows into a neural affordance function.

title: Deep Sensorimotor Control by Imitating Predictive Models of Human Motion
contribution: Trains robot sensorimotor policies with RL by imitating a model that predicts future human keypoint motion, applied zero-shot to robot end-effector keypoints.
sensing: human motion data and robot cameras

title: OmniRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Data Generation for Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation and Scene Interaction
contribution: Generates humanoid loco-manipulation reference data by interaction-preserving retargeting of human motion that keeps human-object and human-environment contacts.

title: Retargeting Matters: General Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Motion Tracking
contribution: Proposes a general motion retargeting method that reduces foot sliding and penetration artifacts when converting human motion to humanoid tracking references.

title: CDF-Glove: A Cable-Driven Force Feedback Glove for Dexterous Teleoperation
contribution: Builds a cable-driven force-feedback glove for dexterous robot-hand teleoperation (abstract not available in the program listing; described from the title).

title: Low-Dimensional Tactile Glove for Visuo-Tactile Robot Hand Control: A Preliminary Study
contribution: Late-breaking result listed in the ICRA 2026 technical program: builds a low-cost low-dimensional tactile glove to collect visuo-tactile data for controlling robot hands.

title: SignBot: Learning Human-To-Humanoid Sign Language Interaction
contribution: Retargets human sign-language motions to a humanoid and enables sign-language interaction between humans and the robot.
sensing: human sign motion data and camera input

title: Prepare before You Act: Learning from Humans to Rearrange Initial States
contribution: Learns from human demonstrations how to rearrange atypical initial states before running an imitation policy.

title: Kaiwu: A Multimodal Manipulation Dataset and Framework for Robot Learning and Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Releases an assembly manipulation dataset of 20 subjects and 30 objects (11,664 action instances) with hand motion, pressure, sound, multi-view video, motion capture, egocentric gaze video and EMG.
sensing: multi-view video, motion capture, hand-motion and pressure sensing, eye tracker, EMG

title: Grasp Like Humans: Learning Generalizable Multi-Fingered Grasping from Human Proprioceptive Sensorimotor Integration
contribution: Captures joint-level tactile and kinesthetic data from human hand demonstrations with a data glove usable on both human and robot hands, represents them as polar-coordinate graphs, and trains a tactile-kinesthetic spatio-temporal graph network to transfer grasping skills to multi-fingered robot hands.

title: UniFucGrasp: Human-Hand-Inspired Unified Functional Grasp Annotation Strategy and Dataset for Diverse Dexterous Hands
contribution: Introduces a functional grasp annotation strategy and dataset that maps natural human hand motions to multiple dexterous hand types with force-closure checks.
sensing: human hand motion mapping (capture device not stated in abstract)

title: DreamControl: Human-Inspired Whole-Body Humanoid Control for Scene Interaction Via Guided Diffusion
contribution: Guides RL of humanoid whole-body scene-interaction skills such as drawer opening and object pickup with a diffusion prior trained on human motion data.

title: Low-Latency VR Telepresence for Remote Inspection in Fence-Free Collaborative Manufacturing
contribution: Late-breaking result listed in the ICRA 2026 technical program: deploys an open-source mobile inspection robot with low-latency head-coupled VR video telepresence for safety assessment in collaborative manufacturing.
sensing: robot cameras streamed to a VR headset

title: Human-In-The-Loop Gaussian Splatting for Robotic Teleoperation
contribution: Builds a real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting third-person view for teleoperation with human-guided multi-view image acquisition.

title: CaFe-TeleVision: A Coarse-To-Fine Teleoperation System with Immersive Situated Visualization for Enhanced Ergonomics
contribution: Builds a coarse-to-fine teleoperation system with immersive situated visualization and a retargeting module to improve efficiency and ergonomics of teleoperation and data collection.
sensing: VR headset plus multi-view robot cameras

title: VividFace: Real-Time and Realistic Facial Expression Shadowing for Humanoid Robots
contribution: Shadows human facial expressions on a humanoid robot face in real time with realistic expressiveness.
sensing: monocular RGB camera of the human face

title: OmniRace: 6D Hand Pose Estimation for Intuitive Guidance of Racing Drone
contribution: Estimates the 6D pose of the user's hand from a camera and maps it to commands for guiding a racing drone.
sensing: single camera hand tracking (detail not checked)

title: Object Augmentation Algorithm: Computing virtual object motion and object induced interaction wrench from optical markers
contribution: Computes the motion of a manipulated object and the interaction wrench it induces on the human body from optical marker data, augmenting human motion capture with the object.

title: Contacts from Motion: Learning Discrete Features for Automatic Contact Detection and Estimation from Human Movements
contribution: Learns discrete motion features to automatically detect and estimate contacts between the human body and the environment from captured human movement.
sensing: human motion data (capture modality not checked)

title: ContactHandover: Contact-Guided Robot-to-Human Object Handover
contribution: Robot-to-human handover that predicts 6-DoF robot grasps together with a 3D map of human contact points and delivers the object to maximize the receiver's accessible contacts.
sensing: RGB-D / object point cloud (detail not checked)

title: Compliant Blind Handover Control for Human-Robot Collaboration
contribution: Designs a compliant robot controller for handing objects to a human who is not looking at the robot during collaboration.

title: Enhanced Robotic Assistance for Human Activities through Human-Object Interaction Segment Prediction
contribution: Predicts upcoming human-object interaction segments in an activity so that a robot can provide timely assistance.
sensing: video of human activities (detail not checked)

title: Rethinking 3D Geometric Object Features for Enhancing Skeleton-based Action Recognition
contribution: Adds 3D geometric features of manipulated objects to human skeleton sequences to improve recognition of human-object actions.
sensing: 3D human skeletons plus object geometry (capture modality not checked)

title: DuCAS: a knowledge-enhanced dual-hand compositional action segmentation method for human-robot collaborative assembly
contribution: Segments the compositional actions of a worker's two hands during assembly using a knowledge-enhanced model to support human-robot collaboration.
sensing: video of bimanual assembly (detail not checked)

title: Formalization of Temporal and Spatial Constraints of Bimanual Manipulation Categories
contribution: Formalizes the temporal and spatial coordination constraints that distinguish categories of bimanual manipulation, for recognition from human demonstration and robot execution.
sensing: bimanual human demonstrations (capture modality not checked)

title: Learning Symbolic and Subsymbolic Temporal Task Constraints from Bimanual Human Demonstrations
contribution: Learns symbolic and subsymbolic temporal constraints between actions of the two hands from bimanual human demonstrations for robot task execution.
sensing: bimanual human demonstrations (capture modality not checked)

title: Multi-task real-robot data with gaze attention for dual-arm fine manipulation
contribution: Collects a multi-task dataset of teleoperated dual-arm fine manipulation with operator gaze and trains gaze-attention policies on it.
sensing: teleoperation with operator gaze tracking and robot cameras

title: Learning Variable Compliance Control From a Few Demonstrations for Bimanual Robot with Haptic Feedback Teleoperation System
contribution: Collects bimanual demonstrations with a haptic-feedback teleoperation system and learns variable-compliance control policies from a few of them.

title: GELLO: A General, Low-Cost, and Intuitive Teleoperation Framework for Robot Manipulators
contribution: Builds low-cost, 3D-printed, kinematically matched replica arms with off-the-shelf servos for collecting teleoperated manipulation demonstrations, including bimanual setups.
sensing: joint encoders on a scaled kinematic replica arm

title: Learning Human-to-Humanoid Real-Time Whole-Body Teleoperation
contribution: Retargets and filters human motion data and trains an RL controller so a humanoid robot imitates a human's whole-body motion captured in real time by an RGB camera.
sensing: monocular RGB camera human pose estimation

title: Real-time Dexterous Telemanipulation with an End-Effect-Oriented Learning-based Approach
contribution: Learns a mapping from operator hand motion to dexterous robot hand actions that targets the effect on the object rather than joint-level hand retargeting.

title: Translating Agent-Environment Interactions from Humans to Robots
contribution: Learns to translate human-environment interaction sequences into corresponding robot-environment interactions for transfer of manipulation skills.
sensing: human interaction data (capture modality not checked)

title: One-Shot Transfer of Long-Horizon Extrinsic Manipulation Through Contact Retargeting
contribution: Transfers a single demonstration of long-horizon extrinsic (environment-contact) manipulation to new objects by retargeting its contact requirements.

title: DITTO: Demonstration Imitation by Trajectory Transformation
contribution: One-shot imitation from a single RGB-D human demonstration by extracting object relative trajectories offline and warping them to the new scene online for robot execution.
sensing: RGB-D video of a human demonstration (detail not checked)

title: Visual Imitation Learning of Task-Oriented Object Grasping and Rearrangement
contribution: Learns task-oriented grasping and object rearrangement from visual observation of demonstrations by representing object poses and relations.

title: SculptDiff: Learning Robotic Clay Sculpting from Humans with Goal Conditioned Diffusion Policy
contribution: Trains a goal-conditioned diffusion policy for robotic clay sculpting from human demonstrations.
sensing: human demonstrations with point-cloud observations (detail not checked)

title: Redefining Data Pairing for Motion Retargeting Leveraging a Human Body Prior
contribution: Builds human-robot training pairs for learned motion retargeting using a human body prior, to map human poses onto a robot.
sensing: human pose data (capture modality not checked)

title: An Optimization based Scheme for Real-time Transfer of Human Arm Motion to Robot Arm
contribution: Transfers tracked human arm motion to a robot arm in real time by solving an optimization over the robot kinematics.
sensing: human arm motion tracking (sensor not checked)

title: Is a Simulation better than Teleoperation for Acquiring Human Manipulation Data?
contribution: Compares collecting human manipulation demonstrations in simulation against real-robot teleoperation in terms of data quality and policy learning.
sensing: teleoperation and simulation interfaces (detail not checked)

title: ARCADE: Scalable Demonstration Collection and Generation via Augmented Reality for Imitation Learning
contribution: Collects robot demonstrations through an augmented-reality interface and generates additional demonstrations from them for imitation learning.

title: RADAR: Robotics Assembly by Demonstration via Augmented Reality
contribution: Lets a user demonstrate assembly tasks in augmented reality and converts the demonstrations into robot assembly programs.

title: Incremental Learning of Robotic Manipulation Tasks through Virtual Reality Demonstrations
contribution: Learns manipulation tasks incrementally from demonstrations given by a human in virtual reality.
sensing: VR headset and controllers (detail not checked)

title: Self Supervised Detection of Incorrect Human Demonstrations: A Path Toward Safe Imitation Learning by Robots in the Wild
contribution: Detects incorrect human demonstrations with a self-supervised model before they are used for robot imitation learning.

title: Diffusion-PbD: Generalizable Robot Programming by Demonstration with Diffusion Features
contribution: Uses features from pretrained diffusion models to generalize a single programming-by-demonstration example to new objects and scenes.

title: Reality Fusion: Robust Real-time Immersive Mobile Robot Teleoperation with Volumetric Visual Data Fusion
contribution: Fuses volumetric visual data of the remote scene into an immersive real-time view for teleoperating a mobile robot.
sensing: robot-mounted RGB-D / volumetric sensing, VR display

title: Radiance Fields for Robotic Teleoperation
contribution: Builds radiance-field reconstructions of the remote scene online and renders them as the operator's view for robot teleoperation.
sensing: robot cameras, VR display (detail not checked)

title: Immersive Human-in-the-Loop Control: Real-Time 3D Surface Meshing and Physics Simulation
contribution: Meshes the remote scene surfaces in real time and runs a physics simulation on them to give the human operator an immersive control view.
sensing: depth sensing of the remote scene (detail not checked)

title: Multi-View 2D to 3D Lifting Video-Based Optimization: A Robust Approach for Human Pose Estimation with Occluded Joint Prediction
contribution: Lifts multi-view 2D detections to 3D human pose with a video-based optimization that predicts occluded joints.

title: Exploring 3D Human Pose Estimation and Forecasting from the Robot's Perspective: The HARPER Dataset
contribution: Introduces a dataset of human-robot interactions recorded from a low-mounted robot's perspective and benchmarks 3D human pose estimation and forecasting on it.
sensing: robot-mounted cameras with motion-capture ground truth (detail not checked)

title: Active Human Pose Estimation via an Autonomous UAV Agent
contribution: Controls a UAV's viewpoint so that its camera reduces self-occlusion when estimating a person's pose.

title: A Real-time Filter for Human Pose Estimation based on Denoising Diffusion Models for Edge Devices
contribution: Filters noisy human pose estimates in real time on edge devices using a denoising diffusion model.
sensing: camera-based human pose estimates (detail not checked)

title: Human Orientation Estimation under Partial Observation
contribution: Estimates a person's body orientation when the body is only partially observed by the robot's sensor.

title: Dual-Branch Graph Transformer Network for 3D Human Mesh Reconstruction from Video
contribution: Reconstructs temporally consistent 3D human meshes from video with a dual-branch graph transformer.

title: A Robotic-centric Paradigm for 3D Human Tracking Under Complex Environments Using Multi-modal Adaptation
contribution: Tracks humans in 3D from a robot in complex environments by adapting across multiple sensing modalities.

title: Optimizing Interaction Space: Enlarging the Capture Volume for Multiple Portable Motion Capture Devices
contribution: Combines and places several portable motion capture devices to enlarge the usable capture volume.

title: GazeMotion: Gaze-guided Human Motion Forecasting
contribution: Forecasts future human body motion using eye gaze together with past body poses.
sensing: eye gaze plus body pose sequences (capture setup not checked)

title: Map-Aware Human Pose Prediction for Robot Follow-Ahead
contribution: Predicts future human poses conditioned on the scene map so a robot can move ahead of the person it follows.

title: Functional kinematic and kinetic requirements of the upper limb during activities of daily living: a recommendation on necessary joint capabilities for prosthetic arms
contribution: Analyzes upper-limb joint kinematics and kinetics during activities of daily living to recommend the joint capabilities a prosthetic arm needs.
sensing: human upper-limb motion data (capture modality not checked)

title: Insert-One: One-Shot Robust Visual-Force Servoing for Novel Object Insertion with 6-DoF Tracking
contribution: Tracks the 6-DoF pose of a novel grasped object and combines it with force feedback to servo the object into an insertion from one demonstration.
sensing: camera plus force sensing (detail not checked)

title: PEGASUS: Physically Enhanced Gaussian Splatting Simulation System for 6DOF Object Pose Dataset Generation
contribution: Composes Gaussian-splatting object and environment scans with physics simulation to generate labeled 6-DoF object pose datasets.
sensing: multi-view RGB scans for Gaussian splatting

title: Zero123-6D: Zero-shot Novel View Synthesis for RGB Category-level 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Uses a zero-shot novel-view-synthesis model to expand reference views for category-level 6D object pose estimation from RGB.

title: DiffusionNOCS: Managing Symmetry and Uncertainty in Sim2Real Multi-Modal Category-level Pose Estimation
contribution: Predicts NOCS maps with a diffusion model to handle symmetry and ambiguity in category-level object pose estimation trained in simulation.

title: MV-ROPE: Multi-view Constraints for Robust Category-level Object Pose and Size Estimation
contribution: Adds multi-view constraints over a camera sequence to make category-level object pose and size estimation more robust.
sensing: RGB video from a moving camera

title: ToolEENet: Tool Affordance 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Estimates the 6D pose of a tool's functional end-effector (affordance part) for tool manipulation.

title: Precise Well-plate Placing Utilizing Contact During Sliding with Tactile-based Pose Estimation for Laboratory Automation
contribution: Estimates the in-hand pose of a grasped well plate from tactile contact while sliding it, and uses the estimate for precise placement.

title: Design of Upper-Limb Exoskeleton with Distal Branching Link Mechanism for Bilateral Operation of Humanoid Robots
contribution: Designs an upper-limb exoskeleton with a distal branching link mechanism that captures operator arm motion for bilateral teleoperation of humanoid robots.

title: A Tactile Lightweight Exoskeleton for Teleoperation: Design and Control Performance
contribution: Designs a lightweight arm exoskeleton with tactile feedback for teleoperation and evaluates its control performance.

title: 3D-AMTA: Occlusion-Aware Real-Time 3D Hand Pose Estimation with Auto Mask and Token-Specific Attention
contribution: Adds an auto-mask module for heavy occlusion and token-specific attention to a transformer hand pose estimator, plus a lightweight mobile variant, for real-time single-image 3D hand pose estimation.

title: Diff-IP2D: Diffusion-Based Hand-Object Interaction Prediction on Egocentric Videos
contribution: Forecasts future 2D hand trajectories and object affordances jointly with a non-autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on camera-wearer motion features in egocentric video.
datasets: public egocentric HOI benchmarks (not named in abstract); new evaluation metrics

title: Novel Diffusion Models for Multimodal 3D Hand Trajectory Prediction
contribution: Introduces MMTwin, twin latent diffusion models that jointly predict headset camera egomotion and future 3D hand trajectories from RGB, point clouds, past hand waypoints and text prompts using a hybrid Mamba-Transformer denoiser.
sensing: egocentric headset RGB plus 3D point clouds
datasets: three public datasets plus self-recorded data

title: Improved 2D Hand Trajectory Prediction with Multi-View Consistency
contribution: Proposes the EER training scheme that exploits geometric, multi-canvas and semantic multi-view consistency from headset egomotion as extra supervision for diffusion-based 2D hand trajectory prediction.
datasets: public egocentric hand trajectory datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Gaze-Guided 3D Hand Motion Prediction for Detecting Intent in Egocentric Grasping Tasks
contribution: Predicts future 3D hand pose and joint-position sequences from gaze, past hand motion and object information with a VQ-VAE hand encoder and autoregressive transformer to detect grasp intent for upper-extremity assistive robots.
sensing: egocentric vision with eye-gaze tracking and hand pose sequences

title: Zero-Shot Temporal Interaction Localization for Egocentric Videos
contribution: EgoLoc localizes hand-object contact and separation timestamps in egocentric video zero-shot by sampling VLM visual prompts around 3D hand-velocity cues and refining them with closed-loop visual and dynamic feedback.
sensing: egocentric RGB video with 3D hand observations
datasets: a public dataset plus a newly proposed benchmark

title: EHoA: A Benchmark for Task-Oriented Hand-Object Action Recognition Via Event Vision
contribution: Releases an annotated event-camera dataset of task-oriented hand-object actions and an attention-based residual spiking network baseline for recognizing them (journal paper presented at IROS 2025, marked (I) in the program).

title: GRASPLAT: Enabling Dexterous Grasping through Novel View Synthesis
contribution: Uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to synthesize novel views of real hand-object grasps so that a network can regress dexterous hand joints from RGB alone, with a photometric loss refining grasp predictions.
datasets: synthetic and real-world grasping datasets (not named in abstract)

title: FSGlove: An Inertial-Based Hand Tracking System with Shape-Aware Calibration
contribution: Builds an IMU glove tracking up to 48 hand DoFs and a differentiable MANO-based calibration (DiffHCal) that jointly recovers joint kinematics, hand shape and sensor misalignment, validated against optical motion capture.
sensing: IMU data glove (IMU per finger joint and dorsum); optical MoCap as reference
datasets: own recordings evaluated against Nokov optical MoCap

title: Modular Soft Wearable Glove for Real-Time Gesture Recognition and Dynamic 3D Shape Reconstruction
contribution: Develops a modular liquid-metal capacitive glove that measures each finger joint bend and inter-finger spacing for gesture recognition and dynamic point-cloud reconstruction of hand shape.

title: A Multi-Modal Hand Imitation Dataset for Dexterous Hand
contribution: Releases Multi-Modal Dex, a dataset of human hand demonstrations with RGB, point cloud and kinematic modalities whose human and robot hand poses are aligned in a shared canonical space via neural rendering and kinematic optimization.
sensing: RGB, point clouds and hand kinematics

title: GAT-Grasp: Gesture-Driven Affordance Transfer for Task-Aware Robotic Grasping
contribution: Retrieves grasp knowledge from large-scale human-object interaction videos using the user's hand gesture as a query and transfers the associated affordance into task-specific robot grasp poses for novel objects.
sensing: RGB camera observing human hand gestures; human-object interaction video corpus
datasets: large-scale human-object interaction videos (not named in abstract)

title: Vision-Based Contact Wrench Estimation in Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Detects 3D human hand positions with an RGB-D sensor to locate contact points and combines a generalized momentum observer with an LSTM to estimate multi-contact interaction wrenches in physical HRI.
sensing: single RGB-D camera plus robot joint torques

title: Physics-Informed Learning for Human Whole-Body Kinematics Prediction Via Sparse IMUs
contribution: Predicts future whole-body human joint kinematics from 5 IMUs with a network regularized by forward and differential kinematics losses and an iterative joint-state buffer at inference.

title: Normalized Triangulation for Calibrated Dual-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Lifts noisy 2D poses from two calibrated views to 3D by mapping them to normalized rays, combining neural refinement with triangulation and an analytical inverse kinematics solver with joint limits.

title: Human Arm Pose Estimation with a Shoulder-Worn Force-Myography Device for Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Maps force-myography signals from a shoulder-worn device to full arm pose with a transformer, transfers across users, and uses it for vision-free robot collision avoidance.
sensing: wearable force-myography sensors at the shoulder

title: A Monocular Vision-Based Robotic Arm Teleoperation Method for Human Arm Configuration Imitation
contribution: Captures human arm motion with a single RGB camera and maps it kinematically to robot arms of varied structure so the robot tracks the end effector while imitating the human arm configuration.

title: Tracking Highly Dynamic Humanoid Motion with Dynamic IMU Measurement Fusion
contribution: Tracks highly dynamic human motion with IMUs placed at link ends by converting measured accelerations into angular-rate corrections via centrifugal effects instead of relying on quasi-static gravity correction.
datasets: own low- and high-intensity human motion recordings

title: STG-Avatar: Animatable Human Avatars Via Spacetime Gaussian
contribution: Reconstructs animatable human avatars from monocular video by coupling linear blend skinning with Spacetime Gaussians and optical-flow-guided densification of fast-moving regions, rendering in real time.

title: Monocular Person Localization under Camera Ego-Motion
contribution: Jointly optimizes 2D camera attitude and a four-point human model to recover a person's 3D location from a moving monocular camera, deployed in a quadruped person-following system.
sensing: monocular RGB camera on a moving robot
datasets: public datasets (not named in abstract) and real robot experiments

title: Diff-MSM: Differentiable MusculoSkeletal Model for Simultaneous Identification of Human Muscle and Bone Parameters
contribution: Identifies subject-specific Hill-type muscle and bone dynamic parameters end to end by differentiating from measured muscle activation through joint torque to observed motion, without measuring joint torques.
sensing: muscle activation (EMG) and observed motion; simulation study

title: Cross-Activity sEMG-Driven Joint Angle Estimation Via Hybrid Attention Fusion: Bridging Traditional Features and Deep Spatial Representations
contribution: Estimates continuous knee and hip joint angles from surface EMG by fusing time-domain features with CNN spatial features through attention, across walking, stairs and obstacle crossing.
datasets: own data from 8 participants performing 4 activities

title: Physics-Embedded Neural Networks for sEMG-Based Continuous Motion Estimation
contribution: Combines musculoskeletal forward dynamics with a recursive structure and CNN residual correction to estimate continuous joint motion from surface EMG.

title: Soft Wearable Robotic Kit for Forearm Rotation and Grasping Motion Tracking Based on Embedded End-Effector-Level Sensor System
contribution: Builds a tendon-driven wearable kit with embedded end-effector sensors, including a sensor-only exosuit that captures the user's forearm pronation/supination and grasping motion in real time for upper-limb rehabilitation.

title: High-Accuracy Early Recognition of Upper-Limb Motions for Exoskeleton-Assisted Mirror Rehabilitation
contribution: Parameterizes 3D upper-limb trajectories into a four-dimensional space so that motions can be recognized from their first 30 percent for exoskeleton-assisted mirror rehabilitation, benchmarking 11 classifiers.
datasets: P-BTBS, Arm-CODA and other public datasets

title: PhysioSense: An Open-Source Multi-Modal Monitoring Framework for Human Movement and Behavior Analysis
contribution: Provides an open-source Lab Streaming Layer framework that synchronizes kinematic, dynamic and physiological sensor streams for human movement analysis, shown on ergonomics and drilling case studies.
sensing: heterogeneous wearable kinematic, force and physiological sensors

title: Enhancing Context-Aware Human Motion Prediction for Efficient Robot Handovers
contribution: Extends the lightweight siMLPe predictor with intention-aware conditioning, task-specific losses and an intention classifier (IntentMotion) to forecast human motion during robot handovers.
datasets: handover motion data (not named in abstract)

title: Integrating Ergonomics and Manipulability for Upper Limb Postural Optimization in Bimanual Human-Robot Collaboration
contribution: Optimizes a simplified human upper-limb skeleton posture for ergonomics and force manipulability during bimanual human-robot co-carrying and drives the robot with a bimanual model-predictive impedance controller to guide the human there.
sensing: human posture tracking with muscle activation measurement

title: Multi-Modal Graph Convolutional Network with Sinusoidal Encoding for Robust Human Action Segmentation
contribution: Segments human-object manipulation actions by fusing low-rate visual features with high-rate 3D skeleton and object detections in a graph network with sinusoidal coordinate encoding and SmoothLabelMix augmentation.
sensing: RGB video plus 3D skeleton and object detections

title: Towards Open-World Human Action Segmentation Using Graph Convolutional Networks
contribution: Defines open-world human-object interaction segmentation and detects novel out-of-distribution actions with a pyramid graph network, synthesized OOD training data and a temporal clustering loss.
sensing: hand/body skeleton and object pose sequences
datasets: Bimanual Actions, Two Hands and Object (H2O)

title: Real-Time Manipulation Action Recognition with a Factorized Graph Sequence Encoder
contribution: Recognizes human manipulation actions in real time from scene-graph sequences with a factorized temporal encoder and a hand pooling operation.
sensing: scene graphs derived from RGB-D video

title: SEI3D: CPU-Only 3D Object Tracking Fusing Sparse-Flow-Filtered Edge and Interior Alignment
contribution: Tracks object 6-DoF pose from monocular video on a CPU by filtering edges with sparse interior correspondences and fusing edge and interior terms in a multi-feature pose optimization.

title: Occlusion-Aware 6D Pose Estimation with Visual Observation Guided Diffusion Model
contribution: Refines category-level object poses in cluttered, occluded scenes with a diffusion model guided by implicit correspondences, perception distance and occlusion relations extracted from RGB-D.

title: RAG-6DPose: Retrieval-Augmented 6D Pose Estimation Via Leveraging CAD As Knowledge Base
contribution: Builds a multi-modal CAD feature knowledge base from multi-view renderings and retrieves it to refine 6D pose predictions, improving robustness to occlusion and novel viewpoints for robotic grasping.
datasets: standard benchmarks (not named in abstract) and real robot tasks

title: VAPO: Visibility-Aware Keypoint Localization for Efficient 6DoF Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Generates keypoint visibility labels from object annotations and weights keypoints by PageRank-derived visibility importance to improve instance-level 6DoF pose estimation under self- and external occlusion.

title: Distilling 3D Distinctive Local Descriptors for 6D Pose Estimation
contribution: Distills the zero-shot GeDi point-cloud descriptor into an efficient student trained to be robust to occlusion and partial observation for fast zero-shot 6D pose estimation.

title: KARL: Kalman-Filter Assisted Reinforcement Learner for Dynamic Object Tracking and Grasping
contribution: Keeps a continuous 6D pose estimate of a moving target with a Kalman filter between perception and an RL controller on an eye-on-hand system, with a six-stage curriculum and retry mechanisms for dynamic grasping.

title: Lost & Found: Tracking Changes from Egocentric Observations in 3D Dynamic Scene Graphs
contribution: Tracks the 6DoF pose of objects moved by a person during detected interaction intervals from egocentric recordings with hand positions and camera poses, and updates a transformable 3D scene graph online.
sensing: egocentric head-mounted RGB with hand and camera pose estimates (no depth)

title: Adaptive Anomaly Recovery for Telemanipulation: A Diffusion Model Approach to Vision-Based Tracking
contribution: Detects occlusion and lighting anomalies in the video used to track a teleoperator's commands and replaces the anomalous clips with diffusion-reconstructed frames to keep dexterous telemanipulation stable.
sensing: RGB camera tracking the human operator

title: Omni-Scan: Creating Visually-Accurate Digital Twin Object Models Using a Bimanual Robot with Handover and Gaussian Splat Merging
contribution: Builds 360-degree 3D Gaussian Splat object digital twins by having a bimanual robot rotate and hand over an object in front of a stationary camera, segmenting out gripper occlusions and merging the splats.
sensing: single stationary RGB camera with robot-held object
datasets: own scans; part defect inspection application

title: RwoR: Generating Robot Demonstrations from Human Hand Collection for Policy Learning without Robot
contribution: Collects human hand demonstrations with a wrist-mounted GoPro and trains a hand-to-gripper generative model on paired human-hand and UMI-gripper data so that robot policies can be trained from human-only demonstrations.
datasets: self-collected paired human hand and UMI gripper demonstrations

title: NuExo: A Wearable Exoskeleton Covering All Upper Limb ROM for Outdoor Data Collection and Teleoperation of Humanoid Robots
contribution: Designs a 5.2 kg backpack upper-limb exoskeleton with a novel shoulder mechanism covering full range of motion for outdoor motion capture, multi-modal data collection and teleoperation of humanoid robots.
sensing: wearable upper-limb exoskeleton encoders plus multi-modal sensors

title: TacCap: A Wearable FBG-Based Tactile Sensor for Seamless Human-To-Robot Skill Transfer
contribution: Develops a wearable fiber-Bragg-grating fingertip tactile sensor that adds tactile signals to human demonstration collection and evaluates its transfer via grasp stability prediction.
sensing: wearable FBG tactile sensors on human fingers

title: Let Me Show You: Learning by Retrieving from Egocentric Video for Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Retrieves task-relevant human videos from a video bank and feeds extracted object affordance masks and hand motion trajectories into robot policy learning (Retrieving-from-Video).
sensing: egocentric human video bank; robot cameras
datasets: own video bank of humans performing daily tasks

title: Human Demonstrations Are Generalizable Knowledge for Robots
contribution: DigKnow distills human demonstration video frames into hierarchical observation, action and pattern knowledge that an LLM planner retrieves to plan and verify robot execution on new tasks and objects.

title: Cross-Embodiment Robotic Manipulation Synthesis Via Guided Demonstrations through CycleVAE and Human Behavior Transformer
contribution: Aligns human and robot latent motion sequences with an unsupervised CycleVAE and generates human expert motions with a causal behavior transformer to synthesize dexterous robot manipulation.

title: Human-Humanoid Robots Cross-Embodiment Behavior-Skill Transfer Using Decomposed Adversarial Learning from Demonstration
contribution: Learns decomposed behavior primitives on a unified digital human model by adversarial imitation of human whole-body loco-manipulation demonstrations, coordinates them via a human-object interaction graph, and retargets them to several humanoids.

title: Human-Robot Intrinsic Skill Transfer and Programming by Demonstration System
contribution: Segments and classifies demonstrated actions from forearm sEMG and inertial signals using transfer learning from a sign-language dataset to program robot tasks by demonstration (journal paper presented at IROS 2025, marked (I)).
datasets: sign language dataset for pretraining; own demonstrations

title: Simultaneously Learning of Motion, Stiffness, and Force from Human Demonstration Based on Riemannian DMP and QP Optimization
contribution: Measures human arm motion, 3D endpoint stiffness and force during a one-shot demonstration and encodes them with an extended Riemannian DMP plus QP refinement for a Franka robot (journal paper presented at IROS 2025, marked (I)).
sensing: human arm motion, stiffness and force measurement

title: SSFold: Learning to Fold Arbitrary Crumpled Cloth Using Graph Dynamics from Human Demonstration
contribution: Combines a sequential pick-and-place stream with a visibility-graph dynamics stream over partial point clouds and integrates real human demonstrations to learn cloth smoothing and folding (journal paper presented at IROS 2025, marked (I)).
sensing: depth / partial point clouds plus human demonstrations

title: Extraction of Robotic Surface Processing Strategies from Human Demonstrations
contribution: Captures human motions and contact forces while sanding various surface geometries with a powered tool, releases the multi-user dataset, and extracts robot surface-processing strategies from it.
sensing: tool motion tracking plus force sensing

title: OpenRoboCare: A Multi-Modal Multi-Task Expert Demonstration Dataset for Robot Caregiving
contribution: Records 21 occupational therapists performing 15 activities of daily living on manikins with RGB-D video, pose tracking, eye-gaze, tactile sensing and action annotations for robot caregiving.
sensing: RGB-D video, body pose tracking, eye-gaze trackers, tactile sensors

title: DARt Vinci: Egocentric Data Collection for Surgical Robot Learning at Scale
contribution: Collects surgical robot demonstrations without a physical robot using augmented-reality hand tracking coupled to a physics engine simulation.
sensing: AR headset hand and body tracking (egocentric)

title: VRobotix: A Scalable and Cost-Effective Virtual-Reality-Based Robotic Manipulation Dataset Generation Framework
contribution: Uses off-the-shelf VR headsets with handheld controllers and body posture tracking to teleoperate robots in a physics simulator and replay sessions into multi-format RGB-D and kinematic datasets.
sensing: VR headset, handheld controllers, body posture tracking

title: HACTS: A Human-As-Copilot Teleoperation System for Robot Learning
contribution: Builds low-cost 3D-printed teleoperation hardware with bilateral joint synchronization so a human copilot can intervene and record action-correction data for imitation and RL.

title: Whole-Body Teleoperation for Mobile Manipulation at Zero Added Cost
contribution: MoMa-Teleop infers end-effector motions from standard interfaces and delegates base motion to an RL agent to collect whole-body mobile manipulation demonstrations without extra hardware.
sensing: standard interfaces such as joystick or hand guidance

title: LEGATO: Cross-Embodiment Imitation Using a Grasping Tool
contribution: Collects demonstrations with a handheld gripper that unifies action and observation spaces, trains visuomotor policies in a motion-invariant space, and retargets the gripper motion to whole-body motions of different robots.

title: Ag2x2: A Robust Agent-Agnostic Visual Representation Boosts Zero-Shot Learning of Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Learns coordination-aware agent-agnostic visual representations from human videos that jointly encode object and hand motion, and uses them for zero-shot reward learning and imitation of bimanual robot tasks.
sensing: RGB human videos; simulated robot cameras

title: AgiBot World Colosseo: Large-Scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
contribution: Releases over 1 million teleoperated bimanual robot trajectories across 217 tasks with a standardized human-in-the-loop collection pipeline and trains the GO-1 generalist policy on them (IROS 2025 award finalist session).
sensing: robot multi-camera observations with grippers, dexterous hands and visuo-tactile sensors
datasets: AgiBot World (introduced); compared with Open X-Embodiment

title: Generalizable Humanoid Manipulation with 3D Diffusion Policies
contribution: Combines whole-upper-body teleoperation for human-like data collection, a 25-DoF humanoid with a 3D LiDAR, and an improved 3D Diffusion Policy that learns from noisy human teleoperation data to generalize beyond the collection scene.
sensing: teleoperation with head-mounted hand tracking; robot-mounted 3D LiDAR

title: Robust and Expressive Humanoid Motion Retargeting Via Optimization-Based Rig Unification
contribution: Unifies motions from different sources, including noisy pose estimations, onto a canonical rig, repairs infeasible poses with foot-contact constraints, and retargets them to 12 simulated and 3 real humanoids.
sensing: human motion data including video pose estimates and motion capture

title: I-CTRL: Imitation to Control Humanoid Robots through Bounded Residual Reinforcement Learning
contribution: Refines kinematically retargeted human motions into physically feasible humanoid motions with constrained bounded-residual reinforcement learning that generalizes across four robots and large motion datasets.
datasets: large-scale human motion datasets (not named in abstract)

title: Motion Capture-Based Robotic Imitation: A Keyframeless Implementation Method Using Multivariate Empirical Mode Decomposition
contribution: Retargets motion capture joint angles to a NAO robot and uses multivariate empirical mode decomposition to fit nuanced motions within motor limits without keyframes (journal paper presented at IROS 2025, marked (I)).

title: Whole-Body Impedance Control of a Humanoid Robot Based on Human-Human Demonstration for Human-Robot Collaboration
contribution: Encodes collaborative trajectories from human-human demonstrations in a TP-GMM and estimates human impedance from EMG to drive a variable whole-body impedance controller on the CURI dual-arm humanoid.

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimization of Humanoid Joint Motion Control Via Text-Driven Human Motion Mapping
