contribution: Generates human motion from text, maps it to humanoid joint angles with an angle signal network trained with a position and rotation loss, and tracks it with an RL whole-body controller.

title: Learning Adaptive Dexterous Grasping from Single Demonstrations
contribution: AdaDexGrasp learns a library of dexterous grasp skills, each from a single human demonstration via a trajectory-following RL reward and curriculum, and selects among them with a VLM.
sensing: single human demonstration per skill; robot RGB-D at deployment
datasets: simulation and real PSYONIC Ability Hand experiments

title: Temporal-Spatial Representation Fusion for Dexterous Manipulation Learning with Unpaired Visual-Action Data
contribution: UnVALe learns temporal and spatial priors of human dexterous manipulation from action-only data with LSTM and VAE models and injects them as RL rewards for robot hand tasks.
sensing: hand action (motion) data without paired images

title: Design of an Affordable, Fully-Actuated Biomimetic Hand for Dexterous Teleoperation Systems
contribution: Designs the RAPID Hand, a low-cost 20-DoA anthropomorphic hand with a universal phalangeal transmission and omnidirectional thumb, aimed at large-scale dexterous teleoperation data collection.

title: Real-Time Photorealistic Mapping for Situational Awareness in Robot Teleoperation
contribution: Integrates Gaussian-splatting SLAM into an online map-based teleoperation system on the GPU to give operators a real-time photorealistic 3D map of unknown sites.
sensing: onboard RGB-D camera on an aerial vehicle

title: Tele-GS: 3D Gaussian Scene Representation for Low-Bandwidth Teleoperation
contribution: Prebuilds a LiDAR-initialized 3D Gaussian Splatting model and renders remote views from it during vehicle teleoperation to cut bandwidth while preserving telepresence fidelity.
sensing: LiDAR plus RGB cameras on a vehicle

title: Learning Human-like Functional Grasping for Multi-finger Hands from Few Demonstrations
contribution: Synthesizes intention-conditioned functional grasps for kinematically diverse multi-finger robot hands from a few human-like grasp demonstrations via fine-grained contact optimization and dense shape correspondence, then trains DexFG-Net to generate such grasps from a single-view reconstructed object.
sensing: single-view camera with object shape reconstruction; few grasp demonstrations
datasets: over 10k synthesized functional grasps used to train DexFG-Net; simulation and physical robot grasps

title: Goal-Conditioned Dual-Action Imitation Learning for Dexterous Dual-Arm Robot Manipulation
contribution: Learns long-horizon bimanual deformable-object skills (banana peeling) from human demonstration data by splitting the policy into trajectory-level global actions and reactive local actions to limit compounding error, tested on a real dual-arm robot.
sensing: robot vision plus human-teleoperated bimanual demonstrations on a dual-arm robot
datasets: own human demonstration data for banana peeling (not named)

title: Challenges for Monocular 6D Object Pose Estimation in Robotics
contribution: Reviews monocular 6D object pose estimation from robotics and vision literature and identifies open problems for robotics, including occlusion handling, pose representations, category-level and novel-object pose, refractive materials and uncertainty estimates.

title: Reactive Human-to-Robot Dexterous Handovers for Anthropomorphic Hand
contribution: Builds a closed-loop human-to-robot handover framework for an anthropomorphic hand with collision detection and grasp selection that reacts to human motion and handles objects in varied 6-DoF poses under occlusion, evaluated on 30 novel objects with a UR5 and Schunk SVH hand.
sensing: camera-based perception of the human hand and held object (details not in abstract); UR5 arm with Schunk SVH hand
datasets: 30 novel objects; user study with eight participants

title: Exploiting Information Theory for Intuitive Robot Programming of Manual Activities
contribution: Uses Shannon information measures between hands and objects in RGB videos of a single human demonstration to extract active scene elements, encodes them as scene graphs, segments the task and generates behavior trees for robot execution, and releases the HANDSOME hand-skill demonstration dataset.
sensing: RGB video of human manual demonstrations
datasets: introduces HANDSOME (multi-subject hand skill demonstration dataset)

title: Learning Multimodal Latent Dynamics for Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Learns human-robot interaction from recorded human-human interactions using an HMM-prior variational autoencoder that conditionally generates robot motion from observed human motion, adapted with inverse kinematics and stiffness modulation, including bimanual robot-to-human handovers on a humanoid.
sensing: recorded human-human interaction motion trajectories; humanoid robot deployment
datasets: own human-human interaction recordings from two humans; user study

title: Fast and Accurate 6-D Object Pose Refinement via Implicit Surface Optimization
contribution: Refines 6-D object pose by encoding the object model offline as a neural signed distance field and optimizing the pose online so observed point cloud points lie on the zero level set, avoiding explicit correspondence search under noise, occlusion and large initial error.
sensing: depth point cloud with known object model

title: Tracking and Control of Multiple Objects During Nonprehensile Manipulation in Clutter
contribution: Tracks 6-D poses of multiple occluded objects during robot pushing in clutter with a physics-based particle filter that fuses physics predictions driven by robot joint states with real-time depth camera observations, and couples the estimates to model predictive control.
sensing: single depth camera plus robot joint states

title: Representation of Human Arm Dynamic Intents With an Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT)-Driven Musculoskeletal Model for Human-Robot Interaction
contribution: Combines wearable electrical impedance tomography, muscle identification, parameter estimation and a physiologically constrained musculoskeletal model to estimate wrist motion and endpoint stiffness of the human arm and drive variable admittance robot control.
sensing: wearable EIT sensor on the arm (sparse non-camera sensing) with biomechanical model

title: Multimodal and Force-Matched Imitation Learning With a See-Through Visuotactile Sensor
contribution: Collects human kinesthetic demonstrations with a see-through visuotactile sensor and matches demonstrated forces during replay so that imitation policies trained on visual and tactile inputs reproduce contact-rich manipulation.
sensing: see-through visuotactile sensor (camera-based) plus kinesthetic demonstrations

title: A Survey on Deep Generative Models for Robot Learning From Multimodal Demonstrations
first_author: Julen Urain (from arXiv 2408.04380; author list not shown in sources accessed)
contribution: Surveys energy-based models, diffusion models, action value maps and GANs used to learn robot policies from multimodal demonstrations, covering grasp generation, trajectory generation and cost learning, and design choices for out-of-distribution generalization.

title: Learning From Videos Through Graph-to-Graphs Generative Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
first_author: Guangyan Chen (inferred from the CVPR 2025 GraphMimic companion paper; T-RO author list not seen)
contribution: Pretrains a model on unlabeled videos by abstracting frames into graphs of object vertices and visual action (hand-object interaction) vertices and generating future graphs, then conditions downstream manipulation policies on the generated graphs to reduce reliance on action-labeled robot data.
sensing: RGB video (unlabeled human and robot videos)
datasets: simulation and real-robot benchmarks (not named in sources seen)

title: DexRepNet++: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation With Geometric and Spatial Hand-Object Representations
contribution: Proposes DexRep, a hand-object interaction representation encoding object surface features and spatial relations between a multi-fingered robot hand and the object, and uses it to learn RL policies for grasping, in-hand reorientation and bimanual handover with sim-to-real deployment.
sensing: point clouds from multi-camera and single-camera setups; simulation
datasets: 40 training objects, evaluation on over 5000 unseen objects in simulation

title: Scalable Unseen Objects 6-DoF Absolute Pose Estimation With Robotic Integration
contribution: Defines SinRef-6D, estimating 6-DoF absolute pose of unseen objects from a single pose-labeled RGB-D reference image, solved by iterative object-space point-wise alignment with point and RGB state space model backbones, and integrates it into robotic manipulation.
sensing: single RGB-D reference image plus RGB-D query

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Visual Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Derives distribution-free ellipsoidal uncertainty bounds on monocular object pose estimates from bounded 2D semantic keypoint noise via SLUE, a convex S-lemma relaxation guaranteed to contain the true pose with high probability.
sensing: monocular RGB with 2D semantic keypoint detections on known objects

title: Learning a Contact Potential Field for Modeling the Hand-Object Interaction
contribution: Models hand-object contact as a learned contact potential field and uses it to estimate and refine hand-object poses and to generate grasp poses (TPAMI 46(8):5645-5662).
sensing: monocular RGB images of hand-object interaction
datasets: not verified (journal extension of the ICCV 2021 CPF work)

title: EvHandPose: Event-Based 3D Hand Pose Estimation With Sparse Supervision
contribution: Estimates 3D hand pose from an event camera using hand-flow event representations and weak supervision through contrast maximization and hand-edge constraints, with a new event-hand dataset.
datasets: new event-based hand dataset introduced by the authors

title: Bi-DexHands: Towards Human-Level Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
contribution: Provides a simulated benchmark of bimanual dexterous-hand manipulation tasks for evaluating reinforcement-learning methods (first author taken from the original project, not re-checked on this page).

title: HiSC4D: Human-Centered Interaction and 4D Scene Capture in Large-Scale Space Using Wearable IMUs and LiDAR
contribution: Captures egocentric human motion, human-human and human-scene interaction in large indoor-outdoor spaces by jointly optimizing body-mounted IMUs with a head-mounted LiDAR, and releases the resulting 4D dataset.
sensing: body-worn IMUs plus head-mounted LiDAR (egocentric, no external cameras)

title: SMPLer: Taming Transformers for Monocular 3D Human Shape and Pose Estimation
contribution: Regresses SMPL body shape and pose from a single image with a transformer that uses decoupled attention and an SMPL-based target representation so high-resolution features can be exploited.
datasets: standard 3D human benchmarks (e.g. Human3.6M, 3DPW); not re-verified

title: Playing for 3D Human Recovery
contribution: Builds GTA-Human, a large game-engine-generated 3D human dataset with automatic ground truth, and studies how such synthetic data improves image- and video-based human pose and shape estimation.
sensing: monocular RGB images and video (synthetic, GTA-V engine)

title: Animatable Implicit Neural Representations for Creating Realistic Avatars From Videos
contribution: Reconstructs animatable human avatars from video using a skinning-based pose-driven deformation field over a canonical neural field.
sensing: multi-view RGB video (also monocular in the extension)
datasets: Human3.6M, ZJU-MoCap, released Mobile-Stage and SyntheticHuman++ data

title: Pose-Driven Compression for Dynamic 3D Human via Human Prior Models
contribution: Compresses dynamic 3D human content by transmitting pose and parameters of human prior models rather than full geometry, relevant to telepresence streaming (only the title was seen; details not verified).

title: EGCN++: A New Fusion Strategy for Ensemble Learning in Skeleton-Based Rehabilitation Exercise Assessment
contribution: Assesses rehabilitation exercise quality from skeleton sequences with an ensemble graph-convolution model and a new fusion strategy (only the title was seen; details not verified).

title: Occlusion-Aware Self-Supervised Monocular 6D Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Trains a monocular 6D object pose network on synthetic data and then self-supervises it on unlabeled real RGB(-D) images with noisy-student training and occlusion-aware differentiable rendering (early access 2021, issue in vol. 46, 2024).
sensing: monocular RGB, unlabeled real RGB-D for self-supervision

title: Match Normalization: Learning-Based Point Cloud Registration for 6D Object Pose Estimation in the Real World
contribution: Estimates object 6D pose by learned point-cloud registration, adding Match Normalization and a correspondence negative log-likelihood loss so models trained on synthetic data work on real depth data.
datasets: real-world RGB-D object pose benchmarks (e.g. LINEMOD, Occluded LINEMOD); not re-verified

title: RNNPose: 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation via Recurrent Correspondence Field Estimation and Pose Optimization
contribution: Refines monocular 6-DoF object pose with a recurrent network that alternates correspondence-field estimation and differentiable Levenberg-Marquardt pose optimization, robust to bad initial poses and occlusion (journal version of the CVPR 2022 RNNPose).
datasets: LINEMOD, Occlusion LINEMOD, YCB-Video (per conference version)

title: CPPF++: Uncertainty-Aware Sim2Real Object Pose Estimation by Vote Aggregation
contribution: Estimates category-level object pose from a single RGB-D frame by uncertainty-aware point-pair-feature voting trained only on synthetic data (journal extension of CVPR 2022 CPPF).

title: FocalPose++: Focal Length and Object Pose Estimation via Render and Compare
contribution: Jointly estimates the 6D pose of a known object and the camera focal length from a single uncalibrated RGB image with an iterative render-and-compare network.
datasets: Pix3D, CompCars, StanfordCars (per conference version; not re-verified)

title: EPro-PnP: Generalized End-to-End Probabilistic Perspective-n-Points for Monocular Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Makes PnP a probabilistic differentiable layer that outputs a pose distribution on SE(3), allowing 2D-3D correspondences and weights to be learned end to end for monocular object pose.

title: Glissando-Net: Deep Single View Category Level Pose Estimation and 3D Reconstruction
contribution: Jointly estimates category-level object pose and reconstructs the object shape from a single RGB image using coupled image and point-cloud auto-encoders.

title: Diff9D: Diffusion-Based Domain-Generalized Category-Level 9-DoF Object Pose Estimation
contribution: Formulates category-level 9-DoF object pose and size estimation as diffusion denoising trained only on rendered synthetic data so it generalizes to real scenes, and deploys it for robotic grasping.
datasets: REAL275, Wild6D and synthetic renderings (not re-verified)

title: GDRNPP: A Geometry-Guided and Fully Learning-Based Object Pose Estimator
contribution: Geometry-guided, fully learning-based instance-level 6D object pose estimator, an improved GDR-Net for the BOP challenge.

title: Towards Real-World Aerial Vision Guidance With Categorical 6D Pose Tracker
contribution: Tracks category-level 6-DoF object pose over time with shape and temporal priors (Robust6DoF) and uses it for aerial robot manipulation guidance under fast viewpoint changes.
datasets: category-level pose tracking benchmarks plus real aerial experiments (not re-verified)

title: Textureless Deformable Object Tracking With Invisible Markers
contribution: Tracks and reconstructs textureless deformable surfaces using UV-fluorescent markers that are invisible under normal light, captured by a time-multiplexed multi-camera rig (journal version of the arXiv 2308.13678 work).
sensing: multi-camera RGB rig with UV and visible illumination

title: Towards Human-Level 3D Relative Pose Estimation: Generalizable, Training-Free, With Single Reference
contribution: Estimates the relative 3D pose of an unseen object from a single query-reference image pair without training, combining 2.5D shape perception, render-and-compare and semantic correspondences.

title: HybrIK-X: Hybrid Analytical-Neural Inverse Kinematics for Whole-Body Mesh Recovery
contribution: Recovers SMPL-X whole-body meshes (body, hands, face) from images by converting estimated 3D joints to rotations with a twist-and-swing hybrid inverse kinematics solver.
datasets: Human3.6M, 3DPW, AGORA and whole-body benchmarks (not re-verified)

title: VMarker-Pro: Probabilistic 3D Human Mesh Estimation From Virtual Markers
contribution: Estimates 3D human meshes through learned virtual surface markers, extended to a probabilistic formulation (journal extension of CVPR 2023 virtual markers).

title: Human as Points: Explicit Point-Based 3D Human Reconstruction From Single-View RGB Images
contribution: Reconstructs clothed 3D humans from one RGB image using explicit point clouds as the intermediate representation, estimating, generating and refining points in 3D space.

title: SMPLest-X: Ultimate Scaling for Expressive Human Pose and Shape Estimation
contribution: Studies data and model scaling for expressive body-hand-face pose and shape estimation, benchmarking 40 datasets and training generalist foundation models.

title: Diffusion Models are Efficient Data Generators for Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Uses diffusion models to synthesize training images with 3D human annotations for human mesh recovery (only title and authors seen in the TPAMI early-access feed).

title: Rendering Humans behind Occlusions
contribution: Renders full-body human appearance from occluded in-the-wild monocular videos by decomposing the scene into occluder, human and background (TPAMI version of the Wild2Avatar line of work).

title: Reconstructing Three-Dimensional Models of Interacting Humans
contribution: Predicts contact signatures between interacting people and uses them to enforce contact-consistent 3D reconstruction, introducing the CHI3D motion-capture dataset and related contact datasets.
sensing: monocular RGB images; lab mocap for ground truth

title: Surfel-Based Gaussian Inverse Rendering for Fast and Relightable Dynamic Human Reconstruction From Monocular Videos
contribution: Reconstructs relightable, animatable clothed human avatars from monocular video with surfel-based Gaussians and physically based material estimation.

title: GPHM: Gaussian Parametric Head Model for Monocular Head Avatar Reconstruction
contribution: Builds a 3D Gaussian parametric head model and fits it to monocular input to reconstruct animatable head avatars for telepresence-style applications (journal version of the 3D Gaussian Parametric Head Model work).

title: Ins-HOI: Instance Aware Human-Object Interactions Recovery
contribution: Reconstructs human or hand together with objects through an instance-level occupancy field that implicitly learns contact surfaces, trained with real captures augmented by synthetic compositions.
datasets: own real-captured and synthesized HOI data (released)

title: HandBooster+: Boosting 3D Hand-Mesh Reconstruction From Data Synthesis to Progressive Multi-Hypothesis Aggregation
contribution: Improves single-image 3D hand-mesh reconstruction under hand-object interaction by synthesizing diverse annotated hand-object images with a conditional diffusion model and aggregating multiple hypotheses (extension of CVPR 2024 HandBooster).
datasets: DexYCB and HO3D (per conference version; not re-verified)

title: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction With a Point-Embedded Transformer
contribution: Reconstructs hand meshes from multi-view images by embedding basis points in the multi-view stereo space to fuse view features (POEM), aimed at practical hand motion capture.
datasets: hand and hand-object datasets such as DexYCB, HO3D, OakInk (not re-verified)

title: Scalable High-Fidelity 3D Hand Shape Reconstruction via Graph-Image Frequency Mapping and Graph Frequency Decomposition
contribution: Reconstructs detailed 3D hand meshes from a single image coarse-to-fine across graph frequency bands with a frequency decomposition loss (extension of the CVPR 2023 work).

title: HandRT: Simultaneous Hand Shape and Appearance Reconstruction With Pose Tracking From Monocular RGB-D Video
contribution: Jointly tracks hand pose and reconstructs personalized hand shape and appearance from a monocular RGB-D video (only the title was seen; details not verified).

title: HandNeRF++: Modeling Animatable Interacting Hands With Neural Radiance Fields
contribution: Builds animatable neural radiance fields of single and interacting hands with a pose-driven deformation to a shared canonical space for photorealistic rendering (extension of CVPR 2023 HandNeRF).

title: Keystate-Driven Long-Term Generation of Bimanual Object Manipulation Sequences
contribution: Generates long bimanual hand-object manipulation motion sequences guided by key states (only the title was seen; details not verified).

title: ManiDext: Hand-Object Manipulation Synthesis via Continuous Correspondence Embeddings and Residual-Guided Diffusion
contribution: Generates hand manipulation and grasp poses conditioned on 3D object trajectories with hierarchical diffusion over continuous hand-object correspondence embeddings.
sensing: motion generation from object trajectories (no image input)

title: EigenActor: Variant Body-Object Interaction Generation Evolved from Invariant Action Basis Reasoning
contribution: Generates 3D whole-body human-object interaction motion from text by learning action-specific motion bases plus object-specific interaction priors.

title: Ego4D: Around the World in 3,600 Hours of Egocentric Video
contribution: Releases a 3,670-hour egocentric daily-activity video dataset with benchmark suites, including hand-object interaction tasks (TPAMI version of the CVPR 2022 dataset).
sensing: head-worn egocentric cameras, with some audio, gaze, stereo, 3D scans and multi-camera recordings

title: 3D Hand Pose Estimation via Articulated Anchor-to-Joint 3D Local Regressors
contribution: Estimates 3D single- and interacting-hand pose with articulated anchor-to-joint local regressors in a transformer (A2J-Transformer-Plus, extension of CVPR 2023 A2J-Transformer).
sensing: single RGB image (A2J line also supports depth)
datasets: InterHand2.6M and hand pose benchmarks (not re-verified)

title: MADiff: Motion-Aware Mamba Diffusion Models for Hand Trajectory Prediction on Egocentric Videos
contribution: Forecasts future hand waypoints in egocentric video with a latent diffusion model using motion-aware Mamba and egomotion compensation, aimed at XR and robot manipulation.
datasets: EPIC-Kitchens, EgoPAT3D-DT, H2O-PT (as listed in a curated summary)

title: Uni-Hand: Universal Hand Motion Forecasting in Egocentric Views
contribution: Forecasts 2D and 3D hand waypoints and multiple hand targets from multimodal egocentric input with vision-language fusion and a dual-branch diffusion model, and deploys predictions on real robots.

title: EgoLoc: A Generalizable Solution for Temporal Interaction Localization in Egocentric Videos
contribution: Localizes the moments of hand-object contact and separation in egocentric video, framed for mixed reality and human-to-robot policy transfer.

title: YOTO++: Learning Long-Horizon Closed-Loop Bimanual Manipulation from One-Shot Human Video Demonstrations
contribution: Learns long-horizon closed-loop bimanual robot manipulation policies from a single human video demonstration (only title and authors seen in the TPAMI early-access feed).
sensing: human demonstration video (camera setup not verified)

title: GVHMR: Gravity-View Coordinates for Global Human Motion Recovery From Monocular Videos
contribution: Recovers world-grounded human motion from monocular video by predicting poses in a per-frame gravity-view coordinate system (journal version of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2024 GVHMR).

title: OptimalCap: Efficient and Robust LiDAR-Based Motion Capture in Free Environments
contribution: Captures human motion from LiDAR point clouds in unconstrained environments with an efficient and robust pipeline (only title and authors seen in the TPAMI issue feed).

title: A Comparative Assessment of Accuracy in Video-Based Monocular Human Pose Estimation Frameworks
contribution: Compares the accuracy of video-based monocular human pose estimation frameworks (only title and authors seen in the TPAMI issue feed; whether the reference is clinical mocap is not verified).

title: Probing Effective and Efficient Category-Level Articulated Object Pose Perception
contribution: Estimates category-level pose of articulated objects efficiently (only title and authors seen in the TPAMI issue feed).
sensing: not verified (likely point clouds or RGB-D)

title: Language-4D Cross-Boosting for Generalized Zero-Shot 6DoF Tracking and 3D Reconstruction
contribution: Jointly performs zero-shot category-level 6DoF object pose tracking and 3D reconstruction using language guidance with 4D cues (only title, authors and a one-line abstract fragment seen).

title: InterCap: Joint Markerless 3D Tracking of Humans and Objects in Interaction
contribution: Fits SMPL-X bodies with articulated hands and rigid object meshes jointly to multi-view RGB-D video, using hand-object and body-object contact constraints, and releases the resulting InterCap dataset of whole-body human-object interaction (IJCV extension of the GCPR 2022 paper).

title: EventEgo3D++: 3D Human Motion Capture from a Head Mounted Event Camera
contribution: Estimates egocentric 3D human body pose in real time (140 Hz) from a single head-mounted fisheye event camera using the LNES event representation, and releases real studio, in-the-wild and synthetic datasets with allocentric RGB views and SMPL annotations (extension of EventEgo3D, CVPR 2024).
sensing: monocular head-mounted fisheye event camera (egocentric); allocentric RGB for ground truth
datasets: new real (studio and in-the-wild) and synthetic egocentric event datasets with SMPL annotations

title: Event-Based Non-rigid Reconstruction of Low-Rank Parametrized Deformations from Contours
contribution: Reconstructs and tracks non-rigid surface deformations described by a low-rank parametric model (listed by a curated event-based hands list under mesh and tracking) from the contour events of an event camera.

title: Feed-Forward Multi-view Multi-person Reconstruction with Contrastive Human-Aware 3D Representation
contribution: Lifts multi-view observations into a shared instance-centric 3D space trained with spatial contrastive learning so that camera calibration, cross-view person association and SMPL regression are done jointly in one feed-forward pass, aimed at robustness under severe inter-person occlusion.

title: ICo3D: An Interactive Conversational 3D Virtual Human
contribution: Builds a photorealistic animatable avatar from multi-view captures by merging Gaussian-splatting face (HeadGaS++) and body (SWinGS++) models, drives the face from speech audio and couples it to an LLM for real-time conversational interaction.
sensing: multi-view RGB capture of the subject; audio as driving signal

title: Deep Learning-Based Object Pose Estimation: A Comprehensive Survey
contribution: Surveys deep-learning object pose estimation across instance-level, category-level and unseen (novel) object settings, covering datasets, metrics, robustness under challenging conditions and open problems.

title: Towards Symmetry-sensitive Pose Estimation: A Rotation Representation for Symmetric Object Classes
contribution: Introduces SARR, a rotation representation that folds each object's degrees of symmetry into the trigonometric encoding so a standard CNN can regress canonical, symmetry-resolved 3D orientations of symmetric objects.

title: S2P3: Self-Supervised Polarimetric Pose Prediction
contribution: Trains 6D object pose prediction from RGB plus polarimetric images without real pose labels, using a physical polarization model, teacher-student distillation and a differentiable-rendering self-supervised loss.

title: An Outlook into the Future of Egocentric Vision
contribution: Surveys egocentric vision tasks, datasets and open challenges (including hand-object interaction understanding) and frames them against envisioned future wearable-assistant scenarios.
datasets: reviews egocentric datasets such as EPIC-KITCHENS and Ego4D

title: Leveraging Synthetic Data for Enhancing Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Detection
contribution: Studies how synthetic egocentric images improve 2D hand-object interaction detection when real labels are scarce, showing gains with 10 percent of real labels and analysing how aligning synthetic objects, grasps and environments to each target benchmark affects transfer.
datasets: VISOR, EgoHOS, ENIGMA-51, synthetic HOI data

title: HOIST-Former: Hand-held Objects Identification, Segmentation, and Tracking in the Wild
contribution: Transformer that iteratively pools hand and object features with a contact loss to identify, segment and track hand-held objects through grasp and release in the wild.
datasets: in-the-wild hand-held object video dataset introduced in the paper

title: GeneOH Diffusion: Towards Generalizable Hand-Object Interaction Denoising via Denoising Diffusion
contribution: Contact-centric HOI representation plus a domain-generalizable canonical diffusion denoiser that refines erroneous hand trajectories in hand-object interaction sequences.
sensing: HOI motion sequences (estimated or noisy mocap)

title: HO-Cap: A Capture System and Dataset for 3D Reconstruction and Pose Tracking of Hand-Object Interaction
contribution: Low-cost capture system and semi-automatic annotation for hand and object shape and pose, with a video dataset including task use and hand-to-hand handover usable as robot demonstrations (Datasets and Benchmarks track).
sensing: multi-view RGB-D cameras plus HoloLens egocentric headset

title: Learning Dense Hand Contact Estimation from Imbalanced Data
contribution: HACO learns dense per-vertex hand contact (with objects, hands, scene, body) while correcting class and spatial imbalance in hand-contact data.
datasets: multiple hand-interaction contact datasets (not enumerated in abstract excerpt)

title: Towards Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Hand-Instrument Interaction in Ophthalmic Surgery
contribution: OphNet-3D, an RGB-D surgical dataset of 41 sequences with MANO hand meshes and 6-DoF instrument poses from an automatic multi-view annotation pipeline, with bimanual and hand-instrument benchmarks.

title: Stereo Hand-Object Reconstruction for Human-to-Robot Handover
contribution: Stereo RGB hand-object reconstruction that probabilistically fuses single-view reconstructions with learned shape priors, handling unseen and transparent objects during handover.
datasets: large synthetic hand-object dataset (not named in abstract excerpt)

title: SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild
contribution: In-the-wild dataset of 3D hands and hand-held objects captured with a mobile egocentric multi-camera rig; it hosts the HANDS/DexHAND ECCV 2026 challenge on dense hand-object interaction field estimation (per-joint offsets to the nearest object surface).
sensing: egocentric VR headset plus body-worn multi-camera RGB rig

title: Reconstructing Objects along Hand Interaction Timelines in Egocentric Video
contribution: Defines hand interaction timelines for rigid objects and propagates object pose under stable-grasp constraints (COP) to reconstruct held objects in egocentric video without 3D ground truth.

title: EgoGrasp: World-Space Hand-Object Interaction Estimation from Egocentric Videos
contribution: Multi-stage framework with spatial-intelligence preprocessing, a decoupled-diffusion whole-body HOI prior and test-time optimization to recover world-space hand-object interaction from dynamic egocentric video.
sensing: egocentric monocular RGB video, dynamic camera

title: Grasp-and-Lift: Executable 3D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction via Physics-in-the-Loop Optimization
contribution: Converts visually aligned hand-object trajectories into physically executable ones by CMA-ES optimization of a spline hand-motion parameterization with a physics simulator in the loop.

title: NVS-HO: A Benchmark for Novel View Synthesis of Handheld Objects
contribution: Benchmark for novel view synthesis of hand-held objects from RGB only: each object is recorded handheld and on a ChArUco board for ground-truth views; it exposes gaps of SfM/VGGT plus NeRF/3DGS pipelines.
sensing: static monocular RGB camera, object manipulated by hand

title: Interaction-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
contribution: Interaction-aware hand-object Gaussians and hand-conditioned object deformation fields with progressive optimization to model geometry and appearance of HOI scenes without object priors.

title: Grasp in Gaussians: Fast Monocular Reconstruction of Dynamic Hand-Object Interactions
contribution: Tracks hand and object with a compact Sum-of-Gaussians representation initialized from a video-adapted SAM3D pipeline for fast, stable monocular HOI reconstruction.

title: CHOIR: Contact-aware 4D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
contribution: Uses contact as an explicit coupling signal, with generative spatial rectification of a coarse open-world 4D HOI initialization, to reconstruct hand motion, object shape and 6D pose and contact from monocular video.

title: ComPose: When to Trust Hands for Object Pose Tracking
contribution: Hand-aware 6-DoF object tracking from RGB video that adaptively selects informative hand joints as a complementary cue to object evidence under grasp occlusion.

title: High-Fidelity 4D Hand-Object Capture via Multi-View Spatiotemporal Tracking and Physics-Aware Gaussians
contribution: Template- and marker-free multi-view HOI capture with a feed-forward multi-view transformer initialization and physics-aware Gaussian refinement.

title: DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction
contribution: Combines geometry-grounded diffusion refinement with coupled hand inverse dynamics and object Newton-Euler dynamics and an actuation prior to suppress mechanically implausible monocular HOI reconstructions.

title: HOPE: Hand-Object Pressure Estimation from Monocular Videos
contribution: Predicts temporally evolving per-vertex pressure and contact on the hand mesh from monocular video by unifying glove, planar-sensor and distance-based contact labels in hand-vertex space.
datasets: tactile-glove, planar pressure-sensor and hand-object contact datasets (not named in abstract excerpt)

title: Zero-shot Reconstruction of In-Scene Object Manipulation from Video
contribution: First system to reconstruct hand-object manipulation consistent with the surrounding scene from monocular video, using foundation-model initialization and two-stage optimization from grasp to interaction.

title: HOSt3R: Keypoint-free Hand-Object 3D Reconstruction from RGB images
contribution: Keypoint-detector-free estimation of hand-object 3D transformations from monocular video integrated with multi-view reconstruction for template-free hand-object shape recovery.

title: Follow My Hold: Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction through Geometric Guidance
contribution: Guides a latent diffusion model with optimization-in-the-loop hand-object geometric cues to generate hand-held object geometry from a single image with plausible interaction.

title: MaskHOI: Robust 3D Hand-Object Interaction Estimation via Masked Pre-training
contribution: MAE-style pretraining with region-specific mask ratios to learn occlusion-robust features for joint hand and object pose estimation from RGB.

title: Affordance-Guided Diffusion Prior for 3D Hand Reconstruction
contribution: Diffusion prior conditioned on VLM-inferred affordance descriptions refines heavily object-occluded hand poses toward functionally coherent grasps.

title: Training-Free Dense Hand Contact Estimation with Multi-Modal Large Language Models
contribution: ContactPrompt, a training-free zero-shot approach that encodes 3D hand geometry for MLLMs to estimate dense vertex-level hand contact.

title: GraspHOI: Full-Body 3D Human-Object Reconstruction with Finger-Level Grasps from a Single In-the-Wild Image
contribution: Reconstructs body, hands and a category-agnostic object from one image and explicitly optimizes finger articulation with occlusion-aware palmar correspondences for contact-consistent grasps.
datasets: four HOI benchmarks (not named in abstract excerpt)

title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models: Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
contribution: Systematic review of foundation-model priors for hand-object interaction across six reconstruction and generation tasks, with a taxonomy of what knowledge enters the pipeline and which uncertainty it reduces.

title: HOI4D: A 4D Egocentric Dataset for Category-Level Human-Object Interaction
contribution: 2.4M egocentric RGB-D frames over 4000 sequences with 800 rigid and articulated object instances from 16 categories, annotated with 3D hand pose, category-level object pose, segmentation and reconstructed object meshes, plus benchmark tasks.

title: OakInk: A Large-scale Knowledge Repository for Understanding Hand-Object Interaction
contribution: Builds an object affordance knowledge base (Oak, 1,800 objects) and a captured hand-object interaction set (Ink) with hand and object poses for 100 objects, with grasps transferred to the remaining objects.
sensing: multi-view RGB capture with optical motion capture for annotation

title: ARCTIC: A Dataset for Dexterous Bimanual Hand-Object Manipulation
contribution: 2.1M video frames of two hands manipulating articulated objects (scissors, laptops, and others) with accurate 3D hand and object meshes and dynamic contact, plus consistent-motion reconstruction and interaction-field baselines.
sensing: 8 static RGB views plus 1 egocentric RGB view; marker-based motion capture for ground truth

title: AssemblyHands: Towards Egocentric Activity Understanding via 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Large-scale benchmark of accurate 3D hand poses in egocentric images of toy assembly with heavy hand-object occlusion, annotated through a multi-view automatic annotation pipeline.
sensing: synchronized egocentric (headset) and exocentric multi-view cameras from Assembly101

title: AffordPose: A Large-scale Dataset of Hand-Object Interactions with Affordance-driven Hand Pose
contribution: Large set of hand-object interactions labelled with part-level affordances (twist, pull, handle-grasp and others) linking object function to hand pose.
sensing: 3D hand and object meshes (annotated grasps on object models); no camera sensing

title: SHOWMe: Benchmarking Object-agnostic Hand-Object 3D Reconstruction
contribution: 96 videos with sub-millimetre registered textured hand-object meshes under a rigid-grasp assumption, used to benchmark object-agnostic hand-object reconstruction.
sensing: monocular RGB video with high-precision 3D scans for ground truth

title: HOH: Markerless Multimodal Human-Object-Human Handover Dataset with Large Object Count
contribution: 2,720 human-to-human handovers over 136 objects and 40 participants with multi-view RGB-D, skeletons, point clouds, giver and receiver hand segmentations and aligned object models (Datasets and Benchmarks track).

title: ContactArt: Learning 3D Interaction Priors for Category-level Articulated Object and Hand Poses Estimation
contribution: Collects a hand-articulated-object dataset by visual teleoperation in a physics simulator (free object pose and contact labels) and learns contact and part-arrangement priors for hand and articulated object pose estimation.
sensing: iPhone capture of the hand driving a simulator; simulated object state

title: HMDO: Markerless Multi-view Hand Manipulation Capture with Deformable Objects
contribution: First markerless dataset of hands interacting with deformable objects, with an annotation method that uses estimated hand features to guide object pose and deformation recovery.

title: POV-Surgery: A Dataset for Egocentric Hand and Tool Pose Estimation During Surgical Activities
contribution: Large synthetic egocentric dataset of gloved hands manipulating three orthopaedic instruments with 3D hand and tool pose annotations.

title: Efficient Annotation and Learning for 3D Hand Pose Estimation: A Survey
contribution: Reviews 3D hand pose annotation methods (manual, synthetic, hand-sensor, computational) and learning under limited labels, including hand-object occlusion settings.
datasets: reviews FreiHAND, HO-3D, DexYCB, InterHand2.6M and others

title: AnyHand: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for RGB(-D) Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Synthetic set of 2.5M single-hand and 4.1M hand-object RGB-D images with occlusions, arm detail and aligned depth, shown to improve RGB and RGB-D hand pose on FreiHAND and HO-3D.
datasets: introduces AnyHand; evaluates on FreiHAND, HO-3D

title: HRDexDB: A Large-Scale Dataset of Dexterous Human and Robotic Hand Grasps
contribution: 1.4K grasping trials by human and several robot hands on 100 objects with 3D hand/robot and object motion, tactile signals, multi-view and egocentric video, including failures.
sensing: dedicated multi-camera system plus egocentric video and tactile sensors

title: EgoChoir: Capturing 3D Human-Object Interaction Regions from Egocentric Views
contribution: Infers where interaction occurs in 3D (human contact and object affordance regions) from egocentric observations despite incomplete visibility of the interacting parties.
sensing: egocentric RGB video plus head motion

title: InteractVLM: 3D Interaction Reasoning from 2D Foundational Models
contribution: Fine-tunes a vision-language model with limited 3D contact data to estimate 3D contact points on bodies and objects from in-the-wild images, enabling joint human-object reconstruction.

title: InterAct: Advancing Large-Scale Versatile 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Consolidates and corrects existing 3D HOI datasets into a standardized 21.81-hour benchmark with text annotations, extends it to 30.70 hours via contact-invariant augmentation, and defines six HOI generation benchmark tasks.
datasets: InterAct (introduced; consolidated from existing HOI datasets)

title: TeHOR: Text-Guided 3D Human and Object Reconstruction with Textures
contribution: Text-guided joint reconstruction of textured 3D human and object from one image, handling non-contact interactions and using appearance for global context.

title: RHINO: Reconstructing Human Interactions with Novel Objects from Monocular Videos
contribution: Recovers human, unseen manipulated object and static scene in a common world frame from moving-camera monocular video using foundation-model cues to stabilize SfM.
datasets: new handheld-video dataset synchronized with a volumetric 4D capture stage (introduced)

title: CrossHOI: Learning Cross-View Representations for Monocular 3D Human-Object Interaction Reconstruction
contribution: Learns cross-view representations to improve monocular 3D human-object interaction reconstruction.

title: PhysHO: Physics-Based Dynamic 3D Gaussian Human and Object from Monocular Video
contribution: Reconstructs a dynamic 3D Gaussian human and interacting object from monocular video with physics-based object dynamics.

title: Joint Reconstruction of Spatially-Coherent and Realistic Clothed Humans and Objects from a Single Image
contribution: Jointly reconstructs detailed clothed humans and objects in a spatially coherent way from one image while handling human-object occlusion.
datasets: new synthetic dataset of inter-occluded human scans and objects (introduced) plus real data

title: GASPACHO: Gaussian Splatting for Controllable Humans and Objects
contribution: Reconstructs separate animatable Gaussian templates of human and object from multi-view HOI images, enabling controllable photorealistic rendering of novel interactions.

title: Efficient and Scalable Monocular Human-Object Interaction Motion Reconstruction
contribution: 4DHOISolver constrains monocular 4D HOI reconstruction with sparse human-in-the-loop contact annotations and is used to build the Open4DHOI dataset from Internet videos.

title: Asset-Driven Sematic Reconstruction of Dynamic Scene with Multi-Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Gaussian-splatting surface reconstruction of dynamic scenes with multiple humans interacting with multiple objects from monocular video.

title: End-to-End Spatial-Temporal Transformer for Real-time 4D HOI Reconstruction
contribution: THO predicts human and object motion feed-forward from video and object template using spatial contact and temporal kinematic priors, running at 31.5 FPS.
sensing: monocular RGB video plus object template

title: Learning Human-Object Interaction for 3D Human Pose Estimation from LiDAR Point Clouds
contribution: Exploits human-object interaction cues to resolve human-object point ambiguity for 3D human pose estimation from LiDAR.

title: HOIGS: Human-Object Interaction Gaussian Splatting
contribution: Gaussian splatting for dynamic HOI scenes with a cross-attention HOI module coupling separate human (HexPlane) and object (cubic Hermite spline) deformation fields.
datasets: multiple datasets (names not in fetched abstract)

title: Pi-HOC: Pairwise 3D Human-Object Contact Estimation
contribution: Single-pass instance-aware dense 3D semantic contact prediction for all human-object pairs in multi-person images.

title: LEXIS: LatEnt ProXimal Interaction Signatures for 3D HOI from an Image
contribution: Introduces InterFields, dense continuous body-object proximity fields, and infers them from one image to guide 3D HOI reconstruction.

title: Real2Sim in HOI: Toward Physically Plausible HOI Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
contribution: HA-HOI reconstructs monocular HOI with stable contact and functional manipulation so trajectories are usable as references for humanoid-object simulation.
datasets: benchmark and in-the-wild videos (names not in fetched abstract)

title: CoGS: Compositional Dynamic Human-Object Scenes Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video
contribution: Compositional Gaussian splatting with separate articulated-human, rigid-object and static-scene branches for monocular HOI scene reconstruction.

title: BEHAVE: Dataset and Method for Tracking Human Object Interactions
contribution: Introduces the BEHAVE dataset of full-body humans interacting with 20 everyday objects, captured with multi-view Kinect RGB-D and annotated with SMPL body fits, object fits and contacts, plus a method that tracks human, object and contact from a single portable RGB-D camera.
sensing: multi-view RGB-D (Kinect) for capture; single RGB-D for the tracking method

title: COUCH: Towards Controllable Human-Chair Interactions
contribution: Introduces the COUCH dataset of humans sitting on and interacting with chairs with annotated hand-contact targets, and a contact-controllable motion synthesis method trained on it.
sensing: multi-view markerless capture of body and chair (exact sensor rig not verified in fetched sources)

title: Full-Body Articulated Human-Object Interaction
contribution: Introduces CHAIRS, a dataset of full-body humans interacting with articulated chairs and sofas with part-level object motion, and a kinematics-aware method for reconstructing articulated human-object interaction from images.
sensing: multi-view RGB-D capture with body motion capture (rig details not verified in fetched sources)

title: NeuralDome: A Neural Modeling Pipeline on Multi-View Human-Object Interactions
contribution: Builds a 76-view capture dome and the HODome dataset of human-object interactions with body-model annotations, object 6-DoF and masks, plus a neural pipeline for geometry, tracking and free-view rendering of both human and object.

title: Object Motion Guided Human Motion Synthesis
contribution: Proposes OMOMO, a two-stage diffusion model that recovers full-body manipulation motion from object motion via hand-position intermediates, and releases the FullBodyManip motion-capture dataset (about 10 hours, 15 objects) widely used as an HOI benchmark.

title: DECO: Dense Estimation of 3D Human-Scene Contact In The Wild
contribution: Introduces DAMON, an in-the-wild image dataset of dense vertex-level body contact with objects and scenes, and DECO, a detector that estimates dense 3D contact from a single image; DAMON later became a RHOBIN challenge track.

title: RHOBIN Challenge: Reconstruction of Human Object Interaction
contribution: Report on the first RHOBIN challenge (CVPR 2023 workshop) on monocular reconstruction of humans, objects and contacts under heavy mutual occlusion, with tracks on BEHAVE and InterCap; a second edition at CVPR 2024 added DAMON contact tracks.

title: THOR: Text to Human-Object Interaction Diffusion via Relation Intervention
contribution: Text-to-HOI diffusion with relation intervention between human and object motion, and releases Text-BEHAVE, text annotations aligned with the BEHAVE 3D HOI dataset.
sensing: none at inference (generation); built on BEHAVE multi-view RGB-D captures

title: A Survey on Human Interaction Motion Generation
contribution: Surveys human-human, human-object, human-scene and mixed interaction motion generation and catalogs the datasets used, including BEHAVE, InterCap, CHAIRS, HODome, OMOMO, IMHD, HIMO, CORE4D, ParaHome and HUMOTO.
datasets: catalog of HOI, HHI and HSI datasets

title: 3D Human Interaction Generation: A Survey
contribution: Surveys 3D human interaction generation across human-object, human-scene and human-human settings, covering motion representations, datasets and evaluation metrics.

title: RoboTwin: Dual-Arm Robot Benchmark with Generative Digital Twins
contribution: Dual-arm (bimanual) robot manipulation benchmark built on generative digital twins.

title: PianoMotion10M: Dataset and Benchmark for Hand Motion Generation in Piano Performance
contribution: 116 hours of bird's-eye piano videos with 10 million annotated two-hand poses, plus an audio-to-hand-motion baseline and evaluation metrics.
sensing: monocular top-down RGB video with audio

title: Learning Interaction-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for One-shot Hand Avatars
contribution: Two-stage interaction-aware Gaussian splatting framework that builds animatable avatars of interacting hands from a single image using cross-subject hand priors and refinement in contact regions.

title: BiGym: A Demo-Driven Mobile Bi-Manual Manipulation Benchmark
contribution: Demonstration-driven benchmark for mobile bimanual robot manipulation tasks.

title: Bimanual Dexterity for Complex Tasks
contribution: Bidex, a low-cost, low-latency portable bimanual dexterous teleoperation system using motion-capture gloves and teacher arms, compared against Vision Pro and SteamVR teleoperation.

title: A Multimodal Handover Failure Detection Dataset and Baselines
contribution: Dataset of robot-human handover failures caused by the human participant, with video-classification and temporal action segmentation baselines.

title: Depth Restoration of Hand-Held Transparent Objects for Human-to-Robot Handover
contribution: Hand-aware depth restoration (HADR) of hand-held transparent objects from one RGB-D image using hand posture as guidance, for human-to-robot handover.

title: Bunny-VisionPro: Real-Time Bimanual Dexterous Teleoperation for Imitation Learning
contribution: Real-time bimanual dexterous teleoperation system driven by VR-headset hand tracking, with low-cost haptic feedback devices, for collecting imitation-learning demonstrations.

title: Single-Query Person-Centric Bimanual Hand-Object Interaction Detection
contribution: Person-centric detector in which one query predicts a person's box, body pose, both hand boxes and states, and interaction targets, resolving hand ownership in multi-person bimanual scenes.

title: VM-BHINet: Vision Mamba Bimanual Hand Interaction Network for 3D Interacting Hand Mesh Recovery From a Single RGB Image
contribution: Adds state-space (Mamba) interaction feature blocks to interacting-hand mesh recovery, cutting MPJPE and MPVPE by 2-3 percent on InterHand2.6M at lower compute cost.

title: AssemblyHands-X: Modeling 3D Hand-Body Coordination for Understanding Bimanual Human Activities
contribution: First markerless 3D hand-body benchmark for bimanual activities, built by multi-view triangulation with SMPL-X fitting, showing joint hand-body pose improves action recognition.

title: Bimanual 3D Hand Motion and Articulation Forecasting in Everyday Images
contribution: Forecasts bimanual 3D hand motion and articulation from one everyday image, using a diffusion lifting pipeline that imputes 4D hand labels from 2D keypoint sequences across 6 datasets.
sensing: single RGB image (training uses 2D keypoint sequences lifted to 4D)
datasets: 6 datasets (not individually named in fetched abstract)

title: The Invisible EgoHand: 3D Hand Forecasting through EgoBody Pose Estimation
contribution: EgoH4, a diffusion transformer that forecasts 3D trajectories and poses of both hands from egocentric video, including when hands are out of view, by leveraging body pose.
sensing: egocentric RGB video with camera poses

title: A Taxonomy of Self-Handover
contribution: First systematic taxonomy of self-handover (passing an object between one's own hands), built from 12+ hours of annotated cooking video of 21 people, with VLM-based classification of handover types.

title: DexMan: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Human and Generated Videos
contribution: Converts third-person human or generated videos into bimanual humanoid dexterous skills without calibration, depth or scanned assets, using contact-based rewards; state of the art object pose on TACO.
sensing: monocular third-person RGB video (real and generated)

title: Learning human-to-robot handovers through 3D scene reconstruction
contribution: H2RH-SGS learns human-to-robot handover policies from RGB images alone, using sparse-view Gaussian Splatting reconstruction of handover scenes instead of real-robot data.

title: RoboTwin 2.0: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark with Strong Domain Randomization for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Scalable simulated data generator and benchmark for bimanual robot manipulation with strong domain randomization.

title: StructBiHOI: Structured Articulation Modeling for Long-Horizon Bimanual Hand-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Generates long-horizon bimanual hand-object interaction by separating temporal joint planning (joint VAE) from frame-level manipulation refinement.

title: StableHand: Quality-Aware Flow Matching for World-Space Dual-Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
contribution: Recovers world-space 4D motion of two interacting hands from egocentric video with flow matching weighted by per-frame observation quality, handling out-of-view and occluded hands.

title: Dex2HOI: Dexterous Bimanual Two-Object Interaction Generation
contribution: Dual-stream diffusion model that synthesizes bimanual manipulation of one or two objects from text, coordinating the per-object streams with cross-attention and contact-aware conditioning.

title: EgoEMG: A Multimodal Egocentric Dataset with Bilateral EMG and Vision for Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Bimanual hand pose dataset synchronizing bilateral wristband EMG (16 channels), IMU, egocentric RGB, external RGB-D and mocap hand motion for 41 participants and 60 gesture classes.
sensing: bilateral sEMG wristbands, IMU, egocentric RGB, external RGB-D, motion capture

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction
contribution: ViDiHand repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model, adapted with a hand-overlay rendering objective, to reconstruct 4D two-hand pose from egocentric video under heavy occlusion.

title: MEgoVista: Multi-view Ego-aware Motion Estimation for Metric 4D Hands and Head in the Wild
contribution: Offline pipeline that turns one unprepared head-worn multi-view recording into metric two-hand and head motion in a gravity-aligned world frame, aimed at learning manipulation from human video.

title: RGB-D Video Generation for Improving Human-to-Robot Object Handover Prediction
contribution: Introduces Hand2Bot, a human-centric RGB-D handover video dataset, and PassGen, a video-diffusion pipeline that synthesizes realistic handover sequences with sensor-like depth noise.

title: Assembly101: A Large-Scale Multi-View Video Dataset for Understanding Procedural Activities
contribution: 4321 multi-view videos of people assembling and disassembling take-apart toys with 1M fine-grained action segments and 18M 3D hand poses.

title: A Dataset of Relighted 3D Interacting Hands
contribution: Re:InterHand, a dataset of relighted images of accurately tracked two-hand 3D poses that combines realistic diverse appearance with large-scale ground truth (Datasets and Benchmarks track).
sensing: dense multi-camera studio capture with neural relighting

title: RenderIH: A Large-scale Synthetic Dataset for 3D Interacting Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: 1M photo-realistic synthetic images of interacting hands with optimized natural two-hand poses and the TransHand baseline; pretraining on it reduces error from 6.76 mm to 5.79 mm.

title: Reconstructing Interacting Hands with Interaction Prior from Monocular Images
contribution: Builds a two-hand interaction prior from a new large-scale physically plausible multimodal two-hand dataset (Two-hand 500K) and recasts reconstruction as conditional sampling from that prior.

title: HandoverSim: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Human-to-Robot Object Handovers
contribution: Simulation benchmark for human-to-robot handovers that replays captured human hand-grasp motions as the giver, with standardized protocols and metrics correlated with real-world evaluation.
sensing: simulation driven by mocap hand-grasp data (DexYCB)

title: ATTACH Dataset: Annotated Two-Handed Assembly Actions for Human Action Understanding
contribution: 51.6 hours of assembly with 95.2k fine-grained actions annotated separately for each hand, so that over 68 percent of annotations overlap in time.
sensing: three RGB-D (Azure Kinect) cameras with body skeletons

title: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
contribution: Large multi-modal, multi-view dataset and benchmark challenge with time-synchronized egocentric and exocentric video of skilled activities, including ego body and hand pose benchmarks.
sensing: egocentric Aria glasses plus multiple exocentric GoPro cameras, IMU, gaze, point clouds

title: Towards Human-Level Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with Reinforcement Learning
contribution: Bi-DexHands, a simulated benchmark of bimanual dexterous-hand tasks for reinforcement learning (Datasets and Benchmarks track).

title: ADL4D: Towards A Contextually Rich Dataset for 4D Activities of Daily Living
contribution: 75 sequences (1.1M RGB-D frames) of up to two subjects interacting with multiple objects in daily-living tasks, with hand and object poses including handover context.

title: HardMo: A Large-Scale Hardcase Dataset for Motion Capture
contribution: Large dataset of hard-case motions (unusual poses, extreme limb configurations) to expose and reduce failure modes of monocular motion capture.

title: KITRO: Refining Human Mesh by 2D Clues and Kinematic-tree Rotation
contribution: Refines an estimated human mesh with 2D cues by optimizing rotations along the kinematic tree, resolving depth ambiguity.

title: Multi-HMR: Multi-Person Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery in a Single Shot
contribution: Single-shot ViT model that detects people and regresses whole-body SMPL-X meshes with camera-space location for all people in an image.

title: VQ-HPS: Human Pose and Shape Estimation in a Vector-Quantized Latent Space
contribution: Human pose and shape estimation formulated as prediction in a vector-quantized mesh latent space.

title: WorldPose: A World Cup Dataset for Global 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Multi-person global 3D pose dataset from 2022 FIFA World Cup broadcast footage with about 2.5M SMPL poses over large outdoor fields and broadcast camera parameters.

title: Learned Neural Physics Simulation for Articulated 3D Human Pose Reconstruction
contribution: Learned neural physics simulator used inside articulated 3D human pose reconstruction from video to enforce physically plausible motion.

title: Optimal-state Dynamics Estimation for Physics-based Human Motion Capture from Videos
contribution: Physics-based human motion capture from video that blends kinematic estimates and simulated dynamics via optimal-state estimation.

title: Estimating Ego-Body Pose from Doubly Sparse Egocentric Video Data
contribution: Estimates full-body ego pose from egocentric video where hands are only intermittently visible (sparse in time and body coverage).

title: BLADE: Single-view Body Mesh Estimation through Accurate Depth Estimation
contribution: Close-range single-view body mesh estimation that recovers accurate depth, camera focal length and pose under strong perspective distortion.
datasets: synthetic close-range data generation (per repository description)

title: Reconstructing People, Places, and Cameras
contribution: Humans and Structure from Motion jointly recovers metric-scale multi-person meshes, scene point clouds and camera poses from sparse uncalibrated multi-view images.

title: Group Inertial Poser: Multi-Person Pose and Global Translation from Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ultra-Wideband Ranging
contribution: Multi-person pose and global translation from sparse IMUs using UWB ranging between sensors across people.
sensing: sparse IMUs with inter-person UWB ranging

title: Fish2Mesh Transformer: 3D Human Mesh Recovery from Egocentric Vision
contribution: Transformer for 3D human mesh recovery from egocentric fisheye views.

title: Semantics-aware Test-time Adaptation for 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Semantics-aware test-time adaptation of 3D pose estimators to handle occlusion and domain shift.

title: Systematic Comparison of Projection Methods for Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation on Fisheye Images
contribution: Systematically compares fisheye projection models for monocular 3D human pose estimation, relevant for close-range robot cameras.

title: E-3DPSM: A State Machine for Event-based Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: State-machine formulation for egocentric 3D human pose estimation from event-camera streams.

title: FlashCap: Millisecond-Accurate Human Motion Capture via Flashing LEDs and Event-Based Vision
contribution: Millisecond-accurate human motion capture using flashing LEDs observed by event-based vision.
sensing: event cameras with body-worn flashing LEDs

title: MoBind: Motion Binding for Fine-Grained IMU-Video Pose Alignment
contribution: Fine-grained alignment of IMU signals and video poses through a shared motion binding representation.
sensing: body-worn IMUs and monocular RGB video

title: EgoVLA: Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Egocentric Human Videos

title: Being-H0: Vision-Language-Action Pretraining from Large-Scale Human Videos

title: DexImit: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos

title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
contribution: Pipeline that reconstructs object meshes, hand motion and 6-DoF object tracks from everyday hand-object videos and retargets them with sampling-based MPC onto bimanual dexterous robot hands.

title: Traj2Action: A Co-Denoising Framework for Trajectory-Guided Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer

title: Im2Flow2Act: Flow as the Cross-Domain Manipulation Interface

title: In-N-On: Scaling Egocentric Manipulation with In-the-Wild and On-Task Data

title: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data
