contribution: Diffusion-based synthesis of single- and two-hand object manipulation motion conditioned on object mass.

title: UGG: Unified Generative Grasping
contribution: Unified diffusion transformer jointly generating object, dexterous hand grasp and contact anchors.

title: GRIP: Generating Interaction Poses Using Spatial Cues and Latent Consistency
contribution: Generates plausible two-hand interaction poses from body and object motion using spatial cues and latent temporal consistency.

title: ArtiGrasp: Physically Plausible Synthesis of Bi-Manual Dexterous Grasping and Articulation
contribution: RL and physics-simulation method synthesizing bimanual grasping and articulation of articulated objects.

title: HOGSA: Bimanual Hand-Object Interaction Understanding with 3D Gaussian Splatting Based Data Augmentation
contribution: 3D Gaussian splatting based augmentation that renders new bimanual hand-object views and poses to improve bimanual HOI pose estimation.
sensing: multi-view RGB (training data), monocular RGB at test

title: Object-Centric Dexterous Manipulation from Human Motion Data
contribution: Hierarchical policy where human-motion-derived wrist trajectories guide RL finger control for object-centric bimanual dexterous manipulation (listed as CVPR 2024 in haonanhe list; project page says CoRL 2024).
sensing: human mocap data (ARCTIC) to simulated and real robot

title: Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation (GR-1)
contribution: GPT-style model pretrained on large-scale human egocentric video prediction and finetuned for language-conditioned robot manipulation.
sensing: egocentric human video pretraining; robot RGB cameras

title: VLM See, Robot Do: Human Demo Video to Robot Action Plan via Vision Language Model
contribution: SeeDo: VLM pipeline converting long-horizon human demonstration videos into robot task plans.

title: ORION: Vision-based Manipulation from Single Human Video with Open-World Object Graphs
contribution: Extracts open-world object-centric graphs from a single human RGB-D video to derive robot manipulation policies.

title: Physics-Driven Data Generation for Contact-Rich Manipulation via Trajectory Optimization
contribution: Retargets a few human or teleop demonstrations through physics-based trajectory optimization to generate large contact-rich robot datasets.

title: OakInk2: A Dataset of Embodied Hands-Object Manipulation in Long-Horizon Complex Task Completion
contribution: Bimanual long-horizon object manipulation dataset with 3D hand, object and task-level annotations.
sensing: multi-view RGB plus egocentric, optical mocap for GT

title: Keypoint Fusion for RGB-D Based 3D Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Fuses RGB and depth only at sparse keypoint locations rather than dense pixels for 3D hand pose estimation under hand-object interaction.

title: QORT-Former: Query-optimized Real-time Transformer for Understanding Two Hands Manipulating Objects
contribution: Real-time transformer for 3D pose of two hands and an object from a single RGB image with query-optimized decoding.

title: A Versatile and Differentiable Hand-Object Interaction Representation
contribution: CHOIR: continuous differentiable BPS-based hand-object representation encoding object distances, hand anchors and Gaussian contact for refinement and grasp synthesis.

title: In-Hand 3D Object Reconstruction from a Monocular RGB Video
contribution: IHoR: per-sequence neural SDF reconstruction of an in-hand rotated object with amodal mask completion and physical contact priors for hand-occluded regions.

title: TexHOI: Reconstructing Textures of 3D Unknown Objects in Monocular Hand-Object Interaction Scenes
contribution: Reconstructs geometry and albedo texture of an unknown hand-manipulated object from monocular video, accounting for hand occlusion and shadowing.

title: SIGHT: Synthesizing Image-Text Conditioned and Geometry-Guided 3D Hand-Object Trajectories
contribution: Generates 3D hand-object trajectories from a single image plus a verb-noun text using diffusion with retrieval-based geometry guidance.

title: Gaze-guided Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis: Dataset and Method
contribution: GazeHOI: first dataset jointly capturing 3D gaze, bimanual hand and object motion, plus a gaze-conditioned HOI synthesis diffusion model.

title: ClickDiff: Click to Induce Semantic Contact Map for Controllable Grasp Generation with Diffusion Models
contribution: Controllable grasp generation from a user-specified semantic contact map via dual-stage conditional diffusion.

title: FastGrasp: Efficient Grasp Synthesis with Diffusion
contribution: One-stage latent diffusion for fast, physically plausible hand grasp synthesis without contact-map optimization.

title: Multi-Modal Diffusion for Hand-Object Grasp Generation
contribution: MGD: latent diffusion jointly denoising hand pose and object shape with asynchronous schedulers for grasp generation.

title: SNS-Grasp: Semantic-guided Noise Scaling for Grasp Generation
contribution: Semantic-guided anisotropic per-joint noise scaling in diffusion for intent-based grasp generation.

title: Reconstructing Hand-Held Objects in 3D from Images and Videos
contribution: MCC-HO: hand-conditioned transformer reconstructing hand-held object geometry from images and video, with retrieval-augmented reconstruction of template meshes.
sensing: single RGB image or monocular video

title: GeoHand: Unlocking Prior Geometry Knowledge for Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction
contribution: Injects frozen MoGe-2 geometric priors through a GeoAdapter into an RGB-only monocular hand reconstruction model.

title: HGGT: Robust and Flexible 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Images
contribution: VGGT-based feed-forward transformer jointly inferring hand meshes and camera poses from uncalibrated multi-view images.

title: Hand3R: Online 4D Hand-Scene Reconstruction in the Wild
contribution: Online end-to-end 4D hand-scene reconstruction coupling HaMeR with CUT3R for metric global hand placement and camera trajectory.

title: AffordGrasp: Cross-Modal Diffusion for Affordance-Aware Grasp Synthesis
contribution: Diffusion grasp synthesis from object point cloud and free-form text through an intermediate affordance representation.

title: SynHLMA: Synthesizing Hand Language Manipulation for Articulated Object with Discrete Human Object Interaction Representation
contribution: Language-guided autoregressive generation of hand manipulation of articulated objects via discrete HAOI tokens.

title: OpenHOI: Open-World Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis with Multimodal Large Language Model
contribution: Open-world HOI synthesis with a 3D MLLM for affordance grounding and task decomposition plus affordance-driven diffusion.

title: TOUCH: Text-guided Controllable Generation of Free-Form Hand-Object Interactions
contribution: Text-guided free-form hand-object interaction generation beyond grasping with contact prediction, diffusion and physics refinement.

title: Text2Grasp: Grasp synthesis by text prompts of object grasping parts
contribution: Text-prompted part-level dexterous grasp synthesis with diffusion plus contact optimization.

title: Multi-GraspLLM: A Multimodal LLM for Multi-Hand Semantic Guided Grasp Generation
contribution: Multimodal LLM generating semantic grasps for multiple robot end-effectors from point cloud and language.

title: MEgoHand: Multimodal Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Motion Generation
contribution: Egocentric HOI motion generation with a VLM plus metric depth at the high level and a flow-matching DiT at the low level.
sensing: egocentric RGB + text + initial hand pose
datasets: ARCTIC, OakInk2, H2O, HOI4D, HOT3D, TACO, FPHA

title: HVG-3D: Bridging Real and Simulation Domains for 3D-Conditional Hand-Object Interaction Video Synthesis
contribution: 3D ControlNet on CogVideoX conditioning HOI video synthesis on hand-object point clouds and tracks.

title: SViMo: Synchronized Diffusion for Video and Motion Generation in Hand-object Interaction Scenarios
contribution: Synchronized diffusion jointly generating HOI video and 3D hand-object motion.

title: Dexterous World Models
contribution: Scene-action-conditioned video diffusion turning static 3D scenes into interactive digital twins driven by egocentric hand motion.

title: Wh0: Generative World Models as Scalable Sources of Egocentric Human Hand Manipulation Data
contribution: Uses generative video world models to synthesize egocentric hand manipulation data (WM-H, 50k episodes) converted into robot supervision.

title: HandsOnWorld: Unconstrained Egocentric Video Generation with Camera-Disentangled Hand Control
contribution: Hand-controlled egocentric video generation trained on in-the-wild monocular video with the EgoVid-Pro 3D hand trajectory dataset.

title: CLAP: contrastive latent action pretraining for learning vision-language-action models from human videos
contribution: Contrastively aligns human-video latent actions to a robot proprioceptive action space for VLA pretraining.

title: Latent action pretraining from videos
contribution: LAPA: unsupervised latent action pretraining of VLA models from videos, including human videos, without action labels.

title: Moto: latent motion token as the bridging language for learning robot manipulation from videos
contribution: Latent motion tokens learned from video for autoregressive pretraining, then co-fine-tuned for robot manipulation.

title: UniHM: unified dexterous hand manipulation with vision language model
contribution: Unified language-guided dynamic dexterous hand manipulation via a morphology-agnostic hand tokenizer and VLM.

title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
contribution: Co-trains a pi0.5 VLA on egocentric human video and robot demonstrations for dexterous humanoid bimanual control.
datasets: in-house egocentric human and robot data

title: Scalable vision-language-action model pretraining for robotic manipulation with real-life human activity videos
contribution: VITRA: converts unscripted egocentric human videos into 1M-episode hand-VLA training data and pretrains a VLA transferred to robots.

title: H-RDT: human manipulation enhanced bimanual robotic manipulation
contribution: 2B diffusion transformer pretrained on egocentric human manipulation with 3D hand poses to improve bimanual robot manipulation.

title: HERMES: human-to-robot embodied learning from multi-source motion data for mobile dexterous manipulation
contribution: Converts human video and mocap motion into bimanual dexterous robot behaviour via RL in simulation, depth-based sim-to-real and closed-loop PnP localisation for mobile manipulation.
sensing: human motion (teleop, mocap, video); robot depth images

title: Web2Grasp: Learning Functional Grasps from Web Images of Hand-Object Interactions
contribution: Learns functional multi-finger robot grasps from web images of human hand-object interactions via HOI reconstruction and retargeting.

title: FlowHOI: Flow-based Semantics-Grounded Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
contribution: Flow-matching generation of hand-object interaction sequences from egocentric observation, language and a 3DGS scene for dexterous robot manipulation.

title: Gen2Act: Human Video Generation in Novel Scenarios enables Generalizable Robot Manipulation
contribution: Generates human videos for novel tasks and executes them with a video-conditioned robot policy.

title: Human2Robot: Learning Robot Actions from Paired Human-Robot Videos
contribution: Paired human-robot video dataset (H&R) and a video prediction model generating robot actions from human videos.

title: TraceGen: World Modeling in 3D Trace Space Enables Learning from Cross-Embodiment Videos
contribution: 3D trace-space world model and TraceForge data engine making human and robot videos interchangeable training data.

title: H2R-Grounder: A Paired-Data-Free Paradigm for Translating Human Interaction Videos into Physically Grounded Robot Videos
contribution: Translates human-object interaction videos into physically grounded robot videos without paired data.

title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
contribution: Converts Aria Gen2 egocentric human videos into paired dexterous robot demonstrations using an object-centric digital twin with FoundationPose.

title: AVI-HT: Adaptive Vision-IMU Fusion for 3D Hand Tracking
contribution: Adaptive visual-IMU fusion egocentric hand tracker with the DexGloveHOI dataset of egocentric video and IMU gloves.

title: GraspFoM: Towards Reconstruction-Driven Robotic Grasping with 3D Foundation Priors
contribution: Reconstruction-driven robotic grasping using 3D foundation-model priors.

title: CaRe-Ego: Contact-aware Relationship Modeling for Egocentric Interactive Hand-object Segmentation
contribution: Contact-aware relationship modeling for egocentric interactive hand-object segmentation.

title: MASS: Mesh-inellipse Aligned Deformable Surfel Splatting for Hand Reconstruction and Rendering from Egocentric Monocular Video
contribution: Surfel splatting aligned to the hand mesh for hand reconstruction and rendering from egocentric monocular video.

title: General Flow as Foundation Affordance for Scalable Robot Learning
contribution: Language-conditioned 3D object-point flow predictor trained on large RGB-D human video datasets, used as an embodiment-agnostic affordance for zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer (81 percent over 18 tasks).
sensing: RGB-D human video for training; robot RGB-D point cloud at deployment
datasets: Cross-embodiment RGB-D human video datasets (e.g., HOI4D)

title: RAM: Retrieval-Based Affordance Transfer for Generalizable Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
contribution: Builds an affordance memory from robot, human-object interaction and custom data, then retrieves and lifts 2D affordance to 3D for zero-shot manipulation across objects and embodiments.
sensing: Monocular RGB demonstrations for memory; robot RGB-D at execution
datasets: HOI data, robot datasets and internet sources (authors' affordance memory)

title: Dreamitate: Real-World Visuomotor Policy Learning via Video Generation
contribution: Fine-tunes a video diffusion model on human demonstrations performed with tools, generates an execution video in a new scene at test time and tracks the tool to control the robot.
sensing: Stereo RGB human demonstration video with tracked hand-held tools

title: ACE: A Cross-Platform Visual-Exoskeletons System for Low-Cost Dexterous Teleoperation
contribution: Low-cost visual-exoskeleton combining a hand-facing camera for 3D finger pose with an arm exoskeleton for wrist pose, enabling teleoperation and demonstration capture across humanoid hands, arm-hands and grippers.
sensing: Hand-facing RGB camera plus exoskeleton joint encoders

title: Ag2Manip: Learning Novel Manipulation Skills with Agent-Agnostic Visual and Action Representations
contribution: Agent-agnostic visual representation trained on human manipulation videos with embodiments masked, plus an agent-proxy action space, to learn novel manipulation skills without domain-specific demonstrations.
datasets: Human manipulation video corpora; FrankaKitchen, ManiSkill, PartManip simulations

title: Towards Generalizable Zero-Shot Manipulation via Translating Human Interaction Plans
contribution: Factorized approach that predicts future human hand and object configurations (a human plan) from web videos and translates the plan to robot actions for zero-shot manipulation.
sensing: Monocular RGB passive human video; robot RGB at test time
datasets: Large-scale passive human videos plus small robot data

title: Learning Visuotactile Skills with Two Multifingered Hands
contribution: HATO: low-cost bimanual hands-arms teleoperation system and touch-equipped multifingered hands for collecting visuotactile demonstrations and learning bimanual policies.
sensing: Multi-view RGB-D cameras, VR controllers, fingertip touch sensors

title: Articulated Object Estimation in the Wild
contribution: ArtiPoint infers articulated object models from human-object interaction videos under camera motion using deep point tracking and factor graph optimisation; introduces the Arti4D dataset.

title: Generalist Robot Manipulation beyond Action Labeled Data
contribution: Extracts dense dynamic 3D point clouds at the hand or gripper from action-free videos of humans or robots and trains a 3D dynamics predictor for self-supervision of a generalist policy.
datasets: Human and robot video data plus simulated and real tasks

title: TypeTele: Releasing Dexterity in Teleoperation by Dexterous Manipulation Types
contribution: Type-guided dexterous teleoperation that maps operator intent to dexterous manipulation types rather than direct hand retargeting, enabling actions beyond human hand patterns.

title: Dexplore: Scalable Neural Control for Dexterous Manipulation from Reference-Scoped Exploration
contribution: Single-loop optimisation that jointly retargets and tracks hand-object mocap to learn dexterous robot control, treating demonstrations as soft reference rather than ground truth.

title: FUNCTO: Function-Centric One-Shot Imitation Learning for Tool Manipulation
contribution: One-shot imitation of tool manipulation from a single human video by establishing functional correspondences between demonstration and test tools.

title: GraphMimic: Graph-to-Graphs Generative Modeling from Videos for Policy Learning
contribution: Pre-trains a graph-to-graphs generative model on video frames abstracted into object and visual-action vertices, then uses it for policy learning with little action-labelled data.
datasets: Video datasets plus simulated and real robot tasks

title: Ag2x2: Robust Agent-Agnostic Visual Representations for Zero-Shot Bimanual Manipulation
contribution: Coordination-aware agent-agnostic visual representation from human videos encoding object states and hand motion, reaching 73.5 percent over 13 bimanual tasks without demonstrations.
sensing: Monocular RGB human video for representation learning; simulation

title: VTAO-BiManip: Masked Visual-Tactile-Action Pre-training with Object Understanding for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
contribution: Visual-tactile-action pre-training on human bimanual demonstrations with hand motion and object understanding, used to guide curriculum RL for bimanual dexterous tasks.
sensing: RGB video plus tactile and hand motion data from human demonstrations

title: Exo-ViHa: A Cross-Platform Exoskeleton System with Visual and Haptic Feedback for Efficient Dexterous Skill Learning
contribution: Cross-platform exoskeleton for dexterous demonstration collection with visual and haptic feedback.
sensing: Exoskeleton encoders plus camera (details not on fetched pages)

title: Geometric Retargeting: A Principled, Ultrafast Neural Hand Retargeting Algorithm
contribution: GeoRT neural hand retargeting at about 1 kHz using geometric objectives to map human hand keypoints to robot hand joints for teleoperation and data conversion.
sensing: Human hand keypoints from mocap or vision

title: Joint-Aligned Latent Action: Towards Scalable VLA Pretraining in the Wild
contribution: Latent action learning aligned with hand joint motion for VLA pre-training on in-the-wild human videos.

title: ViHaTeleop: A Low-Cost, Lightweight Visual-Haptic Teleoperation System for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
contribution: 0.7 kg, 550 USD visual-haptic teleoperation with SLAM wrist tracking, camera hand tracking and vibrotactile feedback, raising success on contact-critical tasks.
sensing: Wearable fisheye hand camera, SLAM wrist tracking, LRA haptics

title: Learning Diverse Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Skills from Human Demonstrations
contribution: BiDexHD builds bimanual dexterous tasks automatically from existing human bimanual datasets and learns them with teacher-student RL and distillation.

title: DEXOP: A Device for Robotic Transfer of Dexterous Human Manipulation
contribution: Passive hand exoskeleton (perioperation) linking human fingers to robot fingers to record vision and tactile demonstrations that transfer directly to a robot hand.

title: SPIDER: Scalable Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
contribution: Physics-based retargeting that turns kinematic-only human demonstrations from mocap, video and VR into dynamically feasible robot trajectories at scale.
sensing: Human hand and body motion from mocap, video or VR

title: UmeTrack: Unified multi-view end-to-end hand tracking for VR
contribution: End-to-end multi-view hand tracking for VR headsets; its dataset and hand model are used by the HANDS Multiview Egocentric Hand Tracking (MegoTrack) challenge for the pose and shape tracks.

title: PCIE_Pose Solution for EgoExo4D Pose and Proficiency Estimation Challenge
contribution: Challenge-solution report for the Ego-Exo4D pose and proficiency estimation challenges; only the title was seen, so the method itself was not checked.

title: MUSE: Model-based Uncertainty-aware Similarity Estimation for zero-shot 2D Object Detection and Segmentation
contribution: Training-free detection and segmentation of unseen objects that matches proposals to rendered multi-view templates; it reports first place in BOP Challenge 2025 on the Classic Core, H3 and Industrial tracks.

title: 3DGS-based Bimanual Category-agnostic Interaction Reconstruction (HANDS 2024 ARCTIC challenge technical report, team UVHANDS)
contribution: Challenge report that applies 3D Gaussian splatting to template-free reconstruction of two hands and an object, submitted to the HANDS 2024 ARCTIC track.

title: 2nd Place Solution Technical Report for Hands'24 ARCTIC Challenge from Team ACE
contribution: Second-place solution report for template-free bimanual hand-object reconstruction in the HANDS 2024 ARCTIC challenge.

title: Solution of Multiview Egocentric Hand Tracking Challenge ECCV2024 (team JVHANDS; cited elsewhere as 1st Place Solution)
contribution: Winning solution report for the HANDS 2024 MegoTrack challenge, which estimates MANO pose and shape from calibrated stereo egocentric hand-crop videos.

title: Technical report of HCB team for Multiview Egocentric Hand Tracking Challenge on HANDS 2024 Challenge
contribution: Challenge report for the HANDS 2024 multiview egocentric hand pose and shape tracking tracks.

title: GHOST: Gaussian Hand-Object Surface Reconstruction with Geometric Priors
contribution: Challenge report (team DFKI-AV) on Gaussian-based reconstruction of hand and object surfaces with geometric priors, listed among the HANDS 2025 technical reports alongside the ARCTIC template-free track.

title: Technical Report of HCB-Hand Team for Dexterous HO Tracker Challenge on HANDS 2025 Challenge
contribution: Challenge report on transferring noisy human single- and bimanual hand-object mocap to dexterous robot hands in Isaac Gym.
sensing: hand-object mocap reference trajectories; physics simulation

title: Egocentric 3D Hand-Object Tracking in the Wild with Mobile Multi-Camera Rig
contribution: Extended abstract describing a mobile multi-camera rig for 3D hand-object tracking in the wild (the capture setup behind SHOW3D).

title: DyTact: Capturing Dynamic Contacts in Hand-Object Manipulation
contribution: Markerless capture of dynamic hand-object contacts during manipulation that improves contact estimation and novel-view synthesis.
sensing: markerless multi-view RGB video (per summary; not re-checked)

title: DF-Mamba: Deformable State Space Modeling for 3D Hand Pose Estimation in Interactions
contribution: Deformable state-space backbone for 3D hand pose estimation during hand-hand and hand-object interactions.

title: Get a Grip: Reconstructing Hand-Object Stable Grasps in Egocentric Videos
contribution: Reconstructs stable hand-object grasps from egocentric video.

title: Generative Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Hand Pose and Action Modeling
contribution: Generative hierarchical temporal transformer that jointly models hand pose and action (full paper in the HANDS 2024 proceedings).

title: ChildPlay-Hand: A Dataset of Hand Manipulations in the Wild
contribution: In-the-wild dataset of hand manipulations (full paper in the HANDS 2024 proceedings).

title: Pre-Training for 3D Hand Pose Estimation with Contrastive Learning on Large-Scale Hand Images in the Wild
contribution: Contrastive pre-training (HandCLR) on large-scale in-the-wild hand images for 3D hand pose estimation.

title: Diffusion-based Interacting Hand Pose Transfer
contribution: Diffusion-based transfer of interacting two-hand poses.

title: Learn 2D, Solve 3D: UA-Fit, an Uncertainty-Weighted Analytical Solver for Multi-view Hand Mesh Recovery
contribution: Recovers multi-view hand meshes with an uncertainty-weighted analytical solver driven by learned 2D predictions.

title: Cascaded Diffusion Framework for Probabilistic Coarse-to-Fine Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Cascaded diffusion model for probabilistic, coarse-to-fine 3D hand pose estimation.

title: Observe, Retarget, and Distill: Grounding Human Demonstrations in Robot Experience for Dexterous Grasping
contribution: Retargets observed human grasp demonstrations to a robot hand and distils them through robot experience for dexterous grasping.
sensing: human demonstration video (not detailed on page)

title: Joint-Query Spatial Attention for Egocentric Interaction Fields: Second Place in the SHOW3D Challenge at HANDS 2026
contribution: Second-place solution for SHOW3D dense hand-object interaction field estimation, using joint-query spatial attention.

title: GOLF: Global Observation with Local Focus for Calibration-Aware Stereo Interaction Field Estimation
contribution: Calibration-aware stereo method for SHOW3D hand-object interaction field estimation; it is listed as a challenge technical report without a stated rank.

title: Joint-Conditioned Stereo Surface Reasoning for Interaction Field Estimation
contribution: Stereo surface-reasoning method for the SHOW3D interaction field challenge.

title: TokenHMR: Advancing Human Mesh Recovery with a Tokenized Pose Representation
contribution: Reformulates HMR pose regression as classification over a learned discrete pose token vocabulary and adds a threshold-adaptive loss to tolerate biased pseudo-ground-truth, improving 3D accuracy.

title: AiOS: All-in-One-Stage Expressive Human Pose and Shape Estimation
contribution: Detection-transformer-based one-stage method that estimates expressive whole-body SMPL-X for multiple people without a separate detector, improving robustness to truncation and crowding.
datasets: AGORA, BEDLAM, EgoBody, ARCTIC, COCO, UBody

title: LiveHPS++: Robust and Coherent Motion Capture in Dynamic Free Environment
contribution: Single-LiDAR motion capture that handles noise and occlusion in dynamic scenes with trajectory-aware temporal modelling for coherent body motion.

title: DiSRT-In-Bed: Diffusion-Based Sim-to-Real Transfer Framework for In-Bed Human Mesh Recovery
contribution: Diffusion-based sim-to-real transfer for human mesh recovery of people lying in bed and occluded by blankets, trained largely on synthetic data.
sensing: single top-view camera (depth, pressure or thermal modalities as in SLP)

title: AvatarPose: Avatar-guided 3D Pose Estimation of Close Human Interaction from Sparse Multi-view Videos
contribution: Uses personalized implicit neural avatars as priors to estimate 3D poses of closely interacting people from sparse multi-view video, resolving mutual occlusion.

title: Reconstructing Close Human Interactions from Multiple Views
contribution: Multi-view pipeline for reconstructing poses of closely interacting people with heavy mutual occlusion using learned 2D cues and interaction priors.

title: Sapiens: Foundation for Human Vision Models
contribution: Family of human-centric ViT foundation models pretrained on large human image collections for 2D pose, body-part segmentation, depth and normal estimation.

title: ProbPose: A Probabilistic Approach to 2D Human Pose Estimation
contribution: Predicts calibrated keypoint presence and visibility probabilities, including keypoints outside the image, for uncertainty-aware pose under occlusion and truncation.

title: OpenMoCap: Rethinking Optical Motion Capture under Real-world Occlusion
contribution: Studies optical marker-based motion capture under realistic marker occlusion and proposes an occlusion-robust solver with a matching dataset.

title: Masked Modeling for Human Motion Recovery Under Occlusions
contribution: Uses masked motion modelling to recover complete human motion from monocular video when body parts are occluded.

title: Portable Biomechanics Laboratory: Clinically Accessible Movement Analysis from a Handheld Smartphone
contribution: Smartphone-video biomechanical reconstruction pipeline for clinical gait and movement analysis without a motion capture lab.

title: Biomechanical Reconstruction with Confidence Intervals from Multiview Markerless Motion Capture
contribution: Markerless multi-view biomechanical reconstruction that outputs calibrated confidence intervals on joint kinematics.

title: UST-Hand: An Uncertainty-aware Spatiotemporal Point Cloud Interaction Network for 3D Self-supervised Hand Pose Estimation
contribution: Self-supervised, uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal network for 3D hand pose estimation from depth point-cloud sequences.

title: Human Interaction-Aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image
contribution: Reconstructs multiple interacting people from one image while reasoning about their contact and mutual occlusion.

title: Muscles in Time: Learning to Understand Human Motion by Simulating Muscle Activations
contribution: Large simulated dataset of muscle activations paired with AMASS motions for learning muscle-aware motion understanding (Datasets and Benchmarks track).

title: InterCap: Joint Markerless 3D Tracking of Humans and Objects in Interaction from Multi-view RGB-D Images
contribution: Markerless multi-view RGB-D capture method and dataset for whole-body human and object interaction with contact reasoning.
